Sooo annoyed right now. There’s this car parked with a permit but it’s from another neighborhood. How is that fair? I’m just trying to get in and out and now I gotta squeeze past this mess. Please do something about it!

Every time I walk out my front door, there’s this dude using his permit to park wherever he pleases. I thought they were supposed to be for specific spots or something? Anyway, now I gotta dodge his car to get to the bus, it’s ridiculous!
I can't believe it, I swear this car on my block has a permit but it can't be legit. It's parked on the sidewalk half the time! Like, what are we doing here? How does that even happen?

label: General Construction/Plumbing. Fence - None/Inadequate
complaints: Why has the construction on my block been going for weeks and weeks?? I’m talkin’ like all day, every day, it’s so loud I can’t even hear myself think! And now I have these huge holes where fences should be, it looks terrible and makes my whole street look like a warzone!

There’s some construction happening on my street and they put up these flimsy barriers that keep falling down! It’s super dangerous, and there’s no real fence so kids just run into the street. Like, what are they even doing over there?

I don’t know who’s in charge of this construction but can someone please tell them to put up a proper fence? I have a dog and it’s scary letting him out when there’s no barrier. And the noise is unreal, my neighbors are losing it!

Listen, the mess from this construction is getting outta hand. There’s no fence or anything keeping people away from the site, just some cones! It’s a safety hazard, I saw a kid trip and fall the other day, and it’s just not okay!

label: Dead Animal. Rat or Mouse. Street or Sidewalk
complaints: Yo, there’s a dead rat just chillin on the sidewalk at 5th and 12th. It’s been there for days, I swear! Can someone come get it? It's gross and I have to walk by it every day!
Ugh, there’s seriously a mouse corpse near the trash cans on my block. It’s so nasty, I can’t even take my dog out without gagging. Please, please remove it ASAP!
Hey, I know this might sound weird but there’s a dead animal (not sure if it's a rat or a mouse) right by the bus stop on 3rd Ave. It smells sooo bad! Like can you please send someone quick?
I got outta work and stepped right over this dead rat or something on the sidewalk by the cafe at 42nd street. C’mon, it’s disgusting, can we please get it cleaned up or something?

label: Illegal Posting. Poster or Sign. Other
complaints: There’s this flyer for a psychic consultation taped to every lamppost on my street, like how many people really need their future read? It’s super tacky and it’s ruining the vibe of the neighborhood, like we’re not a tourist trap! They need to take this down, it’s all over the place!

I don’t know who keeps sticking those annoying ‘We Buy Houses’ signs everywhere, but it’s getting out of hand! I counted at least five just on my block. It’s cluttered and makes the place look cheap, plus they’re not even local! UGH!

I saw this weird poster with some shrieking cat on it plastered up on my favorite coffee shop door! It’s totally out of place, like what does it even mean? Can someone tell these people to stick to the internet and stop ruining public spaces? It’s so annoying!

There’s a sign for a lost dog taped to every single corner of this block, including mine! I get it, people lose pets! But can’t they just put them in one central place? Now I’m tripping over these signs and it’s giving me a headache!

label: Damaged Tree. Tree Alive - in Poor Condition. Cracked
complaints: There’s this huge tree out in front of my building and it’s cracked and looking real sick. I’m worried it might fall on someone or something! Can someone PLEASE come check it out?
I noticed the big tree by the park is all messed up, like, one good wind and it’s gonna break! It’s got this huge crack down the side and there’s like weird fungus growing on it. Not safe!

So there’s this tree on my street that’s got a nasty crack in it and it’s been there for ages. I thought maybe it would get better but it’s just getting worse! Feels like an accident waiting to happen, guys!
I don’t know who to call, but the tree by my apartment is all damaged and looks like it’s about to topple over. I’m worried it’ll crush my car or hit someone. Can somebody come look at it?

label: Safety. Fire Escape. Window Broken Or Blocked
complaints: So I just noticed that the fire escape outside my apartment is totally blocked off by some random garbage and a bunch of old furniture. Like, what if there’s an emergency?! This is ridiculous! Can someone please do something about it?

Ummm hello?! My fire escape window is broken and it’s been like that for weeks now. I can’t even open it to get fresh air and it’s getting super stuffy in here. Plus, what if there's a fire or something? Super unsafe!

There’s a big tree growing out of the fire escape outside and it’s blocking the whole thing! I can’t even see the steps! What if I need to get out fast? Please send someone to cut that down already! This is crazy!

Seriously, why does my neighbor keep piling junk on the fire escape? It’s like a hoarder’s paradise out there! What if there’s an emergency? I can’t believe that this is allowed to happen, it’s so unsafe!

label: Non-Residential Heat. Inadequate or No Heat
complaints: It's freezing in here and the heat ain't working at all! I got a baby to keep warm and I'm about to lose it! Please help, I can't take this cold anymore!!
I called a week ago about the heat being out, and it’s still like Antarctica in my apartment. I pay way too much rent for this nonsense. Where’s the heat?

So like, I'm sitting here in my winter coat indoors, my fingers are numb and the radiator hasn't made a peep in days. Can anyone please fix this or am I gonna have to start making fires with my furniture?
My heat just stopped working, and I'm over here bundled up in a million layers with a hot cup of tea, but that only goes so far. Who do I even need to talk to to get this fixed? Ugh!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Pedestrian Signal. Allout
complaints: The pedestrian signal at 42nd and 8th is totally dead!!! I’ve almost been hit like 5 times trying to cross. Can’t you fix this?? It’s a busy area for crying out loud!
Yo, what’s up with the walk signal on 3rd Ave? It ain’t working and people are just standing there confused! It’s super dangerous with this crazy traffic! Get it together!
I was waiting forever at the corner of 14th and 6th, the walk sign never lit up! I tried crossing anyway and cars were flying by. Please someone do something about this before someone gets hurt!

Seriously, I almost witnessed a tragedy today at the corner of 34th and Broadway. The pedestrian signal was out of order, and I saw elderly people waiting there forever. This is ridiculous! Fix this ASAP!

label: Dead Animal. Raccoon. Street or Sidewalk
complaints: Hey there, there's a raccoon just lying in the middle of my street, like it doesn't even care. It's gross and starting to smell! Can someone come and take it away, please?
I can’t believe this, but there’s a dead raccoon on my block. I just walked past it and it’s been there for a couple of days now, what are we supposed to do? It’s so unsanitary, like come on!
Ughhh! There’s a dead raccoon on the sidewalk near my building. I’ve seen rats but this is next level gross! It’s been there too long and I’m getting worried about the smell and everything else!

Listen, this raccoon on 5th Ave is just laying there, not moving, and it’s totally creeping me out. I thought it was a stuffed animal at first but nope, it’s very much NOT. Can someone do something about this ASAP?

label: Illegal Tree Damage. Branches Damaged
complaints: There’s this huge tree outside my building and the branches are all messed up, like someone took a chainsaw to it or something! It looks ridiculous and I’m worried it’s gonna fall on my car or someone walking by!

Ugh, why do people think it's okay to just mess with trees? The branch from that tree on 5th Ave is hanging way too low now, like I can barely walk under it without ducking. Can someone please fix it before it takes an eye out?!

I don’t know who damaged the branches on that big tree by the playground, but it looks like a disaster area. It’s not safe for kids to be playing there with all that debris around. Get it together, people!
Please do something about the branches on the tree in front of my apartment, they’re all broken and half hanging down. It’s an eyesore and I’m worried it’s gonna fall on someone’s head!

label: Water Conservation. Illegal Use Of A Hydrant (CIN). Cin
complaints: There’s some dudes in front of my building like every day just blasting water from the fire hydrant, I mean really?! It’s a drought and they’re just wasting it like it’s nothing, like come on, how selfish can you be?

I saw a bunch of guys using a fire hydrant to wash their truck and I’m like, hello? Can we all just be a little responsible here? It’s been super dry and they’re just chillin’ spraying everywhere, it’s not okay!

Why are people still using fire hydrants to water their gardens or whatever? I mean, I get it, it’s summer but there are rules for a reason. My neighbor is out there every day using it like it’s a garden hose. Can someone please do something?

Every time I walk my dog past that corner there’s this constant flow of water from the hydrant, it’s ridiculous. The ground’s all muddy and it’s attracting a bunch of mosquitoes and honestly, it’s just a big mess. Can’t they just figure it out?

I thought the toilet was just being cranky but it started leaking all over the floor. Now I gotta mop up every few hours. What’s up with that? Can someone help? This is gross!
My neighbor’s water heater is leaking, and I’m afraid it’s gonna mess with my apartment too. It’s all over the place down there, smells bad and I just can’t deal with it. They don’t seem to care!

Ughhh my bathroom sink is completely detached from the wall and water is leaking everywhere! It's such a mess I don't know what to do, can someone send a repair guy or something??? I just moved in and this is nuts!
The sink in my kitchen fell off! I’m serious! It’s just hanging there and I can’t even use it. What’s going on??? I don’t have time for this nonsense, I need it fixed right away!

The playground is a disaster waiting to happen, it’s open ALL NIGHT. I saw a group of older teens hanging out there last night, it’s not cool, lock it up already please!

I just cleaned my car and now there's a huge splatter of pigeon poop on the windshield. Can't we get rid of these birds or at least do something about the mess they leave behind? This is ridiculous.

complaints: Yo this parking meter on 5th St is totally busted, It won't take my card or coins and I don't have time to waste! What am I supposed to do now?

label: Noise - Park. Loud Talking
complaints: I was just trying to enjoy a quiet afternoon in the park but this group of people are yelling and laughing so loud like it’s a party or something, can’t even hear myself think!

Seriously, why do people think it’s okay to shout in the park? I’m just trying to read my book and all I hear is them talking about their weekend plans like they’re at a football game!

Why is this park always closed? I swear I drive by and it looks great but the gates are always shut! I planned my whole Sunday around a picnic but I guess that’s not happening now. Can’t believe I wasted my time.

complaints: I took a cab from the airport and my card got charged way too much, like where did this extra fee even come from??? I didn’t even get a receipt. Not cool man, I’m not made of money!

complaints: Hey, I was driving down 5th and there's no stop sign where it should be by the park! It's seriously dangerous, I almost got hit by a bike, like c'mon people can't just assume to stop, fix this ASAP!

Ugh, can someone check the corner of Maple and 3rd? I swear there's supposed to be a stop sign but the last few weeks it's been gone! I've almost seen two near misses since then, this is getting ridiculous!

Just want to let you know that the stop sign at Elm and 12th is missing. I don't know if it's vandalism or what but cars are just speeding through and it’s making me super nervous walking my dog there!

complaints: I can’t even walk down the sidewalk near 5th Ave and 34th street! This street vendor has taken over like a mini mall and it’s super crowded, people are bumping into each other, I nearly tripped over a cooler!

So there’s like this whole setup of chairs and tables on the sidewalk outside the restaurant at 3rd and 10th, it’s a total mess, my dog can’t even do his business without bumping into people. Can someone do something about this?

complaints: I swear there’s a rat infestation in the alley behind my building, I saw like 5 of them last night! It’s disgusting! Can’t even take out the trash without feeling like I’m in a horror movie.

You need to do something about the pest problem at the pizza place on 12th street, I saw a huge cockroach crawl across the counter while I was waiting for my food. So gross!

complaints: OMG a whole tree just fell down in front of my apartment on 2nd Ave and now my sidewalk is blocked. Like what if an ambulance needs to get through? This is crazy, it was just windy. Get it together, please!!

I don’t know what happened but there’s this ginormous tree fallen over in front of my building. It looks like it might’ve crushed a car too? This is nuts, can we get someone to at least clear it up?

complaints: There is this car parked at the bus stop on 5th Ave and it’s blocking the whole lane!! Buses can’t pull in and people are just standing there waiting forever. It’s so annoying!

I mean, seriously, there's a tree just chillin' on its side in the middle of the street! My kids almost tripped over it on their way to school, it's such a hazard! Fix it before someone gets hurt!

complaints: There's this street sign hanging on by a thread on 5th Ave, I swear if it falls it’s gonna hit someone! Can someone fix it ASAP please?!

complaints: So like, a big branch just fell off this tree in my front yard and now it's leaning on my roof! I can't tell if it's gonna do damage or not, but I’m freaking out a little here. Do I need to call someone to fix this or what?
OMG, a giant limb fell on my house during that storm last night! My kids are scared and I think it cracked the gutter or something? Can someone come look at it before it gets worse?

This morning I stepped outside and there was a huge tree limb on my porch! I didn’t even hear it fall. I’m worried it might have damaged the railing, can someone check it out?

complaints: I took a ride last night and the driver didn't even follow the route I put in, like I know traffic is crazy but we went in a full circle! And then he had the nerve to ask for a tip, I was like dude, no way!

My driver was super rude the whole ride, kinda made me uncomfortable honestly, and when I tried to rate him he wouldn't stop talking over me. What is with these people?!

complaints: There's a construction site on 5th Ave and the workers are literally standing on the edge of a crumbling sidewalk, like are they trying to get hurt? It's super dangerous and makes me super nervous every time I walk by, like what if they fall?

Hey I just walked past the site on West 34th and there's like no signs or barriers or anything, just a bunch of workers in hard hats doing their thing. I swear they could get hurt any minute! Can someone check it out before someone gets seriously injured?

Ummm, excuse me, but the construction down on East 42nd is a total mess. No safety measures at all! There’s debris everywhere and the workers look like they have no idea what they're doing. This isn’t safe for them or for us walking by!

I just moved into this place and found a bunch of these weird little termites in the wood by the window. I can't even... like how does that even happen? This is so gross, I don’t know what to do!
I swear I just saw a huge termite in my bathroom!! I've tried cleaning but I’m freaking out here, I can't sleep knowing these things are crawling around my house!
My landlord says it's normal to see some bugs here and there but no, I got termites crawling on my walls! It’s been a week and nothing has been done. Such a nightmare, pls help!!

label: Consumer Complaint. Hotel or Motel. Contract or Billing Dispute
complaints: I booked a room at the fancy hotel for my anniversary and they charged me extra for the 'ocean view' and guess what? I could barely see the water! Just a sliver if I stretched my neck out the window! So annoyed, wedding plans ruined!

So I stayed at this hotel, and they charged me for mini-bar snacks I NEVER TOUCHED! I even checked out before I used any of it! Like, how do they even figure that out? I'm not paying for their mistake! Terrible experience overall.

I booked a room for 2 nights, they charged me for 3! I called them and they keep saying it was a 'system error' or whatever. I’m wondering if they just got greedy, I feel totally cheated! Can't trust hotels no more!

I had to cancel my reservation cause of an emergency and they refuse to refund me! They keep saying it’s their policy and it’s like, why have a policy if you’re not gonna help people in need? Totally heartless!

label: Obstruction. Sign. Sidewalk
complaints: There's this stupid sign just blocking the whole sidewalk on 5th Ave like can you not put it somewhere else? It's a mess and people keep bumping into each other because of it! Ugh!

Hey, there’s a construction sign on my block that’s been there for weeks, it literally takes up the entire sidewalk and my stroller can't even get by. This is so annoying like who do I even complain to?
Walking my dog and there’s this giant sign right in the middle of the sidewalk! It's so irritating, I had to walk on the street to get around it! Can someone move it already?
Why is there a detour sign on my corner that makes it impossible to walk? I'm tired of dodging it every day. Like how hard is it to put it on the side or something??

label: Consumer Complaint. Garage or Parking Lot. Unlicensed
complaints: So I parked in the garage on 34th street and I swear some dude was charging money without a license or anything! Like, how does that even happen? I want my $20 back!
I can't believe these people are operating a parking lot and they don't even have the proper signs or licenses! What a scam! I feel totally ripped off parking there last week.
Can someone check on that parking garage on 5th? I parked there and it was super sketchy, no real management, just some guy taking my money with no ID or anything, felt like a total scam!
Why is there an unlicensed parking garage on 8th Ave? I parked there and the guy just pocketed my cash, no receipt, no nothing! This is so shady, why is this allowed?

label: Street Sign - Missing. St Name - Attached to Pole
complaints: Hey! So there’s this missing street sign on 5th and 12th, like how am I supposed to know where I’m going? I almost made a wrong turn into traffic! Pls fix this ASAP!
Seriously?! I was trying to give directions to my friend and the st sign at 3rd and Pine is gone! No wonder everyone gets lost around here! C’mon, can we get some signs that don’t vanish?
Ugh, I was walking down Maple Ave and there’s just no sign! Like am I supposed to guess where I am? This city is nuts, it’s like a treasure hunt without the treasure. Get it together!
There’s a missing street name sign on the corner of 8th and Broadway. It’s really annoying because I need to find my way around and it’s just blank. Help!

label: Residential Disposal Complaint. Storage Area Not Provided. Super or Building Manager
complaints: Ugh! So my building has no place to throw out garbage properly! I have to drag my trash bags all the way to the curb and it's such a hassle, especially when it’s raining. Can’t we get a dumpster or at least a better setup?

Seriously, why is there NO storage for trash in my building? It’s like they expect us to just pile it up in our apartments. I live on the 5th floor and it’s disgusting having to haul all that junk down the stairs!

We don’t have a trash bin or any area to put our garbage, it’s so frustrating. I’ve called the super like a thousand times but nothing gets done! It’s embarrassing to have guests over with all this trash everywhere.

Can someone explain why we don’t have a designated spot for trash? It’s ridiculous! I keep tripping over bags in the hallway because no one knows where to put them. I thought living in the city would be better than this, but it’s a mess!

label: Sidewalk Condition. Sidewalk Grating - Defective
complaints: the grates on my block are raised and I tripped over one like I was in a circus act, not funny! can someone fix this before someone gets really hurt?
these sidewalk grates are a disaster! every time I walk my dog he almost gets stuck in one of the gaps, plus it’s super ugly and dangerous. so annoying!
ok real talk, I nearly broke my ankle on those janky sidewalk grates by 5th and main. like, do you guys care about our safety or nah? get it together please!
i can’t with these sidewalk grates anymore!!! they are so uneven and just waiting to cause accidents. every step feels like a gamble. fix them already!

label: Lost Property. Other. Other
complaints: I can't belive I lost my laptop at the coffee shop on 5th Ave yesterday, I was so stressed out and now I don't know what to do, I just need someone to help me find it!!!
So I was on the train, right? And I totally left my backpack there, it's got my phone charger and favorite hoodie in it. Please, if anyone sees it, let me know. I'm freaking out!
Ugh I swear I lost my keys in the park last week, I can't even remember where exactly but I need em back, they have my apartment key and everything—what if someone finds them and takes my stuff?!
I lost my favorite red scarf, I was at the grocery store on Broadway and I think I left it in the cart or something, it was a gift from my grandma and means the world to me, please keep an eye out.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Garbage or Litter. Full Trash Bag Not Picked Up
complaints: Hey, I just wanted to say there’s a garbage bag just sitting on the corner of 5th and 34th it’s been there for DAYS! Smells like a dumpster, please send someone to pick it up before it attracts more trash, UGH!
Seriously, can someone do something about the trash? There’s a huge full bag just chillin' near my building and it’s a total eyesore. It’s like, can we at least get someone to take it away?
What is going on with the trash collection around here? There’s a full bag next to my stoop and it’s been there since Friday. Are we living in a landfill or what?
I’m so sick of seeing trash everywhere! I’ve got a black garbage bag just chilling on my corner for a week now! It’s like no one cares! I can’t take my kids out there cause it stinks! PLEASE HELP.

label: Food Establishment. Rodents/Insects/Garbage. Condition Attracting Vermin
complaints: I can't even believe the amount of rats I see around the trash cans outside the deli on 42nd and 8th, it’s like a rat convention over there. Can’t they clean up better?
There’s a stench coming from the garbage bins behind the pizza place on 3rd Ave, and I swear I saw a raccoon dive in there like it was an all-you-can-eat buffet or something, this is ridiculous.

Ugh, why is it so hard for these restaurants to take out their trash properly?? The alley behind my building smells like a landfill and it just attracts more and more mice – this is seriously not okay!

I don’t know how there are so many rats around here, but every time I walk by the taco truck near the park, I see them scurrying around the garbage. It’s gross and I feel like it’s gonna end up in my food if they don’t fix this!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Signal Lens. Out
complaints: Yo there's a traffic light at 5th and 42nd that don't work! It's been flickering on and off and cars just zoom past. Someone's gonna get hit if this keeps up!
That light at Broadway and 34th is totally busted, red doesn't even show up. How is anyone supposed to cross when drivers think it's all green? Fix it already!
So like, I was waiting at that corner for ages and the pedestrian signal was out. All these cars were running through thinking they could go, felt super unsafe. Can someone get over there ASAP?
The signal at 8th Ave and 23rd is completely dead, like, how are we suppose to know when to cross? It's chaos with all the bikers and cars, please fix this before someone gets hurt!

label: Smoking or Vaping. Sign Inadequate. Not Posted
complaints: I was just walking in the park and this dude was vaping like crazy, like what happened to no smoking here?? There’s no signs ANYWHERE and it's kinda gross honestly, can we get some sort of notice up??

So I went to grab coffee and I couldn't even enjoy it because this group of people was smoking right outside the shop. Like, can we get some CLEAR signs or something? I don't wanna breathe in their smoke!
Y'all need to post more signs about smoking in the area! I'm sick of walking down the street and getting hit with clouds of vape smoke. It’s mad irritating and I’m allergic!
Last week I was at the playground with my kids and this guy is just puffing away with no sign saying he can’t. It’s really disturbing, can’t we put up some clear no smoking signs?

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Vehicle Signal. Allout
complaints: Yo, the traffic light at 5th and 42nd is totally out. Cars just zooming through, it’s an accident waiting to happen! Can someone fix this like ASAP?!
I almost got hit by a bus at Broadway and 34th because the traffic signal isn’t working!! This is serious, please get on it before someone gets injured!
So, uh, the light at 8th Ave & 23rd is completely dead. Just blinking red and no one knows what to do! It’s chaos out here, like a free-for-all. Please fix it!
The traffic signal at 14th and 6th is all messed up, feels like a game of Frogger trying to cross. C’mon, it’s dangerous out here and I’m tired of dodging cars.

label: General Construction/Plumbing. Posted Notice Or Order Removed/Tampered With
complaints: Hey, so I just saw that notice about the construction work on my block is totally ripped down like what even?! I need to know what's going on bc it's been a mess out here for weeks! Can't believe they just took it down, it makes no sense!!

Um, I was walking by and noticed that sign about the plumbing work near my building is gone. My neighbor said it was there yesterday but now?? Nothing! I’m not trying to get stuck in a huge water mess. Can someone put that back up?!

Okay, I don’t think it’s okay when they just remove those notices like it’s nothing. There was supposed to be some work happening and now I see nothing – I don’t wanna be surprised by workers blasting in the morning. Get it sorted out please, people need to be warned!

This construction notice on my street just vanished! I mean, how can they just take it down? There’s always a huge mess and I need to know when it'll be quiet for once. This city is nuts sometimes! Not everyone keeps track of these things, come on.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Structure - Outdoors. Fence
complaints: Hey, what's up with the fence on 5th Ave? It's like totally falling apart, like leaning all weird and I swear it’s gonna collapse one of these days. Someone gonna check that before it hurts someone? Just a thought.

So the fence around the park by my place is missing like half the slats? It's making the whole area look trashy and I don't let my kids play there anymore. Can we fix it or maybe just put up a sign that says 'oops, don't go near'?

Why is the fence around the playground so rusty and gross? It looks like it's been here since the dinosaurs and it makes me worry about my kid's safety. Seriously, what’s it gonna take to get a decent fence in there?
Umm, that fence at XYZ street looks like it’s been through a hurricane or something. I mean, who even checks on this stuff? It’s not just ugly, it’s a safety hazard! Let’s get this sorted, please.

label: Consumer Complaint. Garage or Parking Lot. Vehicle Damage
complaints: I parked in the garage on 5th ave and when I came back my bumper was dented! No note, no nothing! Can’t believe how careless people are! I need to know how to get this fixed and who’s gonna pay!

So I was at that lot on 34th and my car got scratched up by some careless driver, like srsly how hard is it to park? I didn’t even notice it till the next day, now I’m stuck with this ugly scratch! Totally unfair, smh.

You guys gotta do something about that parking garage near the mall, my car got hit and there’s no cameras or anything, how am I supposed to find out who did this? It's just frustrating, it's like you pay to park but end up with damage!

I parked in the garage on 10th street and my car got some damage overnight, probably from the guy next to me who couldn’t park straight, really? What’s the point of paying if my ride is gonna get ruined? So annoyed right now!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Controller. Down
complaints: The light at 42nd and 8th is totally broken, I swear I waited like 10 minutes to cross! Cars were just zooming by, someone is gonna get hit if this isn’t fixed ASAP!
Ugh there's a traffic light on my way to work that’s been out for days now, I almost got run over this morning! Can’t someone just put a sign or something until it gets fixed?
Yo, the traffic signal at Broadway and 34th is completely useless right now, it’s just blinking yellow and cars don’t know what to do, it’s chaos! Fix it already!
Driving down 5th Avenue and the signal at 51st is dead, why is it still down? There’s like a million people trying to cross and cars don’t know when to stop, this is ridiculous.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Grass/Weeds. Other
complaints: The park by my apartment is a total jungle now! I mean, I get that it’s fall and all but the grass hasn't been cut in ages, it’s taller than my kid! Feels like I’m walking through a swamp, c’mon how hard can it be to mow it once in a while?

I can't even let my dog play in the backyard anymore, the weeds are outta control! I swear it looks like a scene from Jumanji back there. Just cut the grass for crying out loud, it’s a yard not a rainforest! Ugh!

Heyyy, so I know maybe the city’s busy or whatever but the grass on my street is seriously looking like the Amazon rainforest. Like, can someone just, I dunno, use a weed whacker? It’s not that hard, right?

OMG, this park is such an eyesore now! The lawn is overgrown and there's weeds everywhere, I can't even see the path! I’m worried my kids might get lost in there! This needs to be fixed like, yesterday!

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Base Door/Cover Open. Location Type: Highway
complaints: Hey, the cover on the streetlight base on the highway is open and it's super dangerous! I swear someone could trip or worse, get hurt. Can someone fix this already?
Ummm, there’s a streetlight on the highway with its base cover just dangling there! Like, hello, it’s a hazard! Is anyone even looking at these things?
That streetlight by the on-ramp has its door wide open. Feels like an accident waiting to happen. Plus, it looks real messy out there, can ya get someone to close it? Thanks!
Why is there an open lamppost base on the highway? It’s not just an eyesore but also feels like a liability. Come on, this is New York, let’s get our act together!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Graffiti or Vandalism. Ball Field/Court
complaints: Yo, the local basketball court is a total mess! Like, can someone please clean up all the graffiti? It’s so bad I can barely see the paint on the backboard and it’s super discouraging to shoot hoops there with all that junk!

So I was at the park and the baseball diamond looks like someone used it for an art project... there’s graffiti ALL over the benches and the fences and honestly, it’s giving the place a bad vibe. Can we please get some help?

Look, I love our local park but the tennis courts have become a canvas for wannabe artists and it’s honestly ruining it for everyone. Can we get rid of the spray paint already?! It's like a big distraction when I’m just trying to enjoy a match.

Seriously, the field is covered in nonsense writing and drawings! I took my kids there to play and they kept asking about the weird symbols. Not cool! We need to clean this up before my kids think it’s normal to write on everything.

label: Sanitation Worker or Vehicle Complaint. Idling or Blocking Traffic. Garbage Truck
complaints: Hey, got this garbage truck just chilling outside my window for like an hour now, I can't even hear myself think! It’s just idling and making my whole apartment smell like a landfill, like seriously, what is the point of this?
So annoyed!!! Garbage truck parked right in front of my building, blocking the whole street. No one can get by, cars are honking, and it’s just sitting there making noise and fumes ugh.

Why is this garbage truck always blocking my driveway? I thought they had schedules or something but like, every time I wanna leave I have to wait for them to move and they take FOREVER. Can't they just park somewhere else?

These garbage trucks are so loud at like 5 AM, I get it they gotta do their job but could they be a little quieter? I swear I lose sleep every week because of this nonsense. Plus what’s with all the idling? Is that really necessary?

label: Plumbing. Toilet. Bowl Removed Or Missing
complaints: Hey, so my toilet is totally missing the bowl? Like, I can't even. Just a hole? That's not cool. Plumbers need to come fix this ASAP, I can't do this. Got two kids and a dog, and yeah, you know what I mean, right?

Um, seriously? My toilet bowl just vanished? I thought it was a prank or something but nope, just a empty base. Not what I signed up for when I moved here, man. I need someone to come ASAP or I'm gonna lose my mind!
This is so ridiculous, I go to use the bathroom and there’s just a toilet seat with NO BOWL. How does this happen? I have no idea! Who even removes a toilet bowl? This isn’t a construction site!

My toilet’s just chilling there without a bowl! Like, what am I supposed to do? I can’t even use it! I need help with this, like right now, or I’m gonna have to start using the neighbor's outhouse—if they even have one! Ugh!

label: Emergency Response Team (ERT). Lights From Parking Lot Shining On Building
complaints: Hey, can someone do something about those blinding lights from the parking lot? They shine right into my apartment and it’s like trying to sleep in a freaking stadium!
These bright lights from the lot next door are ridiculous! Can’t get any shut-eye at night, feels like a spotlight just on me. It’s super annoying!
I don’t know who thought it was a good idea to have those giant lights blasting all night but it is really impacting my sleep. I’m sleeping in the daytime because of them!
Ugh, why are the lights in the parking lot so bright?? My bedroom feels like a crime scene every night. Just want to sleep peacefully without feeling like I'm in a horror movie!

label: Consumer Complaint. Tobacco Sales. Unlicensed
complaints: I was at this bodega on 3rd Ave and they sold me a pack of cigs but didn't even check my ID! Like how are they allowed to do that?? Totally sketchy, feels like they don't even care about the law!
So I go into this corner store on 5th and there’s this guy just selling menthols like it’s no big deal, NO LICENSE or anything! I’m pretty sure that’s illegal I mean come on, what’s going on??

There’s this store near my place that sells tobacco but I don’t think they’re even licensed to sell it?? Like, I watched the guy just hand over smokes to a 16 year old the other day! Not okay! Something needs to be done about this ASAP!

Can someone please do something about those little shops on every corner? I walked past one yesterday and they were just handing out cigarillos to anyone who asked!! Super unprofessional, they need to get it together.

label: Appliance. Electric/Gas Range. No Stove Knob Covers
complaints: Hey I'm really upset that I've been looking for those stove knob covers everywhere and I can't find them! My toddler keeps messing with the stove and it's giving me anxiety. I can't cook without worrying! Ugh!
Can someone tell me why it's so hard to find stove knob covers in this city?? I have a little one who thinks the kitchen is a playground and I need those covers ASAP! What's the deal?!
So I tried to get stove knob covers at Target and they're all sold out?? Like seriously, how can parents keep their kids safe if the stores don’t even carry them?? This is ridiculous!

Why don’t they sell stove knob covers in more places? My baby keeps turning the knobs and I’m just freaking out!! I can’t cook dinner without worrying they will burn themselves or something! It's so frustrating.

label: Street Sign - Damaged. Street Cleaning - ASP
complaints: Hey can someone please do something about the street sign on 5th and 42nd??? It's so bent over I thought it was gonna fall on my car like, any second!
Ugh, why do I even bother parking on the street when the cleaning is always messed up? I got a ticket this morning and I swear the street wasn’t even swept!
The sign for no parking is broken and half hanging off, can’t believe the city doesn’t see this! I’ve been driving around and it’s causing so much confusion. Fix it already!
I live on 8th Ave and the street cleaning is a joke, my car got towed because of some nonsense about it being 'cleaning day' but I never saw a single street cleaner!

label: Damaged Tree. Branch or Limb Has Fallen Down. Park (Low Traffic Area)
complaints: There’s a big branch down in the park near 5th and 10th, like, someone could trip over it or worse, a kid could get hurt! Please send someone to clean it up ASAP!
Yo, there’s a huge tree limb just chillin on the ground in the park, it’s been days and it’s getting in the way! Can someone do something about this before it gets worse?
I was walking my dog and almost tripped over a fallen branch in the little park by our place. It's really messy and needs to be taken care of!
This tree in the park behind my building has a big branch that fell and it's just laying there. It’s been like this for a week and I don’t see anyone doing anything about it, please come get it.

label: Door/Window. Door To Dumbwaiter. Broken Or Open
complaints: The dumbwaiter door won’t close all the way and it’s been like this for days! I keep having to prop it shut with a box because I don’t want someone to get hurt or something fall out, it's super annoying!
Hey, can someone please fix the dumbwaiter door? It's just hanging open and it’s such a hazard for the little kids running around! I can’t deal with this right now, I got enough on my plate.
So the dumbwaiter door in my building is broken, like it doesn’t open at all anymore? I don’t know what to do, it’s just stuck and I can’t get my groceries up! Ugh, why is this place falling apart?

I’m really frustrated! The dumbwaiter door is always broken or left ajar, it's disgusting! My neighbor's cat got stuck in there last week, thank goodness I noticed before it got hurt! Please fix this!!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Ped Flasher. Operating Improperly
complaints: Yo, the pedestrian signal at 5th and Broadway is totally broken, it just flashes red for no reason, people are crossing like crazy and it’s super dangerous, fix it before someone gets hurt!
I just tried to cross on 42nd and 7th and the walk signal didn’t work at all, had to wait forever, like what’s the deal? This is New York, we can’t be waiting for a broken sign!
Every time I try to cross at 34th and 8th, the light doesn’t change properly! I pushed the button and waited like 10 minutes, that’s ridiculous! Can’t believe I almost got hit by a bike!
Hey, the walk signal at 23rd and 6th is a mess! It goes off too quick and doesn’t give enough time for people, I saw an old lady almost trip trying to rush across, this is so not cool.

label: Ferry Inquiry. Lost and Found
complaints: I lost my backpack on the ferry yesterday and it had my laptop and some personal stuff in it. Can you please help me find it? I'm freaking out!
Hey, I was on the Staten Island ferry last week, and I think I left my gray jacket on one of the seats. It’s really nice, and I kinda need it back! What should I do?
So I was on the ferry like 2 days ago and somehow left my bag with my favorite book and my water bottle. Can you let me know if it was turned in? Thanks!
I can’t believe I lost my phone on the ferry!! I had it in my pocket and now it’s gone, probably dropped somewhere. I don’t even have a spare, help!

label: Consumer Complaint. Other Store (Non-Food). Advertising False or Misleading
complaints: I bought this fancy air fryer from that big store on 42nd Street and it said it could make everything crispy and perfect but I'm telling you it just makes soggy potatoes!!! Now I feel like I was totally scammed and I can't even find the receipt!! Ugh!

So I ordered some sneakers online, paid extra for 'express shipping' and it took a week and a half to get here!!! What’s the point of paying if they’re not gonna deliver? I feel like I was just duped. That won’t happen again!

Just went to that new gadget shop in Brooklyn and they had this ad saying buy one get one free but when I went to pay they said it doesn’t apply to half the stuff in the store! Like, why put that on your sign then? It’s just misleading and totally infuriating!!

I saw this ad for a women's jacket that was supposed to be waterproof and I wore it in the rain last week and was soaked to the bone! What kind of joke is that? They shouldn’t be selling junk like this to people. I feel like I wasted my money!

label: Unsanitary Condition. Pests. Fleas
complaints: OMG I can't take it anymore! I think my apartment is infested with fleas, I literally feel them jumping on me every night, it's disgusting! I have pets but I can't even sleep without itching!

So, like, I found these tiny bugs everywhere in my carpet and I am freaking out! I vacuumed like a hundred times but they keep coming back. What do I even do? This is not how I imagined living in the city, ugh!

My landlord is such a jerk, I told him about the flea problem a week ago and he hasn’t done anything! I can't have visitors over cause it’s super embarrassing! Can someone help me deal with this? It’s ruining my life!

I saw a random flea jumping from my couch to my dog and it was the grossest thing ever, like why is this happening?? The whole place feels dirty now and I just wanna chill without being a buffet for bugs!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Snow or Ice. Path
complaints: The sidewalk outside my building is a total ice rink!! I almost slipped and fell while taking my dog out! Why hasn’t anyone salted or cleared it? It’s been days!!

I can’t believe the mess on my block after this snowstorm. No one has cleared the sidewalks and it’s just a disaster. People are walking in the street! It’s so unsafe, c’mon, we pay taxes for this, right?
What is up with the neglect on my street? The snow piled up for days, and no one is taking care of it. I have to walk my kids to school and it’s just super dangerous with all this ice! Ugh!
Seriously, I’ve been waiting for someone to clear the path outside my building. It’s a legit hazard. My elderly neighbor almost fell last night! This is ridiculous, get it together, please!

label: Broken Parking Meter. Coin or Card Did Not Register. Payment by Cash
complaints: I tried to pay at the meter on 5th Ave and it ate my quarters! Like, seriously, I put in 3 and nothing happened! Do I just lose my money now?
So I'm at this parking meter and I put in a $1 bill, it just spit it back at me like I’m trying to bribe it or something! What am I supposed to do?
Hey, I was trying to park on 34th and the meter wouldn’t take my card or cash, it just stared at me like I was dumb! I had to leave and now I’m super late, ugh!
This stupid meter by my apartment isn’t working, I put in $5 and it didn’t register, so now I’m standing in the cold trying to figure out what to do! Fix it already!

label: Sanitation Worker or Vehicle Complaint. Inappropriate Behavior. Enforcement Agent
complaints: I was walking my dog near Central Park and saw one of your sanitation workers just standing around chatting and not doing their job!! I mean c'mon, I pay taxes and expect them to actually clean the streets, not hang out like they're on break. What’s the point??

So I don’t know if this is a common thing but I seen a trash truck today and the driver was being super rude to people trying to get past! Like, dude, you're just picking up garbage, acting like he's king of the block or something. Can someone talk to them?

I don’t wanna cause trouble but I saw a sanitation worker throw trash on the ground while they were picking up!!! Like, what the heck? I know the streets are dirty enough already without them contributing to the mess! They should be setting an example, right?

OMG, there was a sanitation guy who just totally ignored a lady asking for help finding her lost dog, like come on, that's just rude. I get he's working but a little kindness wouldn’t hurt! Can they get some training on public interaction or something?

label: Safety. Fire Escape. Drop Ladder Missing Or Broken
complaints: Hey, I gotta say this is really messed up but my fire escape ladder is missing! Like how am I supposed to get out in an emergency? I can't believe nobody has fixed this, it’s been weeks!

So there’s this broken drop ladder on my fire escape, and I noticed it yesterday when I was trying to check if my plants were getting enough sun. Like honestly, if there’s a fire one day and I can’t get down, that’s just crazy!

Ugh, my fire escape ladder is totally broken - just sitting there rusted and useless! What’s the point of having a fire escape if I can’t even use it? It’s dangerous, I’m stressed out just thinking about it!
Yo, I don’t even know who’s in charge of this but my fire escape ladder is flat out missing, gone like it never existed. I live on the 5th floor and it’s just ridiculous, I feel trapped up here!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Aps. Down
complaints: hey whats up with the crossing signals at 5th and 34th?? they don’t make no sounds anymore and it’s like a free for all out there, people just walkin like they own the street, what if someone gets hit??
I just wanna cross the street safely but the APS at 30th and 6th is out again, it’s seriously frustrating, it’s like they never fix it, come on!!
that blind corner of 42nd st and broadway is a mess, the talking signals are off and I feel like I'm risking my life everytime I cross, some fix it already!
Seriously, the APS at 14th and 8th has been broken for weeks! I’m tired of guessing if it’s safe to cross, can someone please get it together or at least give us a heads up?

label: Street Light Condition. Multiple Street Lights Out. Location Type: Highway
complaints: Yo, what is up with all these street lights on the highway being out?? It's super dark and dangerous, like I can barely see anything! Fix this, please!
I was driving home on the FDR last night and half the lights were OFF! Like, do you want us to crash? It’s so sketchy!
Can someone please check the street lights on the highway? It’s like a black hole out there, I had to squint to see the road!
Seriously, why are the lights out on the highway in some spots? It's a nightmare at night, feels like I’m in a horror movie trying to get home. Just fix it already!

label: Mold. Public Complaint - Comm Location
complaints: There’s a weird smell in the hallway of my apartment building, like something died, but my friend says it’s mold. I don’t know how to deal with it, but I’m worried it’s gonna make me sick or somethin. Can someone check it out?

I’ve got this black stuff growing on the walls of my bathroom and it’s really freaking me out! I clean it but it comes back like it’s haunting me! My landlord isn’t answering, so can someone look into this mold situation? I’ve got kids and I don't want them breathing that in!

OMG, why does my kitchen always feel damp?? I just found mold on my bread, and I’m freaking out! My pantry smells musty and it can’t be healthy! I told my landlord like 5 times, but nothing gets done! What’s the hold-up? I just want to cook without worrying!

So, there’s mold in my building and it’s getting worse, like I can see it creeping into my closet too! I literally can’t even wear my nice clothes now. This is not okay, can someone do something? I pay enough rent for this and it’s disgusting!!!

label: Street Sign - Dangling. St Name - Over Intersection
complaints: Hey, that sign at the corner of 5th and Main is hanging by a thread! Like it could fall and hit someone. It's super dangerous, fix it already!
The street sign at Over Intersection is all bent and drooping, you can barely read it! I thought I was lost cause I couldn’t tell where I was going!
Umm, there’s a sign at the intersection that’s almost touching the ground? Just thought you should know before someone walks into it or something. Like, come on!
Seriously, the street sign over on 6th and 7th is hanging down way too low. I have to dodge it every time I walk by, and I can’t even read the name. Can you just make it be straight again?

label: Lost Property. Bag/Wallet. Other
complaints: I lost my backpack on the subway last night, like I can’t even remember what stop I got off at 😩 It had my laptop and some important stuff in it, ugh, can someone help me please?

So I dropped my wallet somewhere in SoHo, I swear I had it when I got into that tiny coffee shop, but when I left it was gone! It’s got my ID and my credit cards, which is just great. Please tell me someone found it!

Hey! I can’t believe this but I think I left my bag on the bus 6 hours ago, it was one of those black totes with the Hawaiian print. I had my lunch in there and some really important papers! If anyone sees it, omg please let me know!

I lost my phone at the park, I know I shouldn’t have been texting while walking but I can’t believe I just left it there! I was at the Bethesda Fountain, I hope it’s still there and hasn’t been picked up by some random person!

label: Illegal Animal Kept as Pet. Rooster
complaints: There’s a rooster living next door and it’s crowing at all hours! I’m telling you I haven’t slept a wink since this thing showed up. It’s like a freaking alarm clock but way more annoying! Can someone please do something?
I’m pretty sure my neighbor is keeping a rooster like it’s a pet. It’s not a dog! This is NYC, not a farm! It started crowing at 5 AM and I can’t take it anymore!
Can you believe it? My next-door neighbor has a rooster! I thought I was imagining things at first – but no, I’m awake at the crack of dawn to this damn bird making noise. This is ridiculous!

I just moved to the city for peace and quiet and now there’s this rooster in the backyard next door making a racket every morning. I mean c’mon! Who even has a rooster in Brooklyn? What is this, 1800s?

label: Drinking. After Hours - Licensed Est
complaints: Yo there's this bar on 4th street that's blasting music like there's no tomorrow and it's past 2am. I can hear the bass through my window like I'm at a concert, it's ridiculous. Can't get a wink of sleep, smh.

Why are these bars allowed to stay open so late in my neighborhood? It's 3am and people are yelling and fighting outside, I just want some peace and quiet! Plus it's freezing out here so I can't even shut my window. What's wrong with this city?

This place down the block from me has been having these loud parties every weekend and it's always packed. I'm talking about people singing in the streets, cars honking, can't even hear myself think! I thought they were supposed to stop serving after hours?

Just want to complain about the loud noise from that pub on the corner. It’s like a nightclub every night, and I live above it. So over hearing those drunk fools yelling at each other, I got work in the mornin'!!

label: Illegal Posting. Sticker or Decal. Other
complaints: There's this annoying sticker on the lamppost outside my building that says something about a comedy show, it's been there forever and it's just peeling and looks trashy, makes the neighborhood feel like a dump, can someone please take it down?

Why do people keep putting these dumb flyers everywhere? I can't walk down the block without seeing some crumby ad for a psychic or a dance class, it's like a bad collage of clutter! Get this garbage off our streets!

Saw a sticker promoting some weird event on my mailbox and it ain't coming off, now it looks all messed up and ugly, can we get some of these people to clean up their mess and stop sticking stuff everywhere?

There’s a huge poster for some concert on my building and it’s all torn up so it just looks like a piece of trash, what’s wrong with these people? Can we ask them to stop putting that junk up like they own the place?

label: Curb Condition. Defacement. Curb Cut
complaints: Yo, the curb outside my building on 5th Ave is totally messed up, like it’s crumbling and cracked everywhere, it’s just a dangerous spot for everyone, especially for my grandma who can’t walk well, can someone fix this ASAP?

I swear the curb on 35th and Park has been like this forever, it’s all chipped and broken, people trip over it all the time, last week I almost fell flat on my face, do we need someone to get hurt before it gets fixed?

Listen, I live on East 10th and the curb cut is so bad it’s like a mini obstacle course, I get that there’s construction but c’mon, at least keep the curb in one piece for the folks who are trying to get by with strollers and wheelchairs!

Ugh, the curb out in front of my building is a disaster, it's crumbling and it looks like it hasn't been touched in years. I mean, is it too much to ask for a decent curb? It’s embarrassing and it could really hurt someone.

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Food Source/Protection. Food Contaminated
complaints: I got a hot dog from the cart on the corner of 42nd and 8th and it had this weird taste, like it went bad or something. Seriously, I thought I was gonna hurl!
Just bought some tacos from that food truck yesterday and there was a fly in the salsa! Like, gross right? I can't believe I actually just ate that, never going back!

I was at the park and got a smoothie from that vendor. When I took a sip there were chunks in it, and honestly I don’t even wanna know what they were. Someone needs to check these guys out, it’s disgusting!

So I ordered some pad thai from this vendor by the subway and it tasted off, like really off. Can't believe I paid for that cause now I'm feeling sick. Pls do something about these street food places, it’s not safe!

label: Commercial Disposal Complaint. Waste Left in Front of Residence
complaints: There's a pile of trash left outside my building for days now, it smells awful like rotten food and it's attracting rats. Why can't these businesses keep their waste to themselves?!
I just got home from work and there’s a big ol' stack of cardboard boxes from that deli on the corner right in front of my door, it’s so annoying! Can't they figure out when to take this stuff away?
Please do something about the garbage bins outside the bodega. They’re overflowing and litter is everywhere, it’s such an eyesore, and I have to walk past it every single day. Gross!
Ugh! That new cafe keeps putting their trash out too early, like it's just sitting there all stinky and making the whole block look bad. It's like no one respects the neighborhood anymore!

label: Damaged Tree. Tree Trunk Split
complaints: There's a HUGE tree in front of my building and the trunk is all split, like it's gonna fall any minute! I got kids playing around here, please do something before it crushes someone!
I noticed that the tree outside my window is seriously messed up, the trunk is split in half and I'm worried it could fall on my car. Can anyone come check it out? Thanks!
Yo, the tree on 5th Ave is all split up! It looks like it’s about to break and fall over, like seriously, it’s gonna hurt someone or smash a car. Can you send someone to look at it plz?
This tree out front is not lookin good! The trunk is split and I swear it’s leaning more every day. Do I need to take a video for you to believe me? Let’s fix this before it’s too late!

label: LinkNYC. Damaged/Defective
complaints: The LinkNYC kiosk on 5th and 42nd is totally busted, I tapped the screen a million times and nothing happens, super frustrating when you need directions!
Why is the internet at the LinkNYC by my apartment so slow? I tried using it to look up a menu and it took forever, might as well just walk to the restaurant!
The kiosk on Broadway by the corner store has a cracked screen and it's all glitchy, it just keeps flashing and I can’t even get a good signal. Fix it already!
So annoyed that the LinkNYC at 8th Ave and 23rd St isn't working, I needed to send an email ASAP and I ended up just using my phone data which is running out. Ugh!

label: Drinking. Underage - Licensed Est
complaints: I was just walking down 3rd Ave and saw a bunch of kids lookin like they were like 16 or somethin just chugging beers right outside a bar. This is crazy, like where are the adults?
Can someone please do something about the bar on 12th St? I keep seein like these teenagers hangin around and sneakin in to drink, it ain't right, it was super obvious last night!

So I was at this party last weekend and I swear there were underage kids everywhere, drinkin and gettin rowdy like nobody cared! It's a mess, felt dangerous, and just gross to witness. Something's gotta change!

I think the place on 5th Ave is servin drinks to minors, I saw a couple of guys that looked like they were barely in high school sittin at the bar with beers—what is up with that? This is so irresponsible!

label: Obstruction. Merchandise. Street
complaints: There's a bunch of carts blocking the sidewalk on 42nd street, like I can't even walk past without squeezing through. Not cool, man. It's a busy area, and I just tripped over some boxes. Fix this!

Why are there so many tables with junk on them taking up the whole street near the park? I'm just trying to get to work and there's literally no space to walk without bumping into stuff, it’s ridiculous!
Every day I walk past this thrift shop on Broadway and they pile all their stuff on the sidewalk! I swear it's getting worse. Just yesterday I saw a lady trip over a mannequin. Please make it stop!

Can someone please tell those street vendors to clean up their mess? They leave all their stuff everywhere on 8th Ave, and it makes it such a pain to walk by. I don’t need to sidestep crates while holding my coffee, it’s infuriating!

label: Consumer Complaint. Landlord or Real Estate Agent. Broker Fee Charged
complaints: I just moved in and my landlord hit me with this huge broker fee that I was totally not expecting! Like, why is this even a thing?? I feel cheated. I didn’t even get a rundown on how everything works!
Why did I have to pay a broker fee if my apartment was already listed as no fee? This is so unfair, I feel like I got scammed, and who even reads the fine print??
Charging me a broker fee when I was told I wouldn't have to pay one is so messed up, I'm so frustrated! I feel like crying, I just wanted a nice place to live and this is ridiculous!
Just moved to the city and why is everyone charging these ridiculous broker fees? It feels like a money grab! I’m just trying to find a decent apartment, not get swindled!

label: Consumer Complaint. Garage or Parking Lot. Overcapacity
complaints: I parked my car in the garage on 22nd and they told me it was full!!! How can you run a parking garage when there’s no parking? I had to park like 5 blocks away in a street spot and it’s so inconvenient, fix your capacity!!
This lot is a joke! I’m here trying to find a spot after driving for 30 minutes and there's literally no room left. People are double-parking, someone will smash my car if this keeps up!
Why is it every time I come to this parking garage it’s full?? It’s infuriating I can’t ever find a place to park my car, I feel like I’m on a wild goose chase around the neighborhood!
I just want to know why they keep selling more spots when they can’t even fit the cars they already have! I pay good money to park here and I’m tired of circling around trying to find a spot!

label: Cannabis Retailer. Suspicious Activity
complaints: So there's this store on 8th ave, it looks like a legit business but they sell weed out the back. No signs or anything, just shady people hanging out looking around and trying to act normal. I feel like something's off, like do the cops even know?

I live right around the corner from that new spot, you know the one with the green lights? I swear they're doing somethin' illegal at night. Like, why is there a line of people at 2am?? It’s getting kinda sketchy out here, man. Can someone check it out?

Ugh! I swear these folks down the block are just asking for trouble. I see a crowd outside their shop all the time, some of those people look really high and there’s a whole lotta whispering going on. It ain't right, I can’t even walk past without feeling weird about it!

Yo, can we talk about that place on Broadway? Like, why are there always cars double parked and people exchanging stuff in the alley? It’s not even trying to be discreet, and I got kids! Just feels wrong, can someone look into it?

label: Illegal Posting. Flyer or Handbill. Street Light
complaints: Why are there flyers taped all over the lampposts on my block?? It looks like a complete dump and I can’t even see the street light at night because of all this junk! Please clean this up, it’s embarrassing!

I’m tired of walking down my street and seeing random flyers shoved on every pole! It’s ugly and makes my neighborhood look trashy. Can someone please do something about this because it’s getting out of hand!!
There’s a million of those annoying handbills stuck on every light post around here, I can’t walk 5 steps without seeing one. Who even puts these up anyway?? It’s so unnecessary!
Ugh, this is so frustrating! I can’t believe how many flyers I have to dodge on my way to work. Like, show some respect for our neighborhood! It’s a mess and I want it gone.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Underground. Need Utility Verify
complaints: Okay so like the traffic light at 5th and 34th is totally out and I've almost been hit 3 times trying to cross! I don’t wanna be a pancake! Can someone please fix this ASAP?

Seriously, what’s the deal with the traffic signal on Broadway? It’s just blinking yellow for ages now! It’s chaos out there, cars don’t know what to do and I saw a guy almost wreck his bike because of it! Get it together!

The light at 72nd and Amsterdam is messed up! It’s stuck on red and no cars are coming, I swear I sat there forever. Someone needs to check it, my patience is running thin and I’m gonna be late for work!

I can’t believe how long that traffic signal has been out on 42nd St! Like, it was yellow when I got there and now it’s just dead. Why is it always so hard for them to fix these things? I don't wanna be the one to stop all the cars... fix it already!

label: Unsanitary Animal Pvt Property. Other Animal
complaints: Yo, there’s this crazy lady down the block who just leaves her dog poop all over the sidewalk. It’s disgusting and smells so bad! Like, can she not see it or what? There’s a park two blocks over for a reason!

Someone really needs to do something about this cat colony behind my building. They keep fighting and making these horrible noises at all hours, and I’m scared they’re gonna bring fleas into my apartment! Not cool!

My neighbor has like 10 cats, and they’re all over my yard, digging in the garden and leaving hair everywhere. I can’t even enjoy my coffee out there anymore! Something needs to be done about this, it’s getting out of hand.

There’s this abandoned dog that keeps hanging around the trash cans near my building. It looks really sick and is super skittish but I can’t just ignore it. It’s heart breaking to watch, can someone come and deal with this, please?

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Signal Head. Hanging
complaints: Hey, that traffic light on the corner of 42nd and 8th is hanging by a thread, like seriously, it’s gonna fall any minute! Fix it before someone gets hurt!
I was driving down Broadway today and I swear the traffic light at 55th is just dangling, all crooked and stuff, could barely see it. It's dangerous!
Ugh! That light at 3rd Avenue and 14th Street is hanging so low, I almost hit it! How is that even allowed? Can someone please get up there and fix it?!
Why is the traffic signal at 7th and 34th all skewed and hanging? It looks like a kid put it up or something, what a mess!

label: Taxi Complaint. Driver Complaint - Non Passenger. Unsafe Driving - Non-Passenger
complaints: I just saw this yellow cab swerving all over the road like it was in a race or something. The driver was texting for sure, I mean c'mon! Can we not have our lives put in danger just to save a minute?
There was this cab cuttin me off on 42nd St, I'm just trying to get home and this dude goes into my lane without signaling! Almost caused an accident, like, how do they have a license?
I was walking home and almost got hit by a taxi that completely ignored the red light at 5th Ave. This happens all the time, these drivers think they own the road!
I can't believe how reckless this taxi driver was today! He was speeding down the street and nearly knocked over a cyclist. Who’s keeping tabs on these guys? It's outrageous!

label: Street Light Condition. Flood Light Lamp Out. Location Type: Intersection
complaints: Hey, can someone please fix the street light at 5th and Elm? It's been out for weeks and it's super dark at night! I feel like I’m walking through a horror movie every time I cross there!
The flood light at Main and 2nd is totally out! It’s like walking in a cave, and I almost tripped over a pothole the other night. Someone needs to do something about this ASAP!
I really need to complain about the street light situation at the corner of Broadway and 42nd. That light has been dead for ages! Can’t even see my phone when I’m waiting for the bus!
Why is the street light at 8th and 45th still not working? It’s pitch black over there, feels unsafe, and I have to take another route just to avoid it. This is ridiculous!

label: Street Condition. Line/Marking - After Repaving
complaints: Yo, the lines on 5th Ave are totally messed up after that repaving. I can't even see where to cross safely!
This is ridiculous, they just repaved my street and now the lines are super faded. Honestly, what were they thinking?
I can't believe how hard it is to see the lane markings on Main St. It's like they forgot to paint them! Cars are swerving all over the place. Get it together!
So they repaved my block but forgot to put the lines back on? I almost got hit trying to figure out where the hell I'm supposed to be. Fix it ASAP!

label: Sanitation Worker or Vehicle Complaint. Noise. Garbage Truck
complaints: Why is that garbage truck always banging around at 6 AM?? I get it’s a city and all but some of us are actually trying to sleep, it’s not fair!!
Every week the truck comes at the most ridiculous hour, like 5:30 AM, I’m up all night for work and when they come I can’t even hear myself think!! Ugh, so annoying!!
Seriously, is there any way to change the garbage truck schedule? Last night it was so loud I thought they were lifting a car! I swear it threw off my whole day!

I don’t know who designs the garbage route but they need to be fired! The truck just stands there for ages revving its engine like, can you not?! I have to go to work and I can’t deal with this every week!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Pedestrian Signal. Out
complaints: Hey so the walk signal at 5th and Main is totally broken and it’s been like that for days! People are just crossing like idiots and it’s super dangerous, especially during rush hour!

I don’t know who’s in charge of the lights over at 42nd street but the pedestrian signal isn’t working at all! I almost got hit by a taxi because of it!!! Can someone please fix this before someone really gets hurt?
There’s a pedestrian signal out at 8th Ave and 34th St and it’s driving me nuts! It’s like a game of Frogger trying to cross there. Can’t believe it’s still not fixed after a week!
Ugh, the walk light at Broadway and 59th is just dead. Like come on, it’s a busy intersection! I feel like I’m playing chicken with cars every time I cross. This is ridiculous, just fix it already!

label: Safety. Sprinkler. System Broken Or Missing
complaints: I just moved into my apartment and there’s no sprinkler system in the hallway! Like, how is that even legal?? What if there’s a fire? I’m seriously freaked out about this!

Okay so I was in the building the other day and noticed the sprinklers were just... not working? There’s literally a sign saying they’re supposed to be there but I just see empty spots. Can someone please look into this ASAP?
I don’t understand how the fire code allows my building to have a completely broken sprinkler system. I mean, come on! What if there’s a fire? This is ridiculous and extremely unsafe.  MOVE ON THIS!

I’m really concerned about the safety in my building. No sprinklers in the basement and I heard from the neighbors that they haven't worked for ages. What’s going on? Do we have to wait for a disaster before anyone cares?

label: Food Establishment. Food Worker Hygiene. Personal Hygiene Inadequate
complaints: I was at this deli on 2nd and 10th and the guy handling my sandwich had grease stains all over his apron and was sneezing without covering his mouth! Like, hello, can we have some basic hygiene please?
So I just left that taco truck on Broadway and the guy who made my food didn’t even wash his hands after touching his face! I mean, come on! How hard is it to keep it clean?

I can't believe it but the guy at the pizza place I go to literally had gooey stuff on his hands while making my slice. It was disgusting. I almost lost my appetite and I know I’m not the only one who noticed!

I went to this café and the barista was not wearing gloves while making my drink and like, I saw him touch money before that! Just gross and really not okay, especially in 2023 with everything going on. Fix it, please!

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Food Worker Activity. Bare Hands in Contact w/Food
complaints: I’m eating at this food cart on 34th St and the guy is making my hot dog with NO gloves how is this even allowed?? I can't even believe what I'm seeing, like what if he just touched something gross?!
So I just saw a vendor slapping together tacos with his bare hands and no gloves and I was like, OMG, does he even wash his hands?? Like, that’s just disgusting, who wants to eat that?
There’s this guy selling pretzels in Central Park and he’s handling the dough and then grabbing cash, like, ew! How does no one stop him??? I’m not eating there, that’s for sure.

Honestly, I love street food but these vendors need to wear gloves or something! I just walked past one where the guy had stuff all over his hands and was making burgers – gross! Why is there no one checking on these folks?

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Bike Signal. Out
complaints: Yo, the bike signal on 6th Ave and 23rd St is just totally not working! It’s like it doesn’t even exist, I had to stop and wait for a car to go before I felt safe crossing. This is so frustrating!
I ride my bike to work every day and the light for bikes on Park Ave is out AGAIN! This makes it super dangerous for me and other cyclists, can someone please fix it?
Why is the bike signal at 14th and 6th always broken? I swear it hasn’t worked in weeks and I almost got hit the other day because cars don’t even see us trying to cross. Get it together!
I don’t know who’s in charge of the traffic lights, but the bike signal at Broadway and Houston is broken. I’m tired of almost getting run over because I can’t tell when it's my turn!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. LED Pedestrian Unit. Out
complaints: Hey, I’m at 5th and 42nd and the walk signal is totally out!!! It’s super dangerous crossing there, I almost got hit by a bus! Plz fix this ASAP!
Could you please fix the pedestrian light at the corner of 1st Ave and 82nd St? It’s been dead for days and I don’t wanna play Frogger every time I cross!
Ugh, the walk sign at 8th and Washington is broken. I’ve seen people just waiting and then risking their lives trying to cross when it’s not safe!
Why is the pedestrian signal at 34th and Park still not working?! It’s been like this for a week and it’s a nightmare trying to get across the street with all the crazy traffic! Fix it already!

label: Food Establishment. Kitchen/Food Prep Area. Food Prep Area Dirty
complaints: Yo, the kitchen at that deli on 3rd Ave is a mess! I swear I saw like three different kinds of mold growing on the counters – totally disgusting! They really gotta do better or I’m gonna stop going there for my sandwiches.

I just went to this bakery on 5th and the prep area behind the counter looked so dirty! Floors were covered in flour and who knows what else. I can't believe they’re baking bread back there! Someone needs to clean that up ASAP!

Seriously, this restaurant on 10th St is the worst. I walked past and the kitchen area was just filthy, trash everywhere, and I even saw a rat run out of there! How can they serve food when it looks like that?
I’m just saying, I love that taco place but the food prep area is seriously gross. I saw the staff drop some food on the floor and just pick it up and serve it. Like, c'mon guys, have some standards!

label: Sidewalk Condition. Broken Sidewalk. Overpass/Traffic Median
complaints: The sidewalk on 5th Ave by the bodega is so messed up, I almost tripped over the cracks yesterday! Like, can’t anyone fix that? It’s been broken for ages and it’s really dangerous!

Hey! The sidewalk around the subway entrance on 42nd Street is a disaster, I swear I saw someone fall there last week. It needs to be fixed, I can’t deal with dodging the holes while trying to catch my train!
Ugh, the pavement near the overpass on 14th is so uneven, I feel like I’m in an obstacle course just trying to get to the bus stop. Seriously, it’s ridiculous, can you get that fixed already?

I don’t know who to tell this but the sidewalk by the park is like a minefield. The concrete is all cracked and raised, my neighbor almost broke her ankle and I’m tired of watching people dodge the bad spots. Do something!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Structure - Indoors. Other
complaints: I woke up this morning and the heat is not on in my apartment, it’s freezing!! I don’t know how I’m supposed to work from home in these conditions, it’s ridiculous!
I can’t take it anymore, there’s a smell coming from the bathroom, I think it’s the pipes or something, it’s honestly making me feel sick!
The elevator in my building has been out of order for like a week now, I live on the 5th floor with groceries and it’s a nightmare!
I’m seriously about to lose it! There’s a leak in the ceiling of my kitchen and it’s getting worse, water is dripping and I can’t keep fixing it myself. PLEASE send someone ASAP!

label: Animal-Abuse. No Shelter. Dog
complaints: I just saw this poor dog tied up outside in this freezing cold for hours. Like, are we seriously just gonna let this happen? Have some compassion for the animals people!
Yo, there’s this dog in my building that the owner never takes out, I’m talking days at a time, just barking and whining like crazy. It can’t be healthy for the poor thing!! I’m worried
There’s this stray dog roaming around my street and it looks real sick. I don’t know what to do but I can’t just leave it there, someone has to help it! It's just laying there looking so sad, ugh!
My neighbor’s dog is seriously neglected, like no food, no water, it's just sad looking and I can hear it crying a lot. Ugh, it just breaks my heart, can’t someone please check on it?

label: Drinking Water. Illness Caused by Drinking Water
complaints: I swear the water coming outta my faucet is making me sick, like I have a constant stomachache since I started drinking it. I don’t know if there’s something in it but it’s def not right, can someone check it out?

My water tastes funny and smells like a wet dog or somethin’! I’ve been sick for days and I’m pretty sure it’s the tap water. I’m drinking bottled now but ugh, who can afford that? This is ridiculous!
I’ve had such bad headaches and nausea since I started using my sink water for cooking and drinking. I thought it was just me but my roommate feels it too! Please, someone help us, this is NOT okay!
Listen, I’m drinking water to stay healthy and my water tastes like metal or rust or whatever. I don’t know what’s in it but my stomach is a mess and I can’t keep doing this, it’s seriously gross!

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Knocked Down. Location Type: Intersection
complaints: Yo, the street light at 5th and Main is totally down! Like, how are we supposed to see where we're going? It’s pitch black at night, and I swear I almost got hit by a bike last night because of it! Ugh!
I can’t believe this! There’s a knocked-down lamppost at the corner of 8th and Broadway. It’s been laying there for days now. I’m worried it’s gonna cause an accident, doesn’t anyone care?
Seriously, the light at 10th and Park is just gone. Like, laying on the ground. It’s super dark and creepy at night, I’m tired of feeling unsafe walking home. Someone needs to fix this ASAP!

The lamp post at the intersection of 3rd Ave and 12th St is out of commission! It's been down for like a week and it’s dangerous all these cars zooming by without any light. Can someone please do something about it?

complaints: So I called this tow company to get my car unstuck and they charged me like 300 bucks just to pull it out! Are you kidding me?! I could've bought a new tire for that!
Got my car towed by those crooks and they took me for a ride literally and financially! They charged me double what they said on the phone! How is that even legal?!

There’s this sign at Elm St and Maple that’s been dangling like a bad haircut for over a week now. Can we get some maintenance out here? It looks ridiculous!

complaints: I just ordered from this new Italian place and they charged me for two entrees but I only got one! Can't even get anyone on the phone to fix it! Ugh, sooo frustrating!

Last night I got takeout from that Thai spot on 2nd Ave and they forgot to charge me for one of my dishes, but I wanted to pay! Now I feel guilty and like I’m gonna have bad karma or something. They should’ve just handed me a receipt! What if the IRS calls?

I visited that taco truck by the park and paid in cash but no receipt. I hope I don’t end up regretting it later. What if they come back and say I didn’t pay? Just give me the damn receipt, it’s not hard, right?

complaints: Yo, the street light at 5th and Broadway is totally gone!! Like, how are we supposed to see anything at night? It’s pitch black, and it’s super dangerous!
