How come the light by the corner of 10th and 8th is missing? No light means no safety, I saw like three sketchy characters hoverin' around last night! Get it together!
I can’t believe there’s no street light at Smith and Baltic. It’s super dark and spooky at night. I’m tired of dodging cars and tripping over stuff while walking back from work!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Post. Missing
complaints: Hey, there's a traffic light missing at the corner of 5th and 23rd! I almost got hit crossing the street, like, seriously, it’s really dangerous! Please fix it ASAP!
So I’m trying to cross at that intersection by the deli on 3rd Ave and I swear there’s no traffic light. Cars just zoom by and it’s super scary! Can someone do something about this?
Can you believe it? There’s no traffic signal at the intersection of 4th and 12th! It’s chaos out here, people just don’t stop, it’s like a game of Frogger trying to cross. Like, help?

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Missing. Location Type: Intersection
complaints: Yo! There's a lamppost missing at the intersection of 5th and Main, it's super dark there at night, feels like I'm walking in a horror movie. Can someone fix this before someone trips and falls?
how is there a lamppost just...not there?? it's pitch black at the corner of 8th and 2nd, I always have to walk my dog in the dark, it's sketchy. Please do something about it!
I don’t understand how you can have a busy intersection with no streetlight! 7th Ave and 42nd St is a disaster waiting to happen, fix this before we have an accident!
There used to be a lamp at the corner of 10th and Broadway but it disappeared?? like poof! Now it’s super shady and dangerous especially for the kids after school. Can someone replace it?

label: Consumer Complaint. Drug Store or Pharmacy. Goods or Services Not Delivered
complaints: I ordered some vitamins like over a week ago and they said it’d be here in three days but nothing!! I’m running out and I just need them already!! What's going on??

Why is it so hard to get my meds delivered?! I’m sick of calling and they keep saying it’s on backorder, I don’t gotta time to play games, I need my stuff NOW!
I ordered some allergy meds and they promised delivery for today but guess what? No delivery AND no one answers the phone to talk to me!!! I’m getting really frustrated here.

label: Indoor Air Quality. Unsafe Mold Cleanup
complaints: So there's this mold in my bathroom and it's spreading like crazy. I clean it and it comes back in like a week or less! I can't even breathe in there and it's driving me insane. What am I supposed to do?

I'm telling you, my apartment smells like a damp basement, and I can SEE mold on the walls! I've tried all the sprays and bleach and nothing works. I'm worried about getting sick, and I just had a baby! Please help us here!

I thought mold was supposed to be a big deal, like health issues or whatever, but my landlord just keeps saying to 'air it out.' UGH! How about he actually does something about the black stuff on the ceiling?! It’s so disgusting and it’s not just me, my roommate’s getting sick too!

I found mold under the kitchen sink and it's making me feel nauseous. I’m a renter and my landlord has been ghosting me for TWO WEEKS. I don’t know what to do, I’ve got a family to take care of and I can’t have this stuff around us!

label: Plumbing. Radiator. Missing Or Removed
complaints: Hey, so my radiator is MIA, like completely gone! It’s freezing in here and I don’t even know where to start looking! Can someone please help?!
Ugh, why do I pay so much rent for a place with NO HEAT? My radiator was just taken out or something and I’m shivering! This is NOT okay for a ‘luxury’ building!
So I’ve been living without a radiator for weeks now, I thought it was just broken but then I saw the empty space! Is this normal? It’s like living in a meat locker! Help!
Something’s very wrong, my radiator is totally not here and it’s making the apartment like an ice box. Can someone come check this out ASAP? Really not fun!

label: Consumer Complaint. Landlord or Real Estate Agent. Broker Fee Listed
complaints: I just saw an apartment listing and I swear they are charging a broker fee that is like 20% of a year’s rent like are you kidding me what is this they should be sued or somethin!

So I found this great place and the broker says there’s a fee which is ridiculous, like I can’t afford to pay an extra month’s rent just for some middle man to get a cut, this whole thing is so frustrating!

Why are these brokers allowed to charge such high fees? I mean c'mon, it’s not like they do much for it. Just found another listing with a fee, totally turned me off, just wanna find a place without being ripped off!

label: Consumer Complaint. Clothing, Shoe, or Accessories Store. Advertising False or Misleading
complaints: I bought this jacket from a place in Soho that said it was genuine leather but turns out it’s some cheap plastic knockoff. I’m super disappointed and feel ripped off, like how can they sleep at night selling this garbage?
So I saw an ad for this store claiming a big sale, but when I got there, nothing was discounted! It was like a bait and switch. What a waste of my time, I could’ve been getting brunch instead!

I ordered shoes online from this store that said they were 'limited edition' but they sent me a pair that looked like they were on clearance. Seriously? Feeling like I got scammed over here, really not cool!

Went to this trendy place that had a big sign saying 50% off EVERYTHING. Of course it didn't include the stuff I wanted. I mean come on, what’s the point of false advertising if you’re just gonna play with people’s hopes like that?

label: Animal in a Park. Injured Wildlife. Bird
complaints: I was in Central Park today and saw a bird that looked hurt, it was just sitting there and not moving! It’s so sad, can someone please help it?
There’s a pigeon in the park by the fountain that can’t fly and it looks like it hurt its wing! I can’t just sit here and do nothing, it needs help ASAP!!!
I saw a little sparrow in the grass at Washington Square Park, it was fluttering around like it was in pain or something. Can someone come take a look?
Why is there a hurt bird in Prospect Park and no one is doing anything about it? It's just sitting there and I feel so bad, I don't know what to do but I can't just leave it!

label: General Construction/Plumbing. Illegal Conversion Of Commercial Bldg/Space To Other Uses
complaints: There's this commercial space on 5th Ave that's been turned into apartments or something, the sign says "cozy lofts" but it's just wrong! The building ain't meant for living! It's loud, the people are all over the place, and I swear I saw them trying to put in a kitchen. Can someone please look into this?

I don’t know what’s going on with that store on 42nd Street but it looks like they’re turning it into a residence? I mean come on! That’s not right. It’s pure chaos around there. I can hear drills at all hours and people parking everywhere. It’s supposed to be a retail area! Who thinks this is okay?

I keep seeing lights on up in what used to be a storefront on the Lower East Side. Now there’s curtains in the windows like it’s an apartment! Like seriously?! Can someone do something about it before it gets worse? This is not how commercial spaces should be used! Ugh!

There’s a conversion happening on Broadway, I think they’re making apartments out of an old deli or something. The noise is unbearable, and the construction is taking forever! I don’t get how they’re even allowed to do this. It’s a commercial area for a reason people!

complaints: I can't believe I saw a RAT in the school yard while dropping off my kid! This is unacceptable, there are CHILDREN here! Do something!

There's a mouse problem at 'XYZ Elementary' and it’s disgusting. My son said they saw one in the cafeteria, gross! What are you doing about this?
Seriously, I just stepped over a dead mouse outside of the school. I mean, how do you let this happen? This is the last place I want my kids near!

label: Lost Property. Bag/Wallet. Shopping Bag
complaints: I left my reusable shopping bag on the subway, the blue one with the yellow flowers! I know it sounds petty but it's my favorite bag and it had my lunch in it so I’m real sad. Please help me find it!
So I was at the bodega on 5th and 34th and I took my bag with groceries but I think I left my tote there. It’s got my favorite mug in it! Can you please look into it?
I cannot believe I lost my shopping bag on the bus! It had all my stuff, like my new sweater I just bought and some snacks! Like who even takes a bag like that?! Ughhh, I need help finding it ASAP!

Hey! Just letting whoever needs to know that I misplaced my shopping bag with the pink polka dots in it somewhere near Times Square! It had a bunch of stuff that I need for the week, it’s driving me crazy!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Ver Mesage Sign RTPI. Operating Improperly
complaints: Yo, the traffic light at 5th and Main is just blinking like a disco ball and cars are all over the place! It’s chaos out here, please fix it ASAP!

Seriously, what’s up with the heating at the school?! It’s like no one cares that the kids are sitting there with coats on while trying to learn. It’s mid-winter, we shouldn’t be having this issue, plz get it sorted out!

There’s this place down the block that looks like a daycare but I never see any permits or anything. Just a bunch of toddlers running around in the backyard while the lady smokes a cig. Is that even legal?

Every time I walk by that house with all the kids, I swear they’ve got like 10 kids in a one bedroom apt! It’s chaotic and I think it’s unsafe, someone needs to check it out. What if there’s an emergency!

So yeah there’s this “daycare” and I put that in quotes because I have my doubts, I mean I see them pack all these kids in like sardines every day no adults in sight most of the time, it’s just wrong!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Base Door. Open

Seriously, what’s up with the traffic light at 8th Ave and 23rd St? It doesn’t change! I’ve been stuck there for ages and cars just don’t stop, it’s chaos! Someone needs to come and take a look before someone gets hurt!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Signal Head. Obscured (Dirty)

label: Sidewalk Condition. Cellar Door Defective
complaints: Yo, the sidewalk in front of my building is a disaster, like seriously, it's all cracked and uneven. I almost twisted my ankle walking my dog, and I'm just tired of dodging it every day. Can someone do something about this?

Listen, there's this cellar door that’s been sticking up in the sidewalk for weeks now. People have tripped on it, including me, and it’s a hazard! Fixed one day, broken the next, I can’t keep watching my feet every time I walk past!
The cellar doors on my block are just awful!! Like, you can't even walk without worrying about falling in or breaking your ankle! And we pay so much for rent in this neighborhood for what?

Idk who’s in charge of the sidewalks but ever since the last rain, that cellar door is like a whole obstacle course. There's a gaping hole now and I saw a kid almost get hurt yesterday! Come on, please get this fixed ASAP!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Pedestrian Signal. Down
complaints: The pedestrian signal at 5th and 42nd is totally out, like I almost got hit crossing the street! It’s been like this for days, it’s so unsafe!
OMG can someone fix the pedestrian light at Broadway and 34th? I stood there for 10 mins waiting for it to change, cars just zooming by, like are we supposed to risk our lives or what?
So the walk signal at 8th Ave and 23rd is not working, like seriously?? I was trying to cross and had to rely on the kindness of strangers to let me through. Fix this already!
Why is the pedestrian signal at Park and 50th just broken?? It's rush hour and nobody knows when to cross. People are getting mad, and it’s just chaos. Get it together!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Snow or Ice. Ball Field/Court
complaints: Yo, the basketball court at Riverside Park is a complete mess with all this snow, we can't even play! It’s like ice skating instead of shooting hoops. Can someone clear that up? We've been waiting for days!
The snow on the baseball field in Prospect Park is ridiculous. Can’t even see where the bases are! My kids were so sad they couldn’t practice, it’s just a snow pile!

Listen, I know it’s winter and all but that tennis court on 79th street is a total ice rink right now! No one can play there and I’m tired of slipping around when I try to jog past! Please do something about it!
I just walked by the soccer field in Central Park and it’s buried in snow! Like, come on guys, it’s been a week! Kids wanna play and all that snow just sitting there is not helping! Get it together!

label: Highway Condition. Dead Animal
complaints: There’s a dead raccoon just chillin on the shoulder of the FDR by 23rd street, it smells real bad like I can’t even deal! Can someone please take care of this?
I don’t know what’s up but there’s a big ol’ dead something on the west side highway near 14th street. Like, come on. Not a great first impression for visitors, ya know?
There’s a dead animal on the Brooklyn-Queens Expressway! It’s gross and it’s been there for days, can someone please do something about it?? I’m starting to feel sick just driving past it!
Why is there a dead whatever on the highway by the toll? It’s like an eyesore and gross! I drive by it every day and I just wanna scream! Fix it!!

label: Consumer Complaint. Cell Phone Store. Contract or Billing Dispute
complaints: I went to this cell phone store to upgrade my plan, but they totally messed it up! I thought I was getting unlimited data but now my bill is like way higher and I'm so confused! Can someone just fix this, please?

So I got a new phone from that store last week and the guy said it was all good, but now they charged me twice and I’m freaking out. I don’t have money for that! Can someone help me settle this nonsense?
This place has the worst customer service ever! I tried calling them to fix my billing issue and the wait time was like forever. They just kept putting me on hold and I don’t have time for that!
I had to cancel my plan with them and they said I’d get a refund but it’s been more than a month and nothing. I’m super annoyed and can’t keep waiting! It’s like they just took my money and ran.

label: Broken Parking Meter. No Receipt. Payment by Cash
complaints: I was trying to park my car and the meter was broken!! I put a couple of bucks in there for my spot and didn't get a receipt or anything, it's like it didn't even work! Now I'm worried I'm gonna get a ticket, what am I supposed to do?!

Ugh! I parked on 5th ave, put cash in the meter and it just ate my money. No receipt, no nothing! This is not ok! I need proof that I paid so I don’t get a stupid parking fine! Who do I even talk to about this?

I parked my car earlier today and the parking meter was acting all wonky. I put in cash, didn’t get a receipt, and it didn’t give me any time!!! What gives?! Now I’m stressed out thinking I’ll get a ticket when it wasn’t even my fault!

So frustrating!!! I used a broken meter on 10th street, paid cash and it just didn’t register. No receipt, I didn’t take a picture or anything like an idiot. I feel like I’m just waiting for a ticket to show up or something. Fix these meters, please!

label: Taxi Compliment. Driver Compliment. Other
complaints: I just wanna shout out to the driver who took me to Brooklyn last night, he was super chill and really nice! Made the ride feel safe and comfy, thanks man!
Took a cab from Midtown to the East Village and my driver was the best, he was so friendly and had the best music playing! Hope he gets a bonus or something, he deserves it!
Honestly, I don’t usually bother with compliments but this driver really made my day! He was so polite and even offered me gum – like, who does that?
Last night I had the most amazing taxi driver who made sure to ask about my favorite music and played it the whole ride! Where do I find more drivers like that?

label: Damaged Tree. Branch or Limb Has Fallen Down. Blocking Driveway
complaints: There’s this HUGE branch from a tree that fell and it’s literally blocking my whole driveway. Like, how am I supposed to get my car out? I can’t just leave it there, I’ve got places to be! Come on now!

Ughhh, a giant tree branch is lying in my driveway! I can’t even park my car, and it’s just gonna sit there for who knows how long! I need to get to work, this is so frustrating! Why can’t people keep their trees in check?!

Listen, a part of a tree just broke off and it’s taking up space in my driveway. I swear it’s been there for days now, and I’m tired of tripping over it when I’m trying to get to my car. Can someone please do something about this? It’s ridiculous!

So there’s this limb from a tree that fell down right in front of my place and now I can’t park. I mean, really? I get that trees fall but why does it have to happen right in my driveway? What do I do now, just wait for it to magically disappear?

label: Food Poisoning. 3 or More
complaints: I got takeout from that taco place on 12th and I swear it was bad, like really bad, my stomach is still hurting and I can’t even think about food right now. Just a heads up for the next poor soul who orders from there, ugh so gross!

So I ordered sushi from that spot on 3rd Ave, and I thought it was gonna be a nice treat but now I’m regretting my life choices. Spent the whole night in the bathroom, not fun! They gotta do better, this isn’t okay!

My friend and I went to this new burger joint last week, and we both ended up sick the next day. I don’t know if it was the lettuce or what but I’m seriously done with eating out for a bit. Can’t believe I wasted my money on that!

Is it normal to feel like I’m dying from a burrito? I had a chicken burrito from that spot on 14th and I can’t even move from my couch. It was all greasy and now my stomach is like a war zone. Just wanted to enjoy my lunch, now I’m regretting everything.

label: Illegal Tree Damage. Unauthorized Tree Pruning
complaints: Why is my tree all messed up? Just saw someone cut a bunch of branches off and it looks terrible! Like, they didn’t even ask me! Who do they think they are?
Ugh, some idiot is out here literally chopping up my beautiful tree! What the heck! It wasn’t even bothering anyone and now it looks like a disaster!
So I came home to find my tree butchered! There’s no way it was just natural, it’s like someone decided to give it a bad haircut. Can’t believe people think they can just mess with nature like that!
I swear I saw someone hacking away at my tree with no permission! Like, seriously, do they think they own it? Now it looks all weird and sad... so frustrating!

label: General Construction/Plumbing. Safety Netting/Guard Rails - Damaged/Inadequate/None (6 Stories/75 Feet Or Less)
complaints: Yo, I live on the block and the scaffolding outside my building is totally falling apart! Like seriously, the netting is ripped and I saw a pigeon almost get squished yesterday. This is a disaster waiting to happen, someone needs to fix this ASAP!

This construction site next to my apartment is a mess! The safety netting is hanging by a thread and I’m really worried it’s gonna come crashing down. I don’t wanna be walking under that thing and get something dropped on my head, you know? It’s just not safe!

Can someone please do something about the scaffolding at 4th and Main? It’s looking super old and the netting is just flapping in the wind. I can’t concentrate on my work because I’m worried about being crushed. Fix it before I end up a headline or something!

Why is there no guard rail on that construction site at 5th Ave? Every time I pass by, I feel like I’m risking my life. I mean, it’s like they don’t care about safety at all. Just a little netting is not enough! It’s just plain reckless, c'mon people.

label: Sewer Maintenance. Catch Basin Clogged
complaints: Heyy umm my street is totally flooded like seriously water is just sitting there and smells horrible. It’s been like this for days and I’m worried about rats or something. Can someone please just come and fix it??

So, there's this catch basin on my block that is completely blocked! It took me 20 minutes just to walk past it without getting soaked. Come on! I shouldn't have to wade through dirty water just to get home, it's disgusting!
Why is the catch basin on 5th Ave & 72nd still clogged?? My kids can’t even play outside without stepping in a gross puddle and it’s been weeks! Fix it already, it's such a hazard! Ugh!!!
Like seriously, does anyone ever check the drains?? My street is literally a swamp after every rain, it’s driving me insane! I don't want my apartment flooding, can someone do something about this?

label: Animal-Abuse. In Car
complaints: I saw this dog in a car parked on 5th st with the windows rolled up! It's so hot outside and I can't believe people still think it's okay to leave their pets like that! Someone needs to do something ASAP!
There’s a poor little pug in a black car on Broadway. It’s been there for at least an hour and it’s panting like crazy! Why are people so heartless?

I’m at the grocery store and there’s a big fluffy dog in a hatchback with no air. The car’s locked, and I can hear it whining. WTH are people thinking leaving their pets like this?! Get it together, NYC!
Just saw a small dog in a car parked in the sun on 42nd, it looks like it's suffering. I knocked on the window to try and help but no one was there, it’s cruel and totally unnecessary!

label: Consumer Complaint. Laundromat. Lost or Stolen Property
complaints: I went to wash my clothes at that corner laundromat and somehow my favorite jacket just vanished! I can't believe it, I left it right on top of the dryer and now it's gone. Who takes a jacket?!

Listen, I dropped off my clothes last week and they said they’d have it ready in a couple of days. I went to pick up & they can't find my stuff?? I've got no idea what they did with it but it's ridiculous, I'm so mad!!

Something's wrong with the laundromat on 10th st, I put my clothes in the dryer and when I came back, my hoodie was missing! Like, how do you just lose a whole hoodie? There's gotta be someone snatching stuff here, it's so frustrating!

I can't believe I went to do laundry and left my bag with my favorite jeans and they said it wasn't there when I came back!!! Like do people just take stuff that isn’t theirs? So infuriating, I want answers!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Signal Head. Damaged
complaints: The traffic light at 5th and 42nd is totally out, like it’s just blinking and cars are cutting through everywhere. It’s a disaster waiting to happen, fix it please!
Hey, can someone take a look at the light on Broadway? Its got a crack and doesn’t work properly, its super confusing for drivers and pedestrians!
Why is nobody doing anything about the traffic signal on 8th and 23rd? It’s all messed up and drivers are just speeding through, I saw a near miss today!
Ugh, the light at 3rd and 11th is all wonky, it stays red way too long and then flips to green for like 2 seconds! What are people supposed to do? Get it sorted out!

label: Consumer Complaint. Restaurant. Fees or Surcharges Not Disclosed
complaints: I went to this new Italian place in the East Village expecting a nice meal but then they hit me with some random surcharge I didn't see anywhere on the menu, like c'mon what is this, a secret fee? Total scam, not returning there again!

Had dinner at a spot in Brooklyn and seriously, they didn’t mention anything about a service charge until after we got the bill. I felt so embarrassed in front of my date, like how do you even just add that with no warning???

Ordered takeout from some trendy joint and they charged me $5 for 'packaging' like WHAT. You can’t just throw in extra fees like that without saying something first! Just tell me if you’re gonna be shady!
So I just got charged extra for ‘wellness services’ on my bill? What does that even mean?? Like, am I paying for good vibes or something?? This better not be a new thing, I’m not here for surprises.

label: Industrial Waste. Wastewater Into Catch Basin (IEB). Ieb
complaints: I saw this weird stuff flowing out of the drain by the park yesterday. It was kinda green and smelled bad, like a mix of rotten eggs and old gym socks. Like, what is that?! This ain’t a science experiment, people!

Ugh, can someone PLEASE do something about the catch basin at 5th & 27th? There's this bubbling goo coming out that looks like it’s been there for ages. I don’t even wanna walk by anymore! Super gross!

So, I was taking my dog for a walk, and I noticed the catch basin by my block is leaking some kinda murky water. I’m worried about pollution or something. Can someone check it out? It’s getting all over the sidewalk and it’s really nasty!

Why is there always this dark sludge in the catch basin on 3rd Ave? It’s been like that for weeks! I don't wanna deal with it when it rains, it looks like a mini oil spill! Gross and not safe for the kids playing nearby.

label: Broken Parking Meter. No Receipt. Payment by Card
complaints: I just tried to pay for parking at that meter on 34th st and it ate my card and didn’t give me a receipt?! like what the heck am I supposed to do now?
There is this broken parking meter on 5th Ave, I put my card in and it just shut off! No receipt, no nothing! I can't afford a ticket for your faulty machine!
Ughhh I used the parking meter on 10th and it totally glitched out on me!! I paid and didn’t get a receipt. This is so frustrating, what if I get a ticket?! Where’s the accountability?!
Hey, this meter on 8th and Broadway is outta order. I tried to use my card, paid for parking but it didn’t give me a receipt and now I’m stressed about getting a ticket. Fix it, please!

label: Disorderly Youth. Playing in Unsuitable Place
complaints: There are like a dozen kids playing basketball in the middle of the street like it's a court or something, and cars can't get by! It's pure chaos out here, someone is gonna get hurt!
These teenagers have turned the playground into a skate park and they don't even care about the rules! I can't even take my little ones there anymore, it’s just wild!
Every evening these kids are playing soccer on the road, it’s annoying and dangerous! Can’t anyone tell them to go to the park and leave the street for cars?
I’m trying to walk my dog and there’s a group of noisy kids blasting music and skateboarding all over the sidewalks, can’t anyone keep them in check? It’s ridiculous!

label: Consumer Complaint. Furniture Store. Goods Damaged or Defective
complaints: I ordered a couch 2 months ago and it showed up with a huge tear in the fabric like are you kidding me?? I waited so long for this thing and now I gotta deal with returning it, what a hassle!

Just got my dining table delivered and it has a scratch that's like a mile long. Who does quality control over there? I can't believe I wasted my money on something that looks like it was dragged down the street!
So I bought a mattress that was supposed to be 'memory foam' but it feels more like a rock. I can't sleep at all and I'm so frustrated! I just wanna get my money back already!
Ordered a bed frame that showed up late and when it finally arrived, there were pieces missing! Now I'm sleeping on the floor and can't even get someone on the phone to help me, UGH!

label: Sewer. Rain Garden Debris (Girgd). Girgd
complaints: There's a pile of leaves and trash in the rain garden on my block!!! It's all clogged up and smells sooooo bad, like come on, clean it up! We're trying to live here!

Ughhh, can someone PLEASE do something about the rain garden near my building? It’s a total mess, full of sticks and junk. It's gross and makes the whole area look terrible! Do I have to wade through garbage to get to work?
So over the rain garden at the corner of 5th and 45th – it’s just full of debris and I swear the weeds are taller than I am! It’s like a jungle and not in a cool way!
Every time it rains, that garden turns into a swamp, it’s just a big pile of garbage - sticks, leaves, and who knows what else! Can't believe this is my neighborhood, seriously, it just looks awful!

label: General Construction/Plumbing. Construction - Change Grade/Watercourse
complaints: Hey! So there’s this construction going on nearby and they’ve been digging up the street for weeks! Like seriously, can someone please tell them to wrap it up? My whole block is a mess and I can’t even park my car without going on a wild goose chase. So frustrating!

I just wanna know why these workers keep digging in front of my building without any notice, it's like a war zone outside! All this noise and dirt is ruining my mornings. Can they at least put up a sign or something? Also my mailman is complaining about getting through, which is ridiculous!

Ugh, I can't take this anymore! My street is like a giant mud pit because of this construction. I stepped in a huge puddle yesterday and ruined my shoes. Who’s responsible for this mess? It’s been too long, and they don’t even work on weekends!

What is going on with the roadwork on 5th Ave? They started digging and then poof! No one’s there for days. The whole thing is making it impossible to get around and my neighbor’s car got stuck in the dirt! Can someone please check it out? This is beyond ridiculous!

label: Street Light Condition. Multiple Street Lights Out. Location Type: Park
complaints: Yo, the street lights in Prospect Park are totally out! Like pitch black after dark. It feels super sketchy walking there at night, can someone PLEASE fix this?
It's dark as a cave in the park after sunset cause all the street lights are off for some reason. I was just there and couldn’t see a thing, super dangerous!! Light 'em up!
The lights by the entrance of Central Park are all off, it’s like a horror movie out there! I get it’s dark early now but come on! Got lost trying to get home – fix this asap!
Why are the park lights out? I jog there at night and I’m dodging trees and shadows like it’s a video game.. It’s getting really annoying. Safety first, people!

label: Residential Disposal Complaint. Storage Area Not Provided. Homeowner
complaints: I just moved in and holy moly where am I supposed to put my trash? No bins anywhere, just a pile in my kitchen that's driving me crazy. Can I get some help with this, please?
So like I’m trying to figure out what to do with my garbage, I don’t have a proper space for it and it’s really piling up. I’m not trying to have a trash mountain in my apartment!
This is ridiculous! I pay too much rent and there’s nowhere to put my garbage!!! I’ve been using the hallway, but that's not safe or allowed right? I need an actual solution here ASAP!
Why is it so hard to get a trash can around here? Have to put my garbage bags on the balcony and it’s attracting flies, it’s so gross. I can’t deal with this mess, help me out!

label: Outside Building. Gutter/Leader. Blocked Or Missing
complaints: Yo, I got this tree right outside my building and it’s like, dropping leaves and gunk into the gutter. It’s clogged up bad and whenever it rains, it’s like a waterfall over my door! Like, can we get someone to fix this?

The gutters on my building are totally blocked. Every time it rains, it just spills over and splashes all over the sidewalk, really annoying especially for people walking by with nice shoes lol. Can somebody please come look at this?

Why are the gutters in front of my apartment always full? I think there’s like a whole family of raccoons living in there or something. It looks nasty and is a hazard for the kids playing outside. This needs to be cleaned up ASAP!

So, there’s this huge pile of leaves and junk in the gutter right by my front door. It’s starting to smell like something died in there! Plus, it’s attracting flies and who knows what else. Can you send someone to clean that out? Thanks.

label: Consumer Complaint. Furniture Store. Refund, Return, or Exchange Refused
complaints: I bought a couch from this store and it has a tear in it, now they don’t wanna give me a refund or exchange?! Like, excuse me is this how you treat customers? I’m very upset, I just want my money back, is that too much to ask?!

Why is it so hard to just return a chair?! I tried to get my money back from this furniture place but they keep saying no because I lost my receipt but I paid with a card! C’mon, just check the system!

OMG I can’t believe the service I got at that furniture store. I spent like a thousand bucks on a dining set and they refused to take it back because I opened the box. It had scratches, that’s not my fault! So mad right now!

I ordered a bed frame and it came damaged, and the store won’t let me return it! Like, why do I have to deal with a broken piece of furniture in my home? This is the worst, I just want what I paid for, not a headache!

label: Consumer Complaint. Bodega, Deli, or Convenience Store. Advertising False or Misleading
complaints: I went into my local bodega thinking I could grab a deal on those chips that were on sale but they charged me full price! Like, is it a sale or what?? I feel ripped off and I’m not coming back if they keep doing this.
So I saw this ad in the deli for a sandwich special but when I got there, they said it expired last week?? Why put it on the board then? I just wanted a quick bite and I wasted my time, not cool.
I bought a drink that was advertised as having all this fruit flavor but it tasted like water. Seriously, it was just so bland! They gotta stop lying about their products, or at least tell the truth!

Every time I go into that corner store, the prices on the shelves never match what they charge at the register! Like I get it, they gotta make money, but it feels like they’re just playing tricks on us. At this point I feel like I can’t trust anythingI read on those shelves.

label: Highway Condition. Crash Cushion Defect
complaints: So I was driving on the FDR and noticed that one of those crash cushions is all messed up, like it's got this huge dent in it. Feels like it's just waiting for an accident to happen, you know? Can someone please fix that?
I was on the highway and saw this crash cushion that looks like it's been hit hard, like what's going on? That thing is dangerous! Please get someone to check it out ASAP!
Yo, I almost crashed into that broken crash cushion on the BQE last night. It's all smashed up and not doing its job, like come on, how hard is it to keep these things in shape? Just fix it already!

Driving down the West Side Highway and I swear that crash cushion was practically flat! Can't believe nobody's seen this, it's just sitting there looking useless! Please send help before someone gets hurt!

label: Illegal Posting. Flyer or Handbill. Other
complaints: There are like a million flyers stuck to every lamppost in my block, it looks so trashy and nobody cares to take them down!
I just moved to the neighborhood and I can't believe how many random posters are plastered everywhere! It’s like a gallery of bad art. Can someone do something about this?
Every time I walk my dog, I get hit in the face with these stupid flyers advertising dance classes or whatever! It's beyond ridiculous, can’t people find a better way to advertise?
I’m so sick of seeing all these flyers for lost cats and parties taped to every available surface! It’s cluttering up the streets, get it together people!

label: Dumpster Complaint. Small uncovered dumpster
complaints: I live next to that dumpster on 3rd Ave and it smells sooo bad like a rotten egg in summer heat I can't even open my window! Can someone please come clean that thing?
What’s up with that dumpster? It’s always overflowing and the trash is everywhere! I saw rats this morning and I don’t want them in my apartment, help!
That dumpster by the corner on W 46th is always open and it’s filled with disgusting stuff, feels like a health hazard or something. Can’t believe we gotta deal with that daily!
That dumpster on my street has no cover and it’s seriously attracting all the stray cats and who knows what else! It’s not cute or safe and we can’t even sit outside anymore ugh!

label: Consumer Complaint. Restaurant. Tip Required
complaints: I went to this restaurant and the waiter literally stared at me while I was eating like he was waiting for a tip or something! It was super awkward and made me not even want to leave one. Like chill dude, I'm just here for some food!

Ordered takeout and they added a tip automatically! I didn't even realize until I checked my receipt later. What’s up with that? I don’t appreciate it. I tip when I want, not when you decide I should. Really shady!

Can someone explain why some places now expect tips for just bringing food to your table? Like, I'm on a budget here, not made of money! It’s really unfair when I just want a simple meal and feel pressured to tip on top of that. Ugh!

Went to this place for brunch, and the service was like super slow! Food took forever and they still basically threw the check at me like I’m supposed to tip them for that? I mean, come on! If I want to tip, it’s for good service, not waiting half an hour!

label: Street Sign - Dangling. Yield
complaints: Hey, there’s this yield sign on 5th Ave and 23rd St that’s like half hanging off the pole, it’s gonna fall on someone’s car or worse, a person. Can’t anyone fix this? It’s been a week like this!
The yield sign at the corner of Maple and Pine has been dangling for days now! I swear if it falls, someone’s gonna get hurt. Get on it, please! It looks unsafe.
Look, the yield sign near my building is practically swinging in the wind, get it together! How are drivers supposed to know they need to yield when the sign is all messed up like that?
I almost got hit because the yield sign on 10th and 45th is hanging by a thread! Like, I can’t believe nobody’s done anything about it, it’s dangerous out here!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Broken Glass. Other
complaints: I was walking my dog by the corner of 5th and 12th and there’s a bunch of broken glass all over the sidewalk like it’s been there for days! My dog almost stepped on it and I’m worried someone’s gonna get hurt! Can someone please clean this up?

Seriously, there’s shattered glass everywhere on the street near the old bodega. I saw a kid almost cut his foot on it yesterday! What happened here? It’s such a mess, fix it already before someone gets hurt!
I can’t believe there’s still broken glass on 7th Ave after a week! It’s not just ugly, it’s dangerous! Last time I checked, people walk here! Do something about this ASAP.

There’s a pile of broken glass on the ground by the park entrance on East 14th that’s been there since the weekend, like who cleans this? I don’t wanna see anyone get hurt, can someone get on it? Thanks!

label: Consumer Complaint. Supermarket or Grocery Store. Goods or Services Not Delivered
complaints: I ordered groceries online and they delivered half of it missing like where's my milk and eggs? I just wanted a normal breakfast. Ugh. What a waste of time!
So I paid for my stuff online from that supermarket on 5th but they didn't bring half my order! I called them and they say they don’t have a record. What do I do now?
Ordered some fancy cheese and bread for a dinner party and they showed up with only the bread! I look stupid now trying to impress my friends with just a loaf. Thanks a lot!
I don't even know who to complain to but my last delivery from that store was a total mess! I'm missing veggies and snacks for my kids. Can’t anyone do their job right? This is ridiculous!

label: Consumer Complaint. Hotel or Motel. Refund, Return, or Exchange Refused
complaints: So I stayed at this hotel last week and it was a disaster! The room was filthy and I actually found a rat! I asked for a refund but they said no way! What kind of place is this? Never going back!

I booked a room for two nights online and the pics looked amazing, but when I got there it was like a totally different place! Furniture was all broken, and there were weird stains on the bed! I just want my money back, but they said I can’t get a refund because I checked in! So unfair!

My wife and I went for a weekend getaway but the hotel was not at all like the website photos at all! It was old, smelled like mildew and we couldn’t even sleep there! I was furious and demanded a refund but they didn’t budge. How is this legal?!

I stayed at this hotel for my business trip and they charged me twice for some reason! I called them to fix it but they said there’s nothing they can do about it. Who do I even talk to about this? Do I have to just let them take my money?

label: Sanitation Worker or Vehicle Complaint. Unsafe Driving. Garbage Truck
complaints: I can't believe how reckless the garbage truck drivers are in my neighborhood! They drive way too fast down the sidewalks and almost hit my kids, like, twice this week! What's the deal? Can't they slow down a little?
Dude, the garbage truck just ran a stop sign right in front of me! It’s like they think they own the road or something. I swear if they keep this up someone is gonna get hurt, it’s not okay!
I’m so fed up with the garbage truck blocking the whole street every week! They stop in the middle of the road, and I have to wait forever to get by. There’s gotta be a better way to do this!
Every Monday morning it's the same story, the trash truck is all over the place! I mean swerving, speeding, and just being a menace! Can we get some accountability here? This is ridiculous.

label: Sidewalk Condition. Sidewalk Grating - Missing
complaints: Hey, so like, there’s this sidewalk grate missing near the corner of 5th and 44th and it’s a real hazard, especially at night! I almost twisted my ankle walking by, like, could someone fix it before someone gets hurt?!
I just tripped over a missing sidewalk grate on W 37th. Seriously, how hard is it to put one back??? My knee is scraped and I’m late to work. Fix this already!
Umm, there’s a huge hole where the grate used to be on 8th Avenue near the deli. I thought I fell into the abyss or something! It’s been like this for weeks!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Signal Visor. Damaged
complaints: Hey there, so the traffic light at 5th and Main has this visor thing that's totally busted. It's not blocking the sun and I swear drivers are squinting like they're in the desert. Like how are we supposed to cross safely?

Can someone please do something about the traffic signal on 34th street? The visor is hanging off and is a total hazard. My kid and I almost got run over because the light was confusing! Fix it already!!!

Ugh, the light at Broad and Pine is so messed up. The visor is cracked which makes it super hard to see if it's red or green when the sun's out. Almost got honked to death today, can’t you people just fix it?

The light at 59th and 8th is missing its visor! It’s like trying to read the future with the sun in my eyes. People just go when they feel like it and it’s really dangerous. C'mon, let's get this sorted out!

label: Street Sign - Damaged. Construction
complaints: Hey so there's a stop sign on 5th and Main that's totally bent like someone kicked it! It’s hard to see it from the road and I'm worried someone is gonna get hit or something. Can't believe this hasn't been fixed yet!

What is going on with the construction on 3rd Ave? They knocked down a sign and haven't replaced it yet! It’s a total mess and drivers are all confused, like, just put a new sign up, how hard can it be?

label: Litter Basket Complaint. Misuse. Used for Household Trash
complaints: Hey, can you please do something about the trash cans on 3rd Ave? I keep seeing people dump their household garbage in them and it's so disgusting! I was walking my dog and the smell was just unbearable, like why is this allowed?

Ugh, there’s this one litter basket outside my building that’s always overflowing with what looks like actual kitchen waste. Seriously, why do people think it’s okay to treat it like their personal dump? It’s making the whole street look terrible!

I live near the park and the trash can is basically a landfill now. I saw someone throw a pizza box in there the other day like it’s a regular trash can! What’s the point of a trash bin if it’s gonna be filled with people’s leftover food?

Please please please, can someone do something about the litter baskets on my block? I’m sick of seeing bags of trash shoved in them, it’s really disgusting and it attracts rats. This is so frustrating!

label: Residential Disposal Complaint. Refrigerator or Freezer Door Attached
complaints: I thought I could get rid of my old fridge last week but now the door is stuck shut and I can’t get it off! It’s just sitting there in the alley like a big block of ice. Can someone please come and help me?

My old refrigerator is just sitting on the curb and it still has the door attached. It looks ridiculous and is taking up space! I don’t even know what to do with it at this point but I want it gone ASAP!
Okay, so like, my fridge is out on the street but the door is still attached and it’s got to be a code violation or something, right? I mean who wants to see that? Help!
Just want to report that my neighbor put their old fridge on the curb and it still has the door on it. It’s a hazard with kids around and it smells bad too! Can we do something about this?

label: Overgrown Tree/Branches. Traffic Sign or Signal Blocked. Sign
complaints: There is this HUGE tree on the corner of 5th and 34th and its branches are hanging right over the stop sign, like how are drivers even supposed to see it? It’s so bad, someone is gonna get clocked if it doesn’t get fixed soon!

This tree in front of my building is outta control, it’s like a jungle out here! The branches are blocking not just the streetlight but also half of the stop sign. I can’t believe it hasn’t been trimmed yet, it's dangerous!

Yo! The tree in front of my apartment is growing over the stop sign like it’s trying to hide it or something. I swear I’ve seen cars run the stop sign because they just can’t see it. Get that thing chopped back ASAP!

Why is nobody doing anything about that tree on Main St? It’s completely hiding the yield sign and I’m pretty sure it’s gonna cause an accident one of these days. Just take a walk there and see for yourself... it’s ridiculous!

label: Consumer Complaint. Restaurant. Price Gouging
complaints: I just went to that new pizza place on Broadway and they charged me $30 for a large pie! Like what even is that? I could get a whole dinner for a family for that price in some other places, this is ridiculous!
Had dinner at this spot in the East Village and they charged $25 for a burger!!! I mean it was good but it’s still just a burger, not gold plated!
Why are restaurants here charging so much?? Went to that Thai place last night and paid $18 for a pad thai that was like the size of my hand. I feel robbed!
Some cafe in Brooklyn just tried to charge me $7 for a small coffee! Are they serious? I can get a whole meal for that price elsewhere, this city is nuts sometimes.

complaints: Went to the corner store near me and they wouldn't take my cash!!! What kinda place won't take cash? I don't always have a card on me and now I gotta go hunt for an ATM? This is ridiculous!!!

I just tried to buy some stuff from that store on 5th Ave and they said they only take cards. What if I don't have one? Are they trying to give us all heart attacks waiting to find an ATM? This is NYC, come on!

I can't believe that shop on 42nd is not accepting cash anymore. Are we in some fancy tech movie? I just wanted to buy a drink and was short on my card limit. It's so frustrating, I mean what are people supposed to do?

This is absolutely absurd, the little shop on Main Street refused to take my cash! I had exact change and they treated me like I was trying to pay with Monopoly money or something. What is the world coming to when cash is no longer an option?!

label: Consumer Complaint. Landlord or Real Estate Agent. Fees or Surcharges Not Disclosed
complaints: I just moved into this apartment and they hit me with all these fees that were NEVER mentioned while signing the lease!!! Like, how am I just supposed to magically know about these extra costs? It's ridiculous!!!
So my real estate agent showed me this cute place but she forgot to mention the $500 move-in fee???? I feel so scammed right now, like I should’ve been told this upfront!!! This is NOT okay!

Why didn’t anyone tell me about the hidden fees when I was looking for a new place?? I’m getting charged for every little thing and it’s like, what is this, a scam? I can’t even afford groceries after this!

My landlord is charging me a cleaning fee after I just moved in and the place was disgusting to begin with! How’s that fair? They didn’t even tell me about that before I signed anything!! Ugh, so frustrating!

label: Consumer Complaint. Debt Collection Agency. Harassment
complaints: These people keep calling me at all hours about some debt I don’t even owe! Like, seriously, I’ve told them to stop 10 times already! Why can’t they just leave me alone?

I’m sick and tired of this company calling me every day, sometimes twice a day! I don’t owe them anything! It’s harassment and it’s driving me crazy! Can’t they get a hint?
I’ve blocked these debt collectors like a million times but they keep using different numbers! How is this even legal? I feel like I’m being hunted down for something that’s not even real!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Structure - Outdoors. Hard Court Surface/Equipment
complaints: Yo, the basketball court on 5th and 2nd is like totally ruined, there's cracks everywhere and the surface is so uneven, it's hard to even dribble a ball without twisting an ankle. Can someone fix this??

Seriously, I just slipped on that court over by the community center, it's like a skating rink with all the cracks. Not cool, I almost fell on my face trying to play. Need someone out here to take a look ASAP!
Can you please send someone to check out the outdoor court on 14th street? It's been months and it’s basically a jungle out there with weeds and stuff all over—who's gonna want to play on that mess?

complaints: I tried to return this expired yogurt I bought last week and the cashier looked at me like I was crazy! They said no returns on dairy after checkout but like I shouldn't have to eat moldy food, right?

complaints: I can't believe these snow plows are out at 3am making all this noise! I have to get up early for work and I can't sleep with all that racket, it's ridiculous!

Why is the plow truck so loud? I get it's snowing but come on, is it necessary to blast my windows at 2 am? I'm so tired!
The snow removal vehicles are nice and all but why do they have to make it sound like a monster truck rally at 5am? I'm begging you to tell them to keep it down!

complaints: I went to this place for a sandwich and saw raw meat just sittin on the counter, like are you serious? Who does that?? It was like a scene from a horror movie!

I bought some sushi from that place on 2nd Ave and the fish looked all weird, like it was not stored right or something. I’m honestly paranoid now, I hope I don’t get sick.

complaints: I can't believe this! The trash cans on my block are always overflowing and its because all these shops are just dumping their garbage in them! Like, keep your trash at your store not in our neighborhood!

label: Water Quality. unknown odor/taste in drinking water (QA6). Qa6
complaints: Yo, has anyone else noticed the water tastes like straight up metal or something? I swear I’m chugging rusty pipes or whatever, it’s disgusting!

Why does it smell like cat pee all the time from my neighbor’s yard? I love cats but come on, they need to clean up after them! This isn't a cat park for them to do their business, it's making my whole place stink!

I just moved in and can’t deal with this! The cat from across the way is always on my porch and it smells like litter box over here. I thought NYC was supposed to be classy but now I feel like I’m living in a dump!

label: Air Quality. Air: Smoke, Vehicular (AA4). Aa4
complaints: What is with all the smoke in the air? It smells like something's burning and I can't breathe right! It's like living in an oven over here and I just want to open a window! Ugh!
Hey, the air quality today is horrible! I can literally taste the smoke. You guys need to do something about the amount of cars spewing exhaust around here. It's out of control!
Seriously, why is it so smoky outside? It feels like I’m choking every time I step outside! I have kids and I’m worried about their health, this is freaking ridiculous!
I don’t know who needs to hear this but the air smells like a BBQ that never stops, and not in a good way! Can someone please do something about the traffic fumes? We need fresh air!

complaints: There's a yield sign on 5th and Elm that's been knocked over for weeks. It's laying on the sidewalk like nobody cares! I almost got into a crash 'cause drivers don’t know to yield! This is ridiculous, fix it already!

Why is the yield sign at the corner by my apartment all bent up and hard to see? People are just blowing through the intersection like it’s nothing. I’m so worried someone’s gonna get hurt! Can someone do something about this?
Hello? Can somebody tell me when the yield sign at W 35th and 8th will be fixed? It’s broken and nobody is yielding, cars swerving everywhere! It’s scary. Just had a bus almost hit me yesterday!
The yield sign near the park is totally destroyed, like, how can they expect people to be safe with a sign that looks like it got hit by a truck? It’s been like this for way too long!

complaints: I was at this pizza place on 5th Ave and I swear the guy making my pie didn't have a hairnet on! I mean, who does that? It's kinda gross, like I'm not trying to eat someone’s hair, ya know?
Just want to mention that the deli on the corner has this dude behind the counter who never wears a hat or anything - I got hair in my sandwich! Disgusting. Please tell them to get it together!

OMG I got takeout from a spot in the East Village and the guy preparing my order had long hair just hanging out! Like, how hard is it to put on a hairnet?! I almost lost my appetite, that’s how bad it was.

I love this little cafe but the last few times I went, the barista doesn't wear anything on her head and I saw her hair flying around! It's just kinda unhygienic and makes me wonder if they care about cleanliness.

label: Street Sign - Damaged. Detour
complaints: Yo, the stop sign on 5th and Maple is all bent up like someone tried to karate chop it or something. Can barely see it, and cars are zooming by like it’s a race track!
That detour sign on 42nd Street is totally wrecked, flapping in the wind, can’t even tell what it’s supposed to say! Seriously, how am I supposed to know where to go if the sign's a mess?
Hey, can you please fix the yield sign at the corner of 8th and 23rd? It’s been knocked over for days now, and I swear drivers are just ignoring the rules, almost got hit yesterday!
This detour is the worst! The sign on Park Avenue is broken and nobody knows where they're supposed to go. It’s causing chaos! Fix it before someone gets hurt, please!

label: General Construction/Plumbing. Excavation Undermining Adjacent Building
complaints: There's a big hole in the street right next to my building and I'm worried it’s gonna collapse or something. Workers have been digging for days and it’s super noisy, plus my windows rattle. Can someone please check this out?

Excuse me, but the construction on my block is ridiculous. They’re digging like it's the end of the world. My car is stuck and I can’t even get to my apartment without climbing over piles of dirt. This is just too much!

So there’s some major digging happening right outside my place and I swear the whole building shakes when they drop something heavy. Kinda freaks me out honestly. Can you send someone to make sure nothing’s gonna fall over?

Ugh, I don't know who’s in charge of this mess but these guys are digging forever! I can’t even get to my front door without stepping around cones and barriers, it’s a hassle. Like, can we get a timeline or something?

label: Food Establishment. Food Preparation Location. Made at Home/Unpermited Site
complaints: I just ordered delivery and I swear my food smells like it was cooked in a dirty basement, like is it even legal to make food like this?? Totally grossed out right now!
Why on earth is my neighbor grilling in the apartment again?? I can smell it from my window and it’s making me sick. I thought there were rules about cooking in apartments!
So I got this weird takeout from a new place down the block and the chicken tasted kinda funny, like it was made in someone’s kitchen not even a restaurant, like come on, who’s checking this stuff??
My roommate found these weird bugs in our takeout! I don’t think that guy making sandwiches on the corner has a permit or whatever, it’s sketchy and now I’m freaking out about food safety!

complaints: I ordered my couch three weeks ago and they said it would be delivered in like a week, but now they won't even pick up my calls!!! I just wanna sit on something that isn't a folding chair, this is ridiculous!!
So I paid for my dining table set and the delivery guy never showed up. I’ve been eating dinner on the floor for a week and it’s just embarrassing. Can I get my money back?
Ordered a bed frame, they said it would be here by Tuesday. It’s Friday and I’m still on the mattress on the floor. This is so frustrating, I’ve been sleeping like a potato!

I got a lamp from this store and they said it’d come in 5-7 days and now it’s been over two weeks, I called and they keep putting me on hold or saying the same excuse. This is not okay, I need light in my apartment!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Signal Lamp. Turned
complaints: The traffic light at 5th and Main is totally out! Cars are just zooming through and it's super dangerous especially with kids around, please fix it ASAP!
Yo, the light on 14th and 8th has been acting up, like it turns green for just a second and then back to red, it’s chaos! Can't believe no one noticed this, it’s been like this for days!

Hey, can someone do something about the traffic signal at Park and 3rd? It’s been blinking yellow for weeks and drivers are confused! Feels like we're living in a video game where anything goes! Help!
I’m so tired of that light on Broadway and 42nd! It’s completely out and has been for too long, I almost got ran over today! This needs to be taken care of, it’s a mess around there!

label: Hazardous Materials. Oil Spill On Street, Small (HQS). Hqs
complaints: Hey, there's this weird oil slick all over the street near my building on 5th Ave. It's super slippery and smells bad, like, what even is this? I noticed it last night and thought it was gonna go away but nope, still there and now I'm worried someone is gonna slip and fall! Can someone please clean this up?

So, I just walked out my front door and there’s this gross puddle of oil across the block. It looks like someone spilled a whole can of motor oil or something! Honestly, it’s disgusting and I can already see people avoiding it but it’s totally a hazard!
There’s an oil spill on the corner of 10th and B. It’s been there for days and it’s getting bigger. I don’t even want to walk my dog around there anymore. Why can’t someone just fix this already?
Ugh, my car almost slipped on this weird oily stuff in the street on 12th St. I don’t know where it came from but it’s like a mini disaster zone out here. Can someone do something quick? It's nasty!

label: General. Signage Missing. Janitor/Super Emergency Contact
complaints: There's a huge sign missing in front of my building and no one knows who to call if there's an emergency!! like, what if something happens?! do they expect us to figure it out ourselves or what? this is silly.

I can't believe there’s no emergency contact info for the super posted anywhere. It's like they expect us to just guess who to call! The other day someone had a huge leak and we were all just standing around freaking out!

Ugh, so frustrating! I went down to the lobby and there's no sign showing how to get in touch with the janitor or super! Now we have a broken elevator and no one to help. Seriously, it's a disaster waiting to happen!
Why is there no emergency contact sign in our building? It’s 2023 and we’re still running around like headless chickens when there’s a problem! Fix it already, this should NOT be hard to do!

label: Pet Sale. Animals Sold From Residence
complaints: I keep seeing these people selling puppies out of their apartment like it’s a doggie store or something, its so wrong, I don't think they're licensed or whatever, it’s shady, I just wanna know if this is allowed!!!
There’s a sketchy dude on my block who sells kittens from his house, like what if they’re sick or something, can someone do something?? I’m worried for those poor animals, ugh!

Can someone please check on 1234 Main St? They are always posting about puppies for sale on social media and I’m pretty sure they’re doing it from their living room, it feels so wrong, I just don’t think that’s a good idea, y'know?

I saw some people buying a dog from a private residence last week and it just didn’t sit right, like shouldn’t this be regulated or something? I feel like I’m in a flea market but for pets, and it’s not cool.

label: Lost Property. Book/Stationery. Book
complaints: I lost my favorite book on the 4 train last night and I just can’t stop thinking about it! It was a signed copy and I'm freaking out. Can someone help me find it?
Man, I left my notebook in a coffee shop in Brooklyn like a dummy, and I really need it back! It’s got all my notes for class and I’m gonna lose my mind if I can’t find it!
I seriously need help finding this book I lost at the library! It’s like my whole life is in that book, I’m so upset!
I dropped my planner somewhere around Union Square and it has important stuff in it! Why is it always the things we need the most that go missing? Ugh!

label: Broken Parking Meter. No Receipt
complaints: So I'm parked at this meter on 5th and 34th, and it's broken! I put in my card and NOTHING! No receipt, nothing. Now I’m worried I'm gonna get a ticket like how is that fair?!

The parking meter on 10th street is completely dead! Tried two different cards, and it just won’t work. I can't believe this - I can’t just sit here all day waiting for it to magically start working!

Parking meter broken at 3rd and B, no receipt, no help, just my luck. I parked there for 15 minutes and was late to my appointment, now I feel like they’re just gonna nab me with a ticket for no reason. Super frustrating!

label: Sewer Maintenance. Catch Basin Sunken
complaints: Hey, there's this catch basin thingy on my block, and it's like completely sunk into the road, feel like my car is gonna fall in or something, please fix, it's a hazard for real.

The catch basin on 5th and 42nd is totally wrecked, it sunk like crazy! I swear it's getting deeper every week. Can someone do something about it before someone trips or worse?
There’s a catch basin near me that’s sunken really bad, like seriously it’s a disaster waiting to happen. I almost turned my ankle walking over it the other day, it’s ridiculous!

complaints: There's a mountain of garbage just sitting in the park by 5th Ave and 12th St. It's not just like a bag or two, there's old furniture, food waste, everything you could think of. It's attracting rats, I swear!

Why is the lot behind my building always a pigsty? Every time I walk by, it smells like someone dumped a kitchen in there. Like, it's seriously gross and it's getting worse. Can someone please do something about the trash?!

Ugh, guys! The trash cans on my block are overflowing, like they haven’t been emptied in days! People just throwing their bags on the ground next to them, it’s so disgusting. I tried to clean a bit up myself but it’s way too much. Help!

I just moved here and wow, the litter on my street is unreal! You can’t even see the sidewalk in some parts. It makes this neighborhood look terrible and I’m embarrassed to walk my dog with all this junk everywhere!

label: Rodent. Signs of Rodents. Holes or Burrows
complaints: I swear I saw a mouse the size of a cat runnin in the back of my kitchen. I thought it was my imagination at first but no, these little pests are basically taking over my life! I just wanna make a sandwich without freakin out!

OMG! There's like a hole in the wall of my apartment and I see these little furry things pokin their heads out. I don't even know how many are in there but it freaks me out. My roommate says it’s normal but I'm just not cool with sharing space with rats! Ugh!

So, there's a burrow near my front door like what is this a wildlife preserve?? I live in the city! I’m not ready to be roommates with rodents! I thought only fancy stores had that problem, not my building on 3rd Ave. Can someone please do something?!

I found a hole in my wall and I swear it leads to somewhere nasty. I can’t sleep knowing whatever is in there could come out at any moment. Like I could wake up to a family of mice havin a picnic in my kitchen! This is not okay!!

label: Overgrown Tree/Branches. Clear Street Light
complaints: Hey there, can’t see nothing at night cause this stupid tree is blocking the light on my block! I almost tripped last night walking home, ugh! Something needs to be done like seriously, it’s a safety hazard!

This tree on my street is so out of control it feels like it’s trying to eat the street light. It’s ridiculous! How am I supposed to walk home at night when I can’t see anything? Help!!

Why is nobody doing anything about these trees? The light on 10th street can barely shine through because of all the branches! It’s scary out here at night and I just want to get home without worrying about tripping or worse!

complaints: I bought a sandwich from that little bodega on 5th and they didn’t have any signs about their return policy! I feel like I got ripped off when I found a hair in my food! How am I supposed to know what they do about refunds?

The other day, I grabbed a drink from that convenience store by the subway and it tasted expired. When I asked if I could get a refund, the dude looked at me like I was crazy. No signs about returns anywhere, so how am I supposed to know?!

I just want to say that the deli on Elm Street has no clear return policy posted! I bought some chips and they were stale, I didn’t know what to do! I asked for a refund and they acted like I was being ridiculous!

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Equipment. Incorrect/Missing Equipment

I was at that new falafel cart on 14th and it was missing half its menu yesterday, no pita bread?? How do you run a falafel stand without pita???
Yo, the dumpling vendor near the subway has been closed for two weeks. When's he comin back? I can’t deal with my cravings anymore!

I got my car back from this place and it was worse than when I dropped it off! They charged me for parts and labor and I think they just slapped some cheap stuff on there that’s gonna break again. I need a real mechanic!

My friend recommended this spot on the corner but now I see why he had trouble! They didn't do half the work they said they would and I think they’re not even licensed. Just a bunch of shady guys with a garage. Avoid at all costs!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Structure - Outdoors. Gate
complaints: The gate to the park near my apartment is always stuck, like yesterday I had to literally shove it open, and it's such a pain with my kid and stroller. Can someone please fix this?

Why are these scooters always left in the way? There’s one right near the crosswalk, like who thinks that’s okay? People can’t even get by!
There’s an abandoned Veo scooter just sitting here for days now, it’s starting to look like trash! Can someone come pick it up? This is getting ridiculous!

Dude, the rocks in the park are totally messed up with all this weird spray paint everywhere. I thought we lived in a nice area but this is just embarrassing. Can we get some cleanup or something? Thanks.

This intersection has a street light that’s cycling on and off like crazy! It’s super confusing at night and makes crossing really scary. I almost got hit! Please do something about it.

Can someone do something about these street vendors? They were all over the place at the fair today and none of them looked legit, I feel like it’s a total rip-off.

Yo, there's a bird in my building, I swear it's not getting food or water or anything, just sitting in a cage all the time, I feel so bad for it, please send someone to help, it's really not okay!

label: Taxi Complaint. Driver Complaint - Passenger. Cell Phone Use
complaints: Got into a cab today and the driver was just glued to his phone the entire ride! I mean, how am I supposed to feel safe? No wonder we almost hit that cyclist. What's wrong with these people?

I was in a taxi and the driver spent half the ride texting, like do they think we're just okay with this?? It's so unsafe and honestly just so rude to us customers. Get it together guys!

complaints: So, like, I can’t even get to my own front door because this restaurant has their tables all over the sidewalk! I get it, outdoor dining is a vibe but COME ON this is ridiculous!

Ugh! This outdoor dining thing has taken over the whole sidewalk in front of my building. I get that people wanna eat outside but I can’t even open my front door all the way!

label: Sidewalk Condition. Newspaper Box Complaint
complaints: Yo, there's this old newspaper box just sitting on the corner of 3rd and 54th and it's like taking over the sidewalk, I almost tripped over it! Can someone do something about it like now?
Hey, I keep bumping into this newspaper box that's been in the same spot for like forever, you can barely walk past it without squeezing through, it's ridiculous!

So there’s this newspaper box that’s been neglected and it's like a whole mess, rusted and dirty, and it's taking up space where people actually need to walk. Like, can we do better?

complaints: I got into a taxi and the card reader was broken! Tried swiping my card like 10 times and the driver was super rude about it. I had to scramble for cash when I don’t even carry that much! Why can’t they just fix these things?
Jumped into a yellow cab but the payment screen was totally dead, man! Had to dig around in my pockets like a fool for cash. What’s the point of having a card reader if it doesn’t work?

This taxi driver didn’t wanna take me because the card machine wasn’t working. Like, are you kidding me? It’s 2023! They should have their stuff together and not leave people stranded without cash options!

I got in a cab and the credit card machine didn’t work, so I had to get out and wait for another one. It’s ridiculous that they can’t keep their machines functioning! There should be some accountability for this!

label: Consumer Complaint. Home Heating Oil Company. Overcharge
complaints: I can't believe the price I was charged for heating oil this month! It's like they just made up a number, I'm so mad!
Why is my heating oil bill DOUBLE what I paid last month?! This is ridiculous and I'm freezing in my own home, I swear I won't pay this nonsense!

So, I got my heating oil delivery and the price was like a bad joke, how can they justify this outrageous charge? I'm so over it.

label: Sidewalk Condition. Cellar Door Open/Unprotected
complaints: Yo, there's this open cellar door by my building that's just sittin there like an accident waiting to happen. I almost tripped into it the other day! Can someone please close it or put a sign up or something?!
I was walking down the street and almost fell into this unguarded cellar door. Who thought it was okay to leave it open? It's a huge hazard! Can someone check it out? Thanks!

So there’s this cellar door on my block that’s always wide open and like, it’s literally a danger! My kid could fall in or worse, someone could get hurt. I’m really worried about this, pls do something!
Why is there a dangerous open cellar door on the sidewalk? It's right in front of that coffee shop where everyone hangs out. Like, I’m not trying to break my neck trying to get my latte!

label: Animal in a Park. Removing Wildlife. Other
complaints: I was just trying to take my kid to the park and there’s this raccoon literally scaring everyone! It’s out in the open like it owns the place. We can’t even enjoy our picnic!
Every time I go to Central Park there’s these squirrels that follow me around like they want my food, it’s cute but also kind of creepy? Like can we do something about this?
Ugh why are there so many ducks at the playground now? My poor kid can’t even swing without worrying about stepping in duck poop. This is a mess. Please get them outta here.
I love nature and all but the geese are taking over the park near me, it’s like a war zone! They hiss at my dog and it’s just not safe to walk through anymore. Can someone please do something?

label: Consumer Complaint. Hotel or Motel. Fees or Surcharges Not Disclosed
complaints: So I booked a hotel for what I thought was a good deal and when I got there they hit me with all these extra fees like resort fees and service charges?! Like, ugh. Just say that upfront instead of bait and switch!
This hotel was supposed to be $150 a night but then they added all these random fees, I mean come on, just tell people how much it actually costs. I feel ripped off!
Checked in and they like charged me a fee for WiFi, like really? Who charges for that in 2023?? Just be upfront about this stuff, it’s ridiculous!
I thought I was getting a sweet deal at this hotel and then bam! They threw on a bunch of fees at checkout. So annoying, why can’t they just include that in their prices instead of being sneaky?

label: Food Establishment. Plumbing. Plumbing Inadequate
complaints: I went to this restaurant on 5th and got the biggest bellyache, like actually thought I was gonna pass out. The bathroom was a total disaster too, like it hadn't been cleaned in a year! That's just vile, come on people!!
Why is the plumbing in this diner so terrible? I swear every time I try to wash my hands, the water barely dribbles out like some bad fountain. Also, the food was cold and undercooked! Ugh!

So I’m sitting at this cafe on 8th Ave, and the bathroom is out of order AGAIN! What the heck?! I had to run across the street to a bodega. I get they're busy but it’s gross, just fix the plumbing already!

Literally can't even with this place. Ordered takeout and the food was okay but I just went to use the bathroom and the sink wouldn’t work! I had to use hand sanitizer that smells like bad tequila! Not cool, guys.

label: Consumer Complaint. Online or Mail Order. Goods or Services Not Delivered
complaints: I ordered a new winter coat over a month ago and it still hasn’t shown up! I’m freezing and can’t believe I wasted my money on something that was supposed to be here already. Do the delivery people even work??

So I ordered this super cute lamp from some online store and it never arrived. I’ve tried to contact customer service and they keep saying they’re looking into it but no resolution! It’s been like 3 weeks like what even?! People have no sense of urgency these days!
I bought a pair of shoes online, said they would be shipped in 5 days, but it’s been 2 weeks and nada! I’m starting to think I got scammed, the seller doesn’t even reply to my messages! Help!!!

Who do I even complain to about this?? I ordered a birthday gift for my nephew weeks ago and it says DELIVERED but it’s nowhere to be found! I checked with my building's front desk and the neighbors, no clue. Super frustrating, I just want him to have his gift!

label: Water Maintenance. Fire Hydrant Defective
complaints: Hey, why is the fire hydrant on 5th and Main just leaking all over the place? It’s like a mini fountain and I’m pretty sure that’s not how it’s supposed to work! Like, what happens if there’s a fire?
So there’s this fire hydrant on my street that’s totally broken, water is pouring out and this is not only wasteful but a huge liability! I mean, we need our hydrants, am I right?
Ugh, the fire hydrant by the park has been busted for weeks now! It’s making the sidewalk all slippery and gross. Can someone PLEASE get this fixed before someone slips and falls!

There’s a fire hydrant near my building that’s got a constant stream of water flowing out and it’s just a mess! I don’t get how it can be leaking forever like this and it’s so annoying, fix it already!

label: Lost Property. Bag/Wallet. Suitcase
complaints: I lost my black leather backpack somewhere near Central Park yesterday and it had all my stuff in it! I can’t believe I just left it ugh! Someone please find it, I had my laptop and personal things in there!!

So I was on the subway, right? I must have left my red suitcase there when I got off at 42nd street. It had my clothes and very important stuff for my trip! Please help me figure out how to get it back!

I think I left my big blue duffle bag in a cab last night. I was at a bar in the East Village and had a couple of drinks so I can’t remember the damn number, I just need my bag back!!! It’s got all my gym stuff and my favorite shoes!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Pedestrian Sign. Allout
complaints: Hey what the heck is going on at the corner of 5th and Main? The pedestrian signal is totally out! I'm standing here waiting like an idiot and cars are flying past! Can someone please fix this?

Why is the walk signal on 8th street not working? I’m tired of waiting for cars to stop. It’s like nobody cares about us walkers anymore! Fix this please, it’s a safety issue!

label: Damaged Tree. Entire Tree Has Fallen Down. Fell on Vehicle
complaints: Yo there's a whole tree blocking the street and it fell on my car! Like, can you send someone to clean this up ASAP? I can't even get out of my driveway!
This morning I woke up and my neighbor's old tree fell right onto my car. It's wrecked and I'm not sure what to do. Like, who even takes care of these things?
I just came back from work and there's a giant tree on my hatchback! It's a mess out here, please send help before I lose it!
Why is there a huge tree lying in the middle of the street, smushed my poor sedan, this is ridiculous! Someone has to do something about these old trees, they’re just waiting to drop!

label: Animal-Abuse. No Shelter
complaints: There's this dog tied up outside a deli and it looks so sad and cold, I saw him shivering today! What kind of monster does that?! Someone needs to help him, it's just not right!

Can someone do something about the cat I saw left out in the rain by itself? I can't even believe people can be so cruel! It just sat there looking miserable and I couldn't take it home because I already have four! It's unfair!

This lady down the block has her dog tied up outside for hours on end, no shelter, no nothing! It's so wrong and it breaks my heart to see it like that. Someone should step in before something really bad happens!

complaints: I bought a used bike last week from this guy on 3rd Ave, and it’s falling apart! He said it was in great condition, but now the brakes squeak like a horror movie! I feel like I got ripped off, ugh!
