I bought some clothes from this thrift store on 5th street, and the tags say they’re new but they smell like a locker room! Seriously, who cleans this stuff? I’m so disappointed, not coming back!

complaints: My landlord is the worst! I’ve been trying to get my heater fixed for weeks and they just keep saying they’ll send someone but nothing happens! It’s freezing in here and I can't take it anymore!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Snow or Ice. Other
complaints: The sidewalks are a disaster! I fell on my way to work because of all the ice and no one seems to be doing anything about it. C'mon people, it's like a skating rink out here!

complaints: I keep walking by this house on 5th St and there’s this poor dog just chained up outside all day and night like it’s some kind of decoration. It’s freezing out and I can hear it barking and whining. Someone please do something. It breaks my heart!

label: Water Maintenance. Fire Hydrant Leaking
complaints: Hey, so like, there’s this fire hydrant on 5th and Main that’s leaking like crazy. I walked by it this morning and it’s just gushing everywhere. Kinda dangerous right?

label: Unsanitary Animal Facility. Animal Odor

Bought a pair of shoes that ended up hurting my feet like crazy, tried to return them but they wouldn’t let me! They said it was “worn” but I only walked around my living room in them! I feel scammed, I don’t have money to throw away!

label: Animal-Abuse. Chained

label: Taxi Complaint. Vehicle Complaint. Broken/Missing Equipment
complaints: I got into a yellow cab and the seatbelt was totally ripped, I mean what kinda safety is that??!! I want my money back because that’s just ridiculous, who even checks these cabs?
Yesterday I had the worst ride, the cab was dirty, like I’m talkin’ trash on the floor and the windows were so smeared I could barely see outside! At least clean up your car, it’s not that hard!
The taxi driver was super rude and the meter wasn’t working right, it just kept going up and up and I’m like where’s your logic? Also, he had the music blasting and I couldn’t even think!
Why is it that every time I get in a cab the AC is either frozen or blasting hot air? Can’t anyone just get it right for once? I’m sweating like crazy in the back seat!

label: Broken Parking Meter. Timer Defect - Fast/Fail
complaints: Hey, this parking meter on 5th Ave by the deli is wack! It keeps eating my money and I can’t even park for the full time. I put in coins and it only gives me like 5 min! It’s so frustrating; I can’t get anything done!

Just wanted to let ya know that this meter on 46th St is broken. I put in a dollar and it doesn’t give me any time! I was running late for work and now I’m stuck somewhere with no tickets left! Ugh! Fix it please!
I parked near Central Park and the meter was all messed up. I thought I had more time but it just started blinking like crazy after I paid. Now I’m getting a ticket for no reason! What gives?

Can someone please check the parking meter on 8th Ave? It charged me for only 10 minutes after I put in a whole five bucks! This is ridiculous! I’m gonna end up late to my appointment because of this. So annoying!

label: Industrial Waste. Oil Spill Into Basin/Sewer - Large (IABL). Iabl
complaints: Hey, there’s this huge oil spill down by the pier, it’s like a slick of black goo all over the water, can’t be good for the fish or whatever is living in there. I saw some guy slip on it, too! C’mon, do something about this!

Ugh, I think there’s an oil spill or something in the basin by my apartment, it smells awful and looks disgusting. My kids won’t even go near there and who can blame them! Just gross, please send someone ASAP!

So I was walking my dog near the river and I saw this shiny oily stuff all over the surface, like, it’s totally ruining the view and probably harming the environment! Can someone clean this up before it’s a bigger mess? Thanks!

Seriously, there’s this big oil stain in the water near the docks, and it’s been there for days. I don’t even wanna think about what’s happening to the wildlife. It’s a serious problem and it’s just sitting there. Get on it, please!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Snow or Ice. Bike Path/Greenways
complaints: Yo, why is the bike path all icy and stuff? I nearly wiped out yesterday trying to get to work. I can't believe it hasn't been cleared. Just a little salt, please?!
The bike lanes are a disaster, covered in slush and ice like no one cares! I got splashed by a bus and now I got wet socks. Can someone do their job and fix this?
What’s with all the snow on the bike path? It’s like a freakin’ obstacle course out there! Can we get some snow removal? My friends think I’m crazy for even trying to bike in this weather.
I almost fell on my bike today - the whole bike lane is a sheet of ice! Seriously, this isn’t a winter wonderland, it’s a winter nightmare. Help a cyclist out, please!

label: Broken Parking Meter. Bent/Loose
complaints: The parking meter on 5th and Main is totally bent over, like, how am I supposed to park here? Can't even get my money in. So frustrating!
Yo, there's this parking meter by my apartment that won't take my quarters, it just eats them like a hungry hippo and doesn’t give me a ticket. I'm gonna lose my spot because of it!
Ugh, the parking meter on 7th Ave is super loose and tilting! I can barely get my change in! I’m tired of lugging groceries only to find the meter's broken!
Hey, can someone fix the parking meter on Green Street? It's all wobbly and crooked, making it hard to use and I’m tired of waiting to find out if I can park there or not.

label: Bus Stop Shelter Complaint. Lighting
complaints: Hey, can someone fix the lighting at the bus stop on 5th Ave? It’s super dark there, I feel like I’m taking my life in my hands just waiting for the bus, and I’m always scared someone’s gonna jump out at me, it’s just not right!
Ugh, the bus stop on 42nd street is like a black hole at night. No lights, no nothing. I'm tired of waiting in the dark like I'm in a horror movie. Can we please get some lights? Thanks.

I was waiting for the B train at the stop by Union Square and I couldn’t even see my hand in front of my face! It's ridiculous, I’ve almost missed my bus twice now because I can’t tell when it’s coming. This is a safety issue!

Look, I’m all for saving energy but the lights at the East 34th street bus stop are basically nonexistent. I felt like I was waiting in a basement or something. Can we get some normal lighting, PLEASE?

label: Consumer Complaint. Newsstand. Unlicensed
complaints: Yo, there's this newsstand on the corner of 42nd and 8th that looks super sketchy. They sell all kinds of stuff and ain't got no license. I swear I've seen stuff there that shouldn't even be sold. Can someone check it out?

This newsstand is not legit! It's like they just set up without any permits. The owner is rude and unhelpful too, always on his phone and ignoring customers. I'm tired of walking by and seeing this nonsense every day!

I think that newsstand at 45th street is operating without a license. They got no sign, no nothing. It's just crazy how they can sell whatever they want. Can someone do something about it, please? It’s literally in front of my apartment!

Why is there this pop-up newsstand in my neighborhood? The guy has no license or anything and I’m pretty sure he’s selling pirated DVDs or somethin'. It just feels wrong, can someone do a proper check on these guys?

label: Lost Property. Other. Passport
complaints: I lost my passport somewhere in the subway, like I was on the F train and now I can’t find it. I’m freaking out because I need it for a trip next week. Can someone help me?!
Ugh, I can’t believe I left my passport at that coffee shop on 39th and 8th, it was so busy and I just totally forgot it. Please, if anyone sees it, I need it back ASAP!
So I was at the airport and I think I left my passport at the security check point or something, like seriously what is wrong with me? I need to find out if it’s turned in. This is a disaster!
I was running around all day and could've sworn I had my passport in my bag but now it’s gone! I might have dropped it at the park or at the deli. Can someone look around for it? I’m so stressed!

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Plumbing. Plumbing Inadequate
complaints: There’s this hot dog cart outside my building and it smells sooo bad, like rotten onions or something! Can't even walk past without gagging, this is New York not a trash can!

Can you please do something about the food trucks nearby? They have no proper plumbing and all the water just drains into the street! It’s like a mini lake of grossness, and I swear the rats are having a party.

I can’t even deal with the number of food vendors around here, they’re all parking near my apartment and it’s like a plumbing nightmare! My neighbor said something’s leaking from one of their sinks, it smells awful! Do people not have toilets?

The taco truck on 2nd Ave, I love their food but the way they have their plumbing set up is disgusting, it’s like a horror movie. There’s always water pooling and it just sits there, attracting all kinds of bugs. Please fix this!

label: Food Establishment. Dishwashing/Utensils. Not Cleaned/Stored Properly
complaints: I just went to that new taco place on 3rd Ave and I gotta say, the plates were grimy like they haven’t seen a dishwasher in weeks. Totally turned me off and I left!
Can you believe the utensils at that diner on 5th? I swear they served me a fork covered in dried food! Like, how hard is it to wash dishes properly?
So I ordered takeout from that pasta place down the block and the container was sticky and the knife had bits of something crusty on it. Not cool, people!
I went to that cafe on the corner and the cups looked like they’d been through a war. Dirty and stained, I didn’t even wanna drink my coffee! What’s wrong with you guys?

label: Consumer Complaint. Other Store (Non-Food). Price Not Posted or Inaccurate
complaints: I was just in that little store on 5th and 42nd and the prices are all over the place! I picked up a shirt that was marked $15 but was charged $25 at the register. Like, what’s going on?

Went to buy a pair of shoes at that boutique near Astor Place and they didn’t have any prices on half of them! I felt like I was in a guessing game and it’s super annoying when you’re just trying to shop!
I can’t believe how sketchy that shop on 14th street is – prices on the racks don’t match what they ring up at checkout. I feel like I’m getting robbed! They really need to fix that.
Last week I bought a jacket from that trendy spot on the LES and it said $40 but when I paid it was $60! Like, how is that legal? Just be honest about your prices, it’s not that hard.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Unsecured Facility. Building/Facility Unlocked
complaints: I just walked by the community center and the front door was wide open!!! It’s 10 PM!!! What kind of safety is that?? Anyone could just walk in and do anything! Plz fix it ASAP!
Hey, I’m on my way to the park and I saw that the gym doors are unlocked. Like, who’s in charge of this place? It’s been like this for days, someone’s gonna walk in and steal stuff or worse!
I left my apartment just now and saw that the basement entrance for my building is not locked. Are we even safe here? Can someone please lock the door?
Why is the rec center door still not locked? I went there this morning and it’s just open, ANYONE could get in there. This is getting ridiculous, it’s a safety hazard, seriously!

label: Outside Building. Roof Door/Hatch. Leaking
complaints: So tired of the water dripping from the roof hatch every time it rains! Like, can we get a solution here? It’s ruining the hallway and smells like mildew now. Ugh!
There’s a leak coming from the roof door again, I thought this was fixed already last summer. I guess not... Anyway, can someone please do something about this before it gets worse?
The roof door is leaking nonstop and it’s like a mini waterfall in the stairwell. My shoes are soaked every time I go outside. Not cool!
I can’t deal with this leaking roof hatch in my building no more. Water just pouring down and making everything gross. It’s been like this for weeks!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Aps. Hanging
complaints: Yo, the traffic light at 5th and Main is just hanging there like nobody's business! It's a miracle nobody's crashed yet, can someone fix this before it becomes a disaster?
I can't believe this light is still broken! It’s been hanging weirdly for days now. I swear, cars are just flying through the intersection and it’s super unsafe! Get it together out there!
Seriously, there’s a light that’s dangling over the intersection on Broadway and 42nd, and it’s like a game of chicken every time you cross. I’ve almost been hit like three times!
Ugh! The traffic signal at 3rd and Elm is not only hanging but half of it doesn't even light up! What is going on! I feel like I'm playing Frogger every time I wanna cross the street!

label: Consumer Complaint. Process Server. Goods or Services Not Delivered
complaints: I ordered this fancy espresso machine like a month ago and it never showed up! I called the company and they keep telling me it’s on its way but do they even know WHERE it is? It’s ridiculous, I paid a lot of money for it, and my mornings are a mess without my coffee!

So I bought a new laptop from this sketchy site and they promised 3-5 shipping days. It’s been almost two weeks and no updates! I’ve sent multiple emails and they don’t reply. I just want my laptop and my money back if they aren’t going to deliver!

Listen, if I wanted to be let down, I’d watch my team play on game night! Ordered some concert tickets and they said they were shipped but that was last week and still nothing in my inbox! I’m freaking out because the concert is in 3 days!

I don't usually complain, but I ordered a book for a school project weeks ago and it said it was delivered but I never got it! I even checked with my neighbors! This is super frustrating because it’s for a big assignment and deadlines are real!

label: Lost Property. Clothing/Glasses. Coat
complaints: I just realized I left my favorite green coat at the coffee shop on 5th Ave, like how could I forget that?? I really need it back, it's getting cold out here!
Hey, so I lost my coat at the subway station last night, it’s black and kinda worn out but I loved it. If anyone finds it, I will literally give them a hug!
Ugh, I think I left my coat at that bar in the East Village after trivia last night. It's this old denim thing, I really hope someone didn't just take it. I'm gonna freak out if I can't find it!
I can't believe I lost my coat, it's this cool olive green thing and I left it somewhere around Union Square but can't remember where exactly. If anyone sees it, please help a girl out!

label: Consumer Complaint. Car Wash. Overcharge
complaints: I went to this car wash to get a simple wash and they charged me an extra $50 for some 'deluxe package' without even asking me first! What a scam, never going back there again!
Ugh, what is with these car wash places? They always seem to have hidden fees. I just wanted to clean my car, not take out a loan. Way too expensive for just a wash!
So I went to this car wash and they told me $20 for a wash but when I got in there, they charged me $35 and I was so confused! Like what happened to the original price??
I feel ripped off! Paid way more than expected for a 'premium wash' and honestly, my car doesn’t even look that great. Just a waste of money, I'm really mad about it.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Graffiti or Vandalism. Restroom/Comfort Station
complaints: I cannot believe the bathroom in the park looks like a war zone, like seriously who cleans this place? There's graffiti everywhere and it smells like something died in there. Fix it, please!

So I went to use the restrooms in Central Park and wow, just wow. They're covered in spray paint, toilet paper everywhere, and it looks like nobody has cared for ages. It’s embarrassing for the city, can we get some maintenance in here?

Why is it that every time I come to this park the bathroom is disgusting? It’s covered in junk, graffiti all over the walls, and the toilets are just gross. I brought my kids here to enjoy the day, not to deal with this mess.

I was just at the community park and I had to use the restroom but OMG it was the dirtiest thing I have ever seen! Graffiti everywhere, no toilet paper, and it just felt so unsafe. Can we please clean this up?

label: BEST/Site Safety. Safety Netting/Guard Rails - Damaged/Inadequate/None (Over 6 Stories/75 Feet)
complaints: There’s no safety netting on this scaffolding and I swear if someone falls I’m gonna lose it! I walk by it every day with my kid and it’s a disaster waiting to happen. Fix it already!
I live on 23rd St and there’s this construction site next door that’s got broken guard rails everywhere. Like seriously, how is it even legal? It’s super dangerous! Someone’s gonna get hurt!
So this construction thing on 5th Ave has like zero safety netting whatsoever! I can’t believe they’re allowed to work like this, it’s just reckless, I don’t want bricks falling on my head or worse!

This scaffolding on the corner of 14th Street is a total mess, the guard rails are falling apart, and I’m just waiting for the day that someone trips or a chunk of it falls off. Get it together people!

label: Bike Rack. Missing
complaints: Hey, where did the bike rack go on 3rd Ave and 12th St? I usually park there and now I got nowhere to lock my bike, it’s super annoying!!

Can someone tell me if the bike rack on 8th St and Avenue C is just missing or what? I came back and there’s nothing but a sad empty space, and I’m freaking out about my bike getting stolen!
Why is there no bike rack on Park Ave near the library? I mean I get it, people need to park their bikes! I don’t want to carry it around when I just wanna grab a book! Ugh.

label: Flooring/Stairs. Stairs. Landing Platform Broken
complaints: The landing at the top of the stairs is like a war zone, I nearly tripped over yesterday! Can someone please fix it before someone gets hurt?
Yo, the landing up here is all cracked and it's like a trap waiting to happen. I’m just trying to get to my apartment without breaking my ankle, someone needs to do something!
Why is nobody fixing the broken landing platform at the top of the stairs? It’s been like this for ages and I’m so sick of dodging pieces of concrete every day!
Seriously, the landing is a disaster like it's falling apart or something. I'm not going to be the next person to fall down those stairs, get it together!

label: Plumbing. Sewer. Broken Or Blocked Drain
complaints: Hey, I don't know who to call but my kitchen sink is completely clogged and now smellin' really bad like rotten eggs, this ain't livin' I can't cook or wash anything!
Ughhh, the drain in my bathroom is totally blocked, I tried plunging it but now the water just sits there! Can someone please help before it overflows?!
So gross! There's this sewage smell in my apartment, I think the pipes are messed up or something. I can't take it anymore! Need it fixed ASAP, I got kids here!
My shower won't drain at all, it's been like this for days now and I'm just standing in dirty water! I'm really over it, please send someone to take a look.

label: Sidewalk Condition. Sidewalk Staircase
complaints: Yo, these stairs on my block are a total joke!! They got cracks and it’s like walking on a death trap, seriously. I almost fell last week and I got a bad back already. Someone needs to fix this ASAP!

Why are the steps at the end of my street so uneven? I’m pretty sure I twisted my ankle walking down them yesterday. Can we please get someone to come check it out or something? It’s like a minefield over here!

Ugh, how come nobody cares about the stairs on 5th Ave? They’re all chipped and it’s super dangerous for kids and old people! I don’t want to see anyone get hurt because of this, can someone do their job??

The staircase outside my apartment is such a mess, there are cracks everywhere and it's getting worse. I swear I’m gonna trip and fall and break my neck any day now. Come on, please fix this already before we have a serious accident!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Cable. Operating Improperly
complaints: Yo feels like the traffic light at 5th and 34th is stuck on red forever! I've missed two light changes now and it's super dangerous out here. Can someone check it out?
That light by the subway entrance at 42nd is always malfunctioning! Like, why does it just blink yellow randomly? It’s chaos trying to cross!
Listen, I'm trying to get to work and that signal at Broadway keeps going out. I'm tired of dodging cars and praying I don’t get hit. Fix it already!
Honestly, I think the signal at 8th Ave is broken. It's either green for 2 seconds or red for an eternity, and it’s causing all kinds of traffic. Does anyone even check these things?

complaints: I just saw the filthy D rating on my fave Chinese takeout place and I’m seriously shocked! That place has the best dumplings!!! How can they be rated like that? I’ve been eating there for years and now I’m questioning my life choices, smh.

Why is this pizza place listed with a B when I’ve seen roaches crawling around in the kitchen?! I’m never gonna eat there again and I think everyone should know about their dirty hidden secrets, it ain’t right!

Okay, so like, I just checked the rating for this coffee shop I go to every morning and they have an A but I swear I saw a rat scurrying around! Makes me wonder if they’re playin’ with the truth, I mean c’mon people, get your stuff together!

I’m really annoyed because I thought this deli was clean, they always have a line out the door but just found out they were rated a C?! How is that even possible?? What gives?! I’m not risking it anymore!!

label: Consumer Complaint. Other Store (Non-Food). Receipt Inaccurate, Incomplete, or Not Given
complaints: I went to that new electronics store on 5th Ave and the cashier didn’t even give me a receipt!! I mean how am I supposed to keep track of my purchases? This is ridiculous!

Bought a phone charger yesterday and the lady just tossed the receipt in the bag but it was all crumpled and half unreadable!! I need to return it but now I can't even tell if I paid the right price, what a mess!

Hey I just went to that shop on 34th Street and I didn’t get a receipt for my stuff, like are they even allowed to do that? I can't return this sweater now if it doesn't fit, what kind of store is this?
Why do I never get receipts anymore?! Went to that boutique last week and they said they were outta paper or something? I can’t believe it, now I can’t return an ugly dress I thought I liked. UGH.

label: Lot Condition. Construction Debris
complaints: Yo there's a bunch of junk and construction crap just lying around on 5th Ave like an eyesore! It’s driving me nuts, can’t even walk without tripping over something, get it cleaned up!

Ugh! The site on Broadway has more leftover trash than an apocalypse movie set! Why is no one cleaning this up? It’s been weeks and it’s disgusting! Can’t believe I have to dodge nails and broken bricks just to get to the coffee shop.

complaints: Yo, there’s a huge branch dangling from this tree in front of my building and it’s like just hanging over the power lines. If it falls I’m pretty sure it could take out the whole block! What’s going on?

Listen, there’s a tree on 5th Ave that looks like it’s about to drop a limb. It’s cracked and barely hanging on! It’s also tangled in some wires, and I’m freaking out it’s gonna cause a blackout or worse. Can someone deal with this before it falls on someone?

There’s a big branch hanging by a thread from the tree near my apartment. It’s literally resting on the electrical wires! I swear like every time the wind blows I get a mini heart attack. Please take a look before it causes some disaster.

So, there’s this tree that’s clearly hurtin’ – one of the branches is just hanging there, it’s cracked and it’s caught in the wires. It’s like an accident waiting to happen! Can someone come check it out before it comes crashing down? Thanks!

label: Consumer Complaint. Pedicab. Overcharge
complaints: So I took a pedicab from Central Park to Times Square and the guy tried to charge me 50 bucks! Are you kidding me? It’s like a 10 minute ride. This is insane!

I feel like I got totally ripped off by a pedicab driver today. He quoted me one price and when we got to my destination he tried to charge me like double! I was in a rush so I just gave him the cash but I’m mad about it.
Yesterday I was in Manhattan and took a pedicab and the driver was super aggressive with the pricing. He said it was $20 but then wanted $40 at the end! Like how does that even make sense?!

I flagged down a pedicab in the Village and the driver was cool until we finished the ride, then he slapped on an extra fee like I wasn't already paying way too much. Not cool at all, felt like I was being taken advantage of.

label: Highway Sign - Damaged. Other/Unknown
complaints: Hey, there’s a sign on the highway that’s all bent and twisted, it looks like it got hit by a truck or something. Totally can’t read it, like what if someone needs directions?
Seriously, why is there a damaged sign on the road? It’s like, hanging by a thread! I almost crashed trying to read it while driving. Can someone fix this before it causes an accident?
I just drove past that messed up sign near the exit on I-95 and omg it’s practically hanging off the pole, how is that safe? People are gonna get lost!
The highway sign on the FDR right near the Manhattan Bridge is all cracked and broken, I thought it was gonna fall off! Can’t believe nobody’s noticed this yet.

label: Consumer Complaint. Games of Chance. Unlicensed
complaints: So like I was walking through the park and saw this whole group of people playing some kinda lottery or something? Like, it felt super sketchy and I don’t think they have a license or whatever. I just don’t think it’s fair to let them do that without any permission. Can someone check it out?

I swear there was this dude at the corner of 2nd and 3rd trying to sell me some fake raffle tickets or something, it was so weird. I didn’t even want to get near him but he kept shouting and making it sound all legit like what the heck?! Someone needs to put a stop to these shady games!

Yo there’s this underground card game at my building like every Saturday night, and it’s loud AF! I mean, I love a good game but these guys just throw cash around like there’s no tomorrow, and I can’t even sleep! What’s with the no licenses? It’s gonna end up getting someone in trouble sooner or later!

I don’t know who is running this scam in the neighborhood but I keep seeing these pop-up gambling games in the local bar. I’m talking serious cash being thrown around and it’s totally unregulated, not to mention the noise and the drunk people spilling out on the street. Can someone do something before it gets crazy?

complaints: Why is there a whole BBQ pit in the playground?? I just took my kid to play and there's smoke everywhere and people grilling hot dogs right next to the swings. Can someone please do something about this?? It's gross and dangerous!

I can't believe people are allowed to set up a grill beside the slide! That's just insane. My kids can't even use the swings without smelling like charcoal. This is a park for kids not a backyard BBQ!

Yo, I don't know who thinks it's cool to have a cookout in the playground but it needs to stop. It's not safe for the kids and it's super messy. I don't want my kid breathing in that smoke while they’re trying to play. Just disgusting!

Seriously, why do people think it’s okay to BBQ in the playground? I had to move my kids away from the grill and they were upset. It’s supposed to be a fun spot for them, not a place where we have to dodge smoke and hot coals. Come on!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Sgnl Mult Lamps. Allout
complaints: The traffic light at 5th and Main is totally out! Cars just zooming through and it’s super dangerous, like come on!
What’s with the traffic signal at 42nd St? The lights don’t even work! People are backing up into each other – it’s chaos! Fix it already!
Hey, so the light at Broadway and 23rd is completely blacked out and it’s like a free-for-all out there. Someone’s gonna get hurt! Can’t believe it’s been like this for over a week!
The signal on 8th Ave is broken, like nothing is happening and cars are just going whenever they feel like it. I can’t even cross the street, it’s madness. Please do something about it!

complaints: I went to this pawn shop last week and bought a watch that was supposed to work fine but it’s broken! I tried to return it and the guy said no returns! Like what kind of store does that??? So frustrating!

Crazy situation! I bought a guitar there and it looked good but turns out it’s all warped and unplayable. I asked to exchange it and they acted like I was trying to scam them or something! They don’t care about customers. I just want my money back!

Y’all ever deal with that pawn shop on Broadway? I bought a camera and it doesn’t work! I go back to return it and they tell me all sales final! How do you sell broken stuff and not let people return it? So mad right now!

label: Building Marshal's Office. Tenant Safety Inspection
complaints: So I live in a bldg where the fire escape is soooo rusted I can't even believe its legal, like what if there's a fire? We all gonna die in here?! It's been like that for months and nobody cares!

Ugh, my neighbors are loud and I feel like the building managers don't give a crap about tenant safety. I've seen sketchy people hanging around at all hours and I'm just trying to live my life without worrying about getting robbed or something. Can someone please step up?

Okay, listen, I have this bill that says I owe money but I’ve already paid it! It’s driving me nuts! I called them but they just keep sending me in circles – I don’t have time for this, I’m a single mom trying to work!

complaints: Yo, there’s this construction site next to my apartment and they just leave materials all over the sidewalk! It’s like an obstacle course out here, my kids could trip and fall over those huge metal beams! So freakin dangerous!
I don’t know who’s in charge of that building going up on 5th Ave but my goodness, they’ve got lumber and tools just lying around all over the place. How is that even allowed?

complaints: The traffic light on Main St. and 5th Ave is totally out! I almost got hit trying to cross. Can someone please fix this before someone gets hurt?
Yo the light at Park Ave is just blinking yellow and cars don’t know what to do. It’s chaos over here, people just running red lights, I swear.
I’ve been waiting at that intersection for like 10 mins and the light isn’t changing. It’s like it forgot to exist or something, I’m late for work!
Can someone check the light at 42nd St? It’s been stuck on red forever and it’s like a game of chicken out here with drivers just blowing through. This is ridiculous.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Junction Box. Open
complaints: Yo, there's this open junction box at the corner of 5th and Main, and it’s been like that for DAYS!! It looks crazy dangerous, like someone’s gonna trip or worse! Can someone please close it up before someone gets hurt?!

I don't know what is going on with that traffic signal box at 42nd & Broadway but it's wide open and I swear I saw a rat crawling in and out of it! This is disgusting and I don't wanna be standing near that when the signal changes!
Hey! There’s an open junction box by the subway entrance on 14th street and I keep worrying that kids are gonna mess with it. Can you get someone out there to fix it? Like yesterday would be great!

I just passed by the traffic signal box on 23rd and 8th and it’s totally open. I mean, couldn’t someone just walk by and stick their hand in there? It’s really not safe. Can you send someone to check it out?

label: Consumer Complaint. Other Store (Non-Food). Tare Weight
complaints: I just bought a bag of flour from that small shop on 3rd and Elm, and the tare weight was totally off! I weighed it at home and it was like 2 pounds more than it should be, what the heck?! I feel like I'm getting ripped off here, this is not okay!

Why is it that every time I go to that corner store they charge me extra for stuff? I bought some snacks and they said it was the tare weight but it just feels like they’re scamming me. So frustrating! Can’t even trust them to weigh stuff right!

I’m so annoyed! I bought a package of nuts and they didn’t subtract the tare weight, like, come on! It’s 2023, how hard is it to get this right? I should’ve just checked before leaving but who thinks they’re gonna be cheated at a local shop? Ugh!

Seriously can someone check on that place on Broadway? I was charged for a container that wasn’t weighed right, and it was so much more than it should’ve been! I don’t even know if this is a common thing there but it feels super shady and I’m not going back.

label: Taxi Compliment. Driver Compliment. Courteous/Kind/Polite
complaints: I just had the most amazing cab ride! Driver was so polite, like wow, he actually asked me how my day was instead of just staring at the street. A+ from me!
Shout out to the driver I had earlier today, he helped me with my bag and was just super nice the whole ride! Like, it’s rare to find someone so friendly in a cab, made my day!
This morning I took a taxi and the driver was seriously the best! So nice, talked to me the whole way and even gave me directions when I didn’t know where to go. Can we have more drivers like him?
I had a cab guy today who was just so polite, I can't even! He was like a breath of fresh air in this city full of stress. Gave me some great tips about places to eat too, really appreciate that!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Broken Glass. Playground Equipment
complaints: Hey, I was at the park on 5th and 2nd and saw broken glass all over the playground! My kids love it there but now I can't let them play! It's a safety hazard and someone is gonna get hurt! Can someone please clean it up like NOW?

This is insane, there’s shattered glass near the swings in that little playground by the community center. I didn’t even realize it until my friend pointed it out! What kind of oversight is this? I thought parks were supposed to be safe! Please fix this ASAP!

Why is there glass scattered around the sandbox in the neighborhood playground? My neighbors and I are seriously freaking out about it. I have no idea how long it’s been there but it’s super dangerous!! Need someone to check it out immediately! Thanks!

So, I took my toddlers to play at the playground by the library and there’s broken glass everywhere like, what the heck?! I can’t even let them play properly! This is ridiculous, fix it before someone cuts themselves!

label: Consumer Complaint. Electronics Store. Overcharge
complaints: I bought a laptop for $999, but my bank statement shows they charged me $1,199!! What the heck is going on? Not cool at all!
Went to this electronics store to grab a TV and they charged me more than what was on the tag! Now I gotta spend all this time trying to fix their mess? Ugh!
I can't believe I got charged extra for headphones that were supposed to be on sale! Like how hard is it to stick to the price on the shelf?!
Just got my credit card bill and they added like $200 to my order that I never agreed to! This is ridiculous, I'm so angry right now!

label: Violation of Park Rules. Obstructing Public Use. Court/Field/Rink
complaints: Why is there a bunch of people playing soccer on the basketball court?! Like, that’s not even a real court anymore, it’s just chaos! The poor kids can’t even shoot hoops because of these adults taking over, come on!

Just walked by the park and it’s FULL of people having a cookout on the playground! Like, is this allowed? There are kids trying to play, and it smells like burnt hot dogs, it’s disgusting! Please make them clean it up!
Every weekend this place is overrun by folks playing frisbee or whatever on the only tennis courts, it’s so annoying! Can’t you get a sign or something? I want to serve not dodge a flying disc! UGH!

I really love my evenings at the park but whyyy are there always these big groups blocking the paths, playing weird games and making it hard to get anywhere? I’m just trying to relax, not fight my way through a crowd!

label: Consumer Complaint. Gas Station Pumps. Broken Machine Not Labeled
complaints: Yo, I just went to the gas station on 5th and like, half the pumps are broken and the damn signs didn't say anything about it! I was there forever figuring it out, super annoying! Like, what’s the point of pumps if they don't even work??

Seriously, I just wasted 30 minutes trying to figure out why I couldn't get gas. The pump at the corner station is totally broken and no one has the decency to put a label on it. Super frustrating when you're in a rush!
I’m so pissed off right now! I went to fill up my tank and pump 3 was out of order but they didn’t say anything until I was all set up to pay. Waste of time, like at least put a sign or something!

What the heck is going on with the gas pumps near me? I tried to use one and it was all broken, zero notifications anywhere. I almost gave up and walked away. Someone needs to fix that ASAP, it’s really sketchy!

label: Water Maintenance. Water Main Break
complaints: There's water gushing like a fountain on 5th Ave, it's crazy! I thought it was raining but no, just a broken pipe or something. Can someone please fix it? My shoes are soaked!

Hey, what's up with the water main break on 23rd Street? It's been spraying everywhere for hours now. I'm scared it's gonna flood the subway station. Can't believe I almost slipped trying to walk my dog past it.
OMG there's a huge puddle on my block, I mean like a small lake. I don't know what's going on but it's ruining my day and my commute! Pls send someone ASAP before it gets worse!
I can't believe this water main break on my street, it's in front of my building and the noise is driving me nuts! And now I gotta dodge all this water when I go out. It's been like this all day!

label: Consumer Complaint. Door to Door Sales. Purpose of Visit Not Stated
complaints: So these people just knocked on my door selling who knows what, didn’t even say what they’re selling and just kept talking like I should let them in or something. I was in the middle of Netflix and they totally messed up my vibe!

Seriously, I had this guy come to my apartment and he looked sketchy as heck, just started talking about some weird vacuum or something and wouldn’t leave until I said no like 10 times. Do I really have to put up with this in my own home?

Why are there so many door to door salespeople in my building all of a sudden? It’s annoying and I feel like I’m being harassed. Can’t they just get a regular job instead of bothering us? Like just let me be in peace!

I just had this lady ring my bell trying to sell me some cleaning products I don’t need. I mean, who even does this anymore? I told her I wasn’t interested and she kept pushing! It’s super frustrating, like I don’t want to be rude but come on!

label: Obstruction. Donation Collection Bin. Sidewalk
complaints: So there's this huge donation bin just sitting on the sidewalk in front of my building! Like come on, it’s blocking the whole pathway, and I’m trying to get out with my stroller! What are we even supposed to do, climb over it?

I don’t know who put this giant donation box on our sidewalk but it needs to be moved ASAP! It’s not only an eyesore but also making it super hard for people to walk by especially when it’s busy. Ridiculous!
Why is there a donation bin just taking up space on the sidewalk? It’s literally impossible to walk past it without bumping into it, and it’s an accident waiting to happen. Ugh!
Can someone please do something about the donation box that’s just chillin' on the sidewalk? It’s always in the way and it’s super annoying. Been there for weeks and it’s just a big ol' block!

label: Consumer Complaint. Barber Shop, Beauty Salon, or Nail Salon. Price Not Posted or Inaccurate
complaints: So I walked into this salon on 5th Ave and asked for a simple haircut, they said it would be $30, but when I went to pay they charged me $50! Like are you kidding me? Where's the price list? This is ridiculous!

I just got my nails done at that place on 42nd St. and they didn't tell me the price until I was done and it was like WAY more than what I expected. Honestly, I'm just trying to get a mani without being ripped off, is that too much to ask?

I went to get my hair colored at this spot in Brooklyn and they didn't even mention the price until they started. Ended up being $100 more than what I thought I'd pay! I feel so cheated right now, like do they think we're made of money?

Just left that new nail salon on 8th Ave. and they didn’t have any prices listed! I asked, they told me one thing, but when I got to the register it was a whole different number. Just a heads up, I won’t be back there.

label: Consumer Complaint. Gas Station Convenience Store. Receipt Inaccurate, Incomplete, or Not Given
complaints: So I went to this gas station on 5th ave yesterday and filled up my tank, but when I asked for a receipt the guy just kinda shrugged and said he can't give me one! What is that about? I need it for my expense report or something, super frustrating!
I bought snacks and gas at the corner station and they didn’t give me a receipt! Like how am I supposed to keep track of my spending? This is the second time it’s happened at the same place!

Seriously, I went to the gas station on Broadway and the clerk was just all over the place. I filled my tank and he didn’t even print a receipt! I asked for one and he said they were out of paper! What kind of gas station runs out of receipt paper??

I’m losing my mind here, got gas this morning and the jerk behind the counter didn’t give me a receipt. How do I know I even paid what I was supposed to? I swear this place needs a better system or someone who knows what they’re doing.

label: Consumer Complaint. Home Improvement Contractor. Goods or Services Not Delivered
complaints: I hired this contractor to renovate my bathroom and he's just vanished! I paid half upfront and now I can't get him on the phone. Like, did he just take my money and run?
So, I contracted this dude to do my kitchen, he said it would take two weeks and it’s been over a month! No cabinets, no communication, nothing. I’m over here living off takeout because I can’t cook!
I don't wanna name names but this contractor promised me the world and didn't deliver even a piece of it! They took a deposit and then just stopped showing up, like what is even happening?

I got a painter to do my living room and he left paint splatters all over my floors, didn’t even finish the job, and now he won't respond to texts! I’m seriously thinking about just getting a refund but I doubt he'll even give me my money back.

label: Illegal Posting. Sticker or Decal. Fire Hydrant
complaints: Hey, I just walked past a fire hydrant on 3rd Ave and there's a huge sticker on it! Like, who thinks that's okay? This isn't a billboard, people! Can someone please deal with this?

So there’s this random decal plastered all over the fire hydrant near my building, it’s gross and kinda dangerous if there's a fire and they can’t get to it! Ugh, can’t people just leave things alone? Just had to rant!
There’s a sticker on the fire hydrant on 14th St and it’s like totally blocking the view of it. What if there’s an emergency? Why are people so inconsiderate?
Can we talk about the fire hydrant on 5th Ave? It’s covered in this weird ad sticker. It looks bad and literally covers the hydrant! This city is a mess sometimes. Please fix it ASAP!

label: Consumer Complaint. Hotel or Motel. Panic Buttons Not Provided to Workers
complaints: I just cannot believe that these hotels don't even provide panic buttons for their staff! Like, what if something goes wrong? It's crazy to think employees are literally walking around in dangerous situations with no help available. This is so messed up!

Is it just me or is it seriously ridiculous that hotel workers don't have panic buttons? I stayed at a place last week and saw how stressed the staff was dealing with obnoxious guests. Not cool at all, just so unsafe!

Just a thought but if hotel staff have no panic buttons, how can we expect them to feel safe? I overheard a worker saying they feel like they’re in a ticking time bomb especially when working the night shift. What’s going on?

This is absurd! Hotels in this city really need to step it up, giving workers no panic buttons is just inviting trouble. So many crazy people out there and workers gotta fend for themselves! Let's do better people!

label: Taxi Report. Driver Report - Passenger. Unsafe Driving
complaints: I just got out of the cab and I am literally shaking. The driver was swerving all over the place like a maniac, made me feel like I was in a rollercoaster or something. I don’t even know how I got home in one piece!

I took a yellow cab today and omg, the driver was speeding, tailgating, and not even stopping at red lights! What the heck?! It was the scariest ride of my life. Please do something about these drivers, it’s a serious safety hazard!

This taxi driver was driving like he was in a Fast and Furious movie! I was scared for my life, he was weaving in & out of traffic and honking at everyone. I don’t think I’ve ever held onto my seatbelt so tight!

I don’t wanna complain but this cab ride was wild, like, the driver was going so fast I thought we’d crash! Plus they were texting while driving, which is super dangerous. Can’t believe I made it home in one piece!

label: Consumer Complaint. Electronics Store. Price Not Posted or Inaccurate
complaints: I can't believe I went to buy a phone charger and the price was different at the register! Like what kind of scam is that? Just put the price on it already!

Hey, I went to buy a laptop and the price tag said one thing but they charged me more at the register! I’m super annoyed. Can you please fix that?
It's so frustrating when you see a price on the shelf and it's not what they charge you! Like do you want customers or not? Get your stuff together!

complaints: I went to this street fair last weekend and bought this jewelry from a vendor, I swear it looked way different than what I got, like way cheaper and they won't give me a refund, so annoyed!

complaints: Hey, can we talk about the street light on 3rd Ave? It’s been flickering like a disco ball for days now, super annoying and a little creepy at night. What’s going on??

complaints: There's this construction site down the block and it's so loud and messy, like every morning my coffee is ruined by the banging and I can't even hear my music! Plus, I swear the scaffolding looks shaky, like how is that even allowed! It’s gonna fall on someone!

Why is there always construction outside my window? It’s been going on for weeks and it looks like they ain't following the rules with all that exposed stuff. I’m worried cause I saw some of the beams leaning, and what if they don’t hold up? Who’s checking this?

There’s this project nearby and it looks ridiculously dangerous, I swear half the stuff they put up is just hanging there. A neighbor from the 5th floor said she heard a crash the other day and I think it came from that site! Can't somebody do something about the way they’re doing this? Like is it even legal?

Honestly, the construction crews are so careless, they left all these tools just lying around! I saw a hammer and a bunch of planks right in the middle of the sidewalk! It’s a nightmare trying to get past and I have a toddler! Who’s gonna take care of this mess?

complaints: Hey, so I was at Washington Square Park and some guy set up a whole yard sale on one of the benches, like a real one with a table and everything! No one could sit down, it was a mess, and I thought there were rules against that? Just trying to chill and enjoy the park!

I was at Prospect Park today and there was a family just taking over the whole row of benches for their picnic, like come on there are rules for a reason! I know it’s a park but we all wanna sit, not squeeze in like sardines!

complaints: I was just at Central Park and there’s this poor cat just wandering around looking sad and lost. It keeps meowing and looks like it hasn't eaten in days. This is so upsetting, I can’t just leave it there! Someone needs to come help it ASAP!

complaints: Yo the exit sign near the FDR at 42nd is hanging by a thread like it’s gonna fall any second, someone’s gonna get hurt! Like, who’s even watching this stuff?

Can we do something about that sign on the highway, the one that's flapping around like it's about to take off? Seriously, it’s a hazard and annoying when you're trying to drive in traffic!
There's this sign near the Queensboro Bridge that's kinda dangling and swaying. It’s super distracting when I’m driving, like, can it be fixed or do we just wait for a disaster?

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Smoke/Odor. From Unit Creating Nuisance

omg the smell from the hot dog cart is just awful!! every day I walk by and can't get that nasty whiff out of my clothes, I just want to eat breakfast without stinking up the world!

label: Food Establishment. Dishwashing/Utensils. Utensils/Equipment Dirty

My friend picked up pizza from that joint on 5th and the utensils were super dirty, I mean c'mon, it’s 2023, they should have a dishwasher or something, who wants to eat with a gross fork?

label: Beach/Pool/Sauna Complaint. Beach/Pool Water. Other (Explain Below)
complaints: So I took my kids to the beach in Coney Island and OMG the water was super murky and smelled weird. Like, can nobody see that? My kids didn’t even wanna swim!

What’s going on with the water at the beach? I mean, it’s supposed to be relaxing but it’s making me more anxious than anything. Can’t we get some clean water or at least a heads up about the conditions?

label: Window Guard. Tenant Refusal. Tenant Refused Install Request
complaints: I can't belive my neighbor is just refusing to put in a window guard like are you serious?? We live on the 5th floor and it's not safe! Kids and pets everywhere, come on!

Ugh, this is so annoying. The dude upstairs is refusing to install window guards, I just saw a bunch of kids playing out on the fire escape. Someone needs to do something about this ASAP.
I get it, we all have our issues but come on, safety first! My neighbor keeps saying he doesn’t want guards on his windows and I’m like dude, think of the children!

label: Consumer Complaint. Hotel or Motel. Overcharge
complaints: I stayed at that hotel downtown for a night and they charged me way more than what the website said!! Like, what kind of scam is that?? I just want my money back and to never have to deal with this again, ugh!

So I booked a room at this place for a weekend and when I checked out, they charged me almost double! They said it was because of 'extra fees' but it wasn't on the site. Feels like a total rip-off, man!
Can someone explain why hotels think they can charge whatever they feel like? I was charged $150 more than my confirmation said, and I couldn't even get anyone to help me. I feel cheated!

Just got back from a trip and I’m fuming because my hotel charged me for stuff I didn’t even use! They have a whole bunch of mystery fees, and it’s just so frustrating. I feel like I need a lawyer or something!

label: Missed Collection. Trash
complaints: Heyyy, my garbage wasn’t picked up yesterday! It’s piling up and smells. I have food waste in there and I can’t deal with this mess. Plz help!
So, it’s been TWO DAYS and my trash is still sitting on the curb. It’s like they forgot my whole block or something. Ugh! It’s disgusting and I’ve got flies now. Can someone do something about this?
Yo, what’s the deal? My neighbor’s trash is everywhere and it stinks! They didn’t pick it up and now it’s overflowing and attracting rats. This is NOT okay! Fix it ASAP!
I put out my recycling and regular trash and they just left it. Like, hello? It’s been sitting there forever and I don’t wanna deal with it turning into a mini landfill. What gives?

complaints: Yo, what’s up with all this graffiti on the bike path near the Brooklyn Bridge? I mean, it's like a tag fest down there and it's really ruining the vibe. Can we get someone to clean that up?

There is this awful graffiti all over the bike paths around Central Park, I can't even enjoy my ride anymore! It’s super distracting and kinda depressing. Please do something!!!

label: General Construction/Plumbing. Landmark Bldg - Illegal Work
complaints: Why is there construction going on at this old building? It feels like they’re just tearing it apart without any permits or whatever, super noisy and making me lose my mind! Who's in charge of this madness?
