Oh my god there’s a bunch of guys in hard hats doing something to that historic building down the street and like, no one knows what’s going on! Can someone please check if they even have the right paperwork??
Seriously can someone please come check on the construction happening at the old church on 7th? It looks super sketchy and I don't think they should be allowed to just smash stuff without a clue!

label: Consumer Complaint. Tow Truck Company. Unlicensed
complaints: So I parked my car on 5th ave like always but when I came back it was gone!! Turns out these tow truck dudes just can’t help themselves, they took it and I’m pretty sure they aren’t even licensed. This is so frustrating, how am I supposed to know who’s legit?

I got my car towed by this shady company that just pulled up and grabbed it without even checking for permits or anything, like who are these people? I swear there’s gotta be some sort of law against this, I just wanna find my car and they won’t even give me a straight answer!

Last night my car was towed from in front of my building and I’m pretty sure the guys who took it didn’t have proper credentials. I mean I thought we had regulations for a reason! This is just ridiculous, can someone please investigate this?

I just wanna say these tow truck guys are total crooks seriously! I parked outside my friend’s place for 30 minutes and boom, they swoop in and take my car like they own the street. I don’t even know who they are, they just had a beat-up truck and like no uniforms. What the heck?

label: Consumer Complaint. Pawnbroker. Overcharge
complaints: I went into this pawn shop to pawn my watch but they tried to charge me way more than it's worth! I looked it up online and they were just robbing me blind, total scam!
So I took my guitar to this place thinking I'd get a fair deal, but they wanted nearly double what it's worth just to take it! I'm not falling for that, it's a total rip-off, just no way!
I can’t believe I got charged almost triple what I thought! I brought in my old camera, and they acted like it was gold or something. I feel so cheated, like they just saw me coming!

Seriously, what kind of business charges you so much just to pawn something? I brought my stuff in and before I knew it, they were throwing crazy numbers at me like I was made of money or something. Not cool!

label: Plumbing. Boiler. Broken
complaints: My heat is not working and its freezing outside!! This is so ridiculous, I can't believe it's happening again in the middle of winter like seriously what's going on!
The boiler in my building is busted, it's like an ice box in here. I haven’t had hot water for two days now! Please fix this, I can't take cold showers anymore!!
Can someone please get someone to look at the boiler? I can’t feel my toes and my radiator is making weird noises like it’s trying to communicate with me, like c'mon! Help!
It's been 4 days without heat in my apartment! I’m sitting here bundled up like I'm in the Arctic and it's not even that cold normally. Can nobody get this fixed? This is not okay.

label: Street Light Condition. Multiple Street Lights Out. Location Type: Residential Address
complaints: Hey, can someone PLEASE do something about the streetlights on my block? Like half of them are dead and it’s getting super sketchy at night. I feel like I'm walking in a horror movie, man!
Just wanna say the street lights on 5th Ave are all out, like every single one! It's pitch black and super dangerous for us walking home from the subway! Fix it already!
Yo, the lights on my street have been out for weeks, no joke! I don’t wanna trip over a crackhead or something on a dark street! This is ridiculous, how hard can it be to switch a lightbulb?
I don’t understand why the city can’t keep the streetlights working. It’s like they’re on some kind of vacation or something. My neighborhood's freezing dark at night, it’s just not safe!

label: Consumer Complaint. Drug Store or Pharmacy. Advertising False or Misleading
complaints: I went to the CVS on 8th Ave and they had a big sale sign on the shelves for 50% off vitamins but when I got to the register they said it was only for certain brands! So misleading, why even put the sign up if it ain’t true?!
Went to Walgreens today for some allergy meds because it said on their app they had buy one get one free, but guess what? They didn’t honor it in store. Total scam and waste of time, furious!

I saw an ad online for a 2-for-1 deal on shampoo at Duane Reade but when I got there, they said it wasn’t in stock. Not cool! I came all the way here for this supposed deal and now I’m leaving empty-handed!

I bought a face cream at Rite Aid that was advertised as '100% natural' but when I looked at the ingredients, there were like 5 chemicals in it! Super disappointed, feel like I was tricked into spending my cash on junk.

label: Lost Property. Bag/Wallet. Money Clip
complaints: I lost my wallet somewhere in midtown like it just vanished into thin air, I had my ID, credit cards, and some cash in there. If anyone finds it please just, like, let me know. I can't even remember when I last had it, I’m freaking out!

Ughh, I was on the subway and I think I left my money clip on the seat, it had a couple of nice bills and my metro card! Can someone PLEASE look out for it? I swear it wasn’t even that old, like trying to keep everything together in this city is stressful enough!

So I was at Central Park yesterday just chilling and I think I accidentally dropped my bag near the Bethesda Terrace, it had my laptop and some personal stuff in it. I literally cannot stop thinking about it, what if someone took it?! I can’t imagine losing all that!

Yo, I lost my bag in the coffee shop on 3rd Ave, like a black tote with a bunch of random junk inside and my wallet! I didn’t even realize till I got home, totally messed up my day! If someone sees it, please help a dude out!

label: Consumer Complaint. Laundromat. Contact Sign Not Posted
complaints: Yo, I been going to this laundromat for weeks now and they don’t have no sign anywhere with a contact number or anything! What if there’s an issue? Like, who do I even talk to? It’s super sketchy!
I did my laundry at this place and there’s no number to call or a manager or anything posted like it’s a ghost store! If my clothes go missing or something, who do I yell at?
Can someone tell the laundromat on 5th Ave to put up a contact sign?! I was in there the other day and the machine ate my quarters and no one was around to help!

Listen, I went to wash my clothes at this laundromat and it was all good until I realized they don’t have a contact # posted anywhere!! What if something goes wrong? I can’t just be sitting here hoping for the best.

label: Animal in a Park. Animal Waste. Other
complaints: There is this dog park at Tompkins Square and its a MESS!! There’s more poop than grass, like come on people clean up after your pets!! It’s disgusting, I can’t even let my kid play there anymore!
I keep stepping in animal crap in Prospect Park! I don’t understand why dog owners can’t just pick up after their pets! This is the city not a farm!
Why is there so much dog poop everywhere in the park? Like I love dogs but owners need to be responsible! It smells and it’s just so nasty and unfair for everyone else trying to enjoy the day! Ugh!

Can someone do something about the filthy state of the dog run in Central Park? I know dogs are dogs but it’s getting ridiculous like am I supposed to dodge landmines while taking my own dog out? GROSS.

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Permit/License/Certificate. Vending of Unapproved Items
complaints: There's this dude selling churros on the corner of 42nd and 8th and they look amazing but I think he's like totally illegal or something... he ain't got no permits, like who lets this happen?

So I’m walking down Broadway and there’s a taco truck selling stuff that’s DEF not on the menu or permitted like this is just wrong! They gotta stop these pop-up vendors, it's nonsense, and what about food safety!

There’s this guy with a cart on my block right outside the deli, and he's selling some crazy stuff like fried Oreos or whatever. I mean, I love fried food but this can't be safe or legal. Can someone please check him out?

Why is there a guy selling bubble tea on the street?? Like I get it, it’s summer, but I’m pretty sure he doesn’t have a license and it’s in the middle of a busy intersection. Just waiting for someone to get hurt, ugh!

label: Tattooing. Minor Received Tattoo
complaints: I went to this tattoo shop on 3rd Ave, and the artist was super unprofessional! My tattoo is all messed up – the lines are crooked and it’s not even what I asked for! They didn’t even care when I brought it up!
Ugh, I’m so upset! I got a tattoo last week, and it’s already fading like crazy! I thought tattoos were supposed to last, what is going on?
So I went to get a tattoo for my birthday and it was a total disaster! They rushed through it and now it looks nothing like what I wanted. I’m pretty sure the ink is already smudging too!
Can you believe I paid good money for a tattoo and it’s all wrong!? The color is off and it’s not even in the right place on my arm. I feel like I got ripped off!

label: Consumer Complaint. Tax Preparation Services. Tax Documents Not Filed
complaints: I hired this tax guy thinking he was legit, but he didn't even file my taxes! Now I'm stressed out and it's almost April! Like how do you not do your job? Ugh!
So I went to this place to get my taxes done and they promised me they'd file it all nice and easy. Now I find out they never sent anything in and I can't get a hold of them. What a scam!
I paid these people a lot of money to do my taxes and they just ghosted me! No filed documents, no responses, nothing! I'm seriously considering calling the police because this is ridiculous!
This tax prep service is a joke! They keep saying they’re backed up but how hard is it to click submit? Now I’m out of time and money and just so mad I can't even think straight!

label: Consumer Complaint. Pedicab. Unlicensed
complaints: I just got accosted by this pedicab guy who clearly had no license or medallion or whatever. He was super aggressive and tried to charge me way too much for a short ride. I felt unsafe, like, can someone please do something about these unlicensed folks?

Saw this dude with a pedicab, no permits at all, just riding around like he owns the streets. Had my kid with me and I didn’t want to take any chances, so we walked away but seriously, isn't there some kind of rule about this?

Okay, I swear I saw the same unlicensed pedicab guy giving rides near Central Park all day long! This is ridiculous! He’s ripping tourists off and nobody’s doing anything about it. Can’t believe it’s legal for them to operate like that!

This pedicab driver just pulled up outta nowhere and started yelling at me to get in, no ID or anything, just sketchy vibes all around. I’m not trying to get into a shady ride in NYC. Please make something happen about these guys, it’s a mess out here.

label: Violation of Park Rules. Unauthorized Climbing. Tree
complaints: I was at Central Park today and saw some kids climbing this huge tree! Like are you serious? That’s just asking for trouble, what if they fall? Get it together, people!
Why are people allowed to climb on the trees in Prospect Park? I was just trying to enjoy a picnic and had to watch these idiots risking their necks. It’s not a playground!
I can’t believe how many people think it’s cool to climb the trees in the park. It’s disrespectful to the nature and dangerous! Saw a kid get stuck the other day, it’s just ridiculous!

Is there any way to stop people from climbing the trees in Fort Greene Park? It looks so messy and unsafe. Last time I went, I saw a couple of guys trying to scale one while yelling like they were in a game or something. Just dumb.

label: Consumer Complaint. Restaurant. Customer Data Shared Without Consent
complaints: Ugh I just found out this restaurant shared my info without telling me!! Like, are you kidding?? I didn’t sign up for that, what’s wrong with people??
So I ordered takeout and now I’m getting random ads from other places?? This is super sketchy and it’s gotta be from that place I ordered from, I’m furious!
Can you believe this restaurant gave my email to some marketing company???? I never agreed to that and it makes me feel so violated, grrr!
I went to this new spot and they asked for my phone number but didn’t say they’d sell it or whatever!! Now I’m getting spam calls and it’s driving me nuts. This ain’t right!

label: Damaged Tree. Branch or Limb Has Fallen Down. Park (High Traffic Area)
complaints: Hey, there's a huge branch just chillin' in the middle of the path in Central Park, like, anyone could trip over it and fall! Not cool, get it cleaned up!
I was just trying to enjoy my walk in the park and there’s this giant limb in the way. I almost tripped over it! Can someone come move it, please?
Listen, there’s a big ol’ branch lying around by the fountain in the park! It’s dangerous for kids and doggos running around, don’t people know about tree safety? Ugh!
There’s a fallen tree limb in Prospect Park, right by the playground. It’s blocking half the path! Really unsafe for the little ones playing nearby, pls fix it ASAP.

label: Consumer Complaint. Gas Station Pumps. Measurement Inaccurate
complaints: I just filled up my tank and I'm 100% sure I didn't get the right amount of gas, it just didn't add up, I was only at a quarter tank before and now it's full but the meter says I got way less than I should have, like how can this even happen?

I pulled into that gas station on 5th and Broadway, and the pump was acting weird, didn't feel like I was getting what I paid for, went to fill up and it stopped way too quick, I'm not a math whiz but my tank shouldn’t be this empty after all that money!

So I went to fill my car at that station on 14th, and the pump doesn't seem to be giving me the right amount, like it claimed I got 3 gallons but my needle barely moved, I feel like I got robbed or something, can someone check these pumps?

OMG I just wasted my money at that gas station near Times Square, the pump was so off, I was in line forever and now I don't even know if I filled up properly, seriously am I getting cheated? This is the third time I’ve complained about this station, it's just ridiculous!

label: Street Sign - Damaged. Speed Limit
complaints: Hey can someone PLEASE fix the speed limit sign on 5th Ave by the park? It’s all bent up and drivers are flying by like they’re on the freeway!! Like seriously, it’s an accident waiting to happen!!
Yo, the speed limit sign on 8th Street is totally destroyed, like barely hanging on. Cars are zooming by and it’s super dangerous man!! Can’t believe no one’s done anything about it yet!
Umm there’s a speed limit sign on Broadway that’s been broken for weeks now! No one knows how fast they can go and I see these cars speeding and it’s like a game of chicken! Help!
I’m really worried about this broken speed limit sign on 14th. It’s like a twisted metal mess now and people act like there’s no limit! Can someone fix it before someone gets hurt?

label: Consumer Complaint. Locksmith. Refund, Return, or Exchange Refused
complaints: I called this locksmith to get my front door unlocked and they were super fast but then charged me way too much like what even is 200 bucks for 10 minutes of work???? I tried to get a refund and they were just rude and said no. Like are you kidding I’m not rich here!

So I had a terrible experience with this locksmith, they came out and were late and then when they finally got to my place the job they did was half assed and I couldn’t even use my key at first! They don’t want to give me any money back, what a scam!

This is outrageous!! I called a locksmith to replace my lock and they promised me a good price but when they got here it was all lies! I paid a ton and now they won’t refund me a cent because I ‘approved’ the price but no one told me about extra charges!

I really regret calling these people for a lockout service. They said they’d take care of it no problem but it felt like forever and they just charged me an arm and a leg for something I could’ve done myself honestly! I asked for a refund and they hung up on me!

label: Consumer Complaint. Mobile Food Vendor. Price Not Posted or Inaccurate
complaints: I just got a hot dog from that vendor on 5th Ave and he charged me $8!! Like seriously? For a hot dog? And there’s no sign anywhere about the price! It’s ridiculous!

There’s this food cart on the corner of 42nd Street and nobody has prices posted anywhere, it’s so shady! I ordered tacos and he said $12 but looked at me all weird. Why can’t they just put up a menu like normal people?
Hey! The guy selling pretzels by Central Park is charging $10 for a pretzel, NO prices posted, nothing! I mean come on, that’s crazy!
Just got ripped off at that halal cart on 8th. No prices on the cart, and he charged me $15 for a chicken over rice! I’m so mad, this is why I never buy from vendors.

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Food Source/Protection. Food from Unapproved Source
complaints: I just bought a hot dog from that cart on the corner of 5th and 42nd and I'm pretty sure they don’t have any permits. I asked the guy where he gets his meat and he just stared at me like I was crazy. I’m feeling sick already and I didn't even finish it!

Yo, there’s this taco truck parked by the subway entrance, the guy making the food doesn’t look like he’s following any health codes! No gloves, no nothing. Just standing there making my burrito and his hands are all over the place! I don’t wanna get sick!

I love food trucks and street food but this one by my office has been there for weeks and I swear I saw a rat run under it the other day! Like, how do they even pass inspections? It’s disgusting and I’m terrified to eat from there now, seriously!

Listen, there’s this falafel guy who sets up near my building every Wednesday and I want to support him but I can’t help but wonder if he’s got the proper health permits. Honestly, the last time I grabbed something from him, I ended up with a stomach ache and I can’t afford to be sick right now.

label: Consumer Complaint. Electronics Store. Refund or Return Policy Not Posted
complaints: Hey I just went to this electronics store on 5th ave and they don’t have any signs about returns or refunds anywhere! I bought a laptop and now the thing doesn’t even turn on and they won’t take it back. Like seriously, how am I supposed to know what to do? This is so frustrating!

Why doesn't this store have their refund policy posted? I ask the cashier about it when I tried to return a broken phone and she just shrugged! I mean come on, this is NYC, we need clear rules, not surprises. Not cool guys!

I just spent a lot of money on a TV and didn’t see anything about returns until after I left the store. Now they’re saying it’s a no return situation because I didn’t ask first? I’ll just tell everyone I know not to shop there, wow just wow.

Can you believe I went to this place and I couldn’t find any info about returning stuff? I bought a camera and it’s just not working and I feel totally cheated. I shouldn’t have to be a detective to figure out if I can return something!

label: Consumer Complaint. Tour Guide. Goods or Services Not Delivered
complaints: I booked a tour for my family two weeks ago and the guide never showed up. I called them like 10 times and no one answered! So frustrating, we ended up walking around lost, and my kids were so mad!
Paid for this fancy food tour but it was just a guy with a hot dog cart. I mean, c'mon! Where's the fancy food? I want my money back!!
So I thought it would be cool to do one of those boat tours, right? But the guy was late and we didn't even get to see half the stuff! What a waste of my Saturday. Not impressed!
I bought tickets for a walking tour and the guy shows up with no info and just starts talking nonsensically. I swear I learned more from Google! Totally not worth the price!

label: Consumer Complaint. Smoking, Cigar, or Vape Store. Overcharge
complaints: I went into that smoke shop on 2nd Ave and they charged me $30 for a pack of cigs that’s usually $12! What the hell? Totally ripping people off. Gonna tell everyone to avoid that place!

So I bought a vape juice from this store in Brooklyn and they charged me $15 when online it's like $8. That's just shady man, especially with everything else going on. Like how do they get away with this?
I swear I got overcharged at that little cigar shop near the corner. They said prices went up but they didn’t even say how much! Just had me in shock when I paid and left. Not coming back for sure.

Why is it that every time I go into that vape store they have different prices?? Like last week it was $10 for my juice and now it’s $20? What is going on with these place? Makes me feel like I'm getting scammed!

label: Curb Condition. Defacement. Graffiti
complaints: The curbs are all marked up with this awful graffiti, it seriously makes the whole block look terrible! Like what is wrong with people??
There's this big ugly tag on the curb by my apartment and every time I walk by I just get so annoyed. Can someone come clean it up?
Ugh, why is there graffiti on EVERY CURB around here? It's like a competition of who can draw the worst stuff. Really takes away from the neighborhood vibe!
The curb outside my place looks like a canvas for some wannabe artists, I mean I get it, art n all but PLEASE, I can't even park without seeing it. Can we do something about it?

label: Sewer. Rain Garden Structure (Girgs). Girgs
complaints: So there's this huge puddle in front of my building every time it rains. It's like a mini lake and we live on the first floor. Help, I can't even walk my dog without us both getting soaked!

I don't know who thought it was a good idea to put that rain garden thingy on my street, but it’s always overflowing and smells like a swamp! It's disgusting, and the last thing I need is to step in that mess while heading to work.
Ughhhh my street is a disaster whenever it rains, the water just sits there. My shoes are ruined and my kids can't play outside after it rains! PLEASE FIX THIS! It's not rocket science!

Why are all the rain gardens so poorly designed? There's debris everywhere and it’s like a magnet for trash. I just want to walk down the street and not feel like I'm in a garbage dump after it rains!

label: Lifeguard. Absent
complaints: So I took my kids to the pool today and there was NO lifeguard on duty!!! What is even going on? I can't have my kids swimming without supervision. This is a safety hazard!! I’m sooo mad!
Just got back from the community pool with my family and there was no lifeguard there. Are you kidding me? That place gets packed, do you want someone to drown? This is ridiculous!
I went to the pool this afternoon and was shocked to see NO lifeguard. I really wish I had just gone to the beach instead! How hard is it to staff someone there? It’s summer, for crying out loud!
Seriously, I just took my kids to swim and there wasn’t even a lifeguard on duty. I mean, what if something happened? Like, do you think safety is optional? This is just so irresponsible!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Door Lock. Damaged
complaints: Hey so I was tryin to get into my bldg and the front door lock is messed up again!!! This is not the first time!!! It took me like 15 mins to get in and I’m about to be late for work. Can someone please fix this?!

Honestly I don’t get how the traffic light at 5th and Main is always stuck on red for like 10 minutes! Cars are just sitting there and it’s like no one knows what to do. Someone is gonna get in an accident!!! A little help here would be great!

Ugh the door to my building has this faulty lock and it just won’t turn!!! I had to wait for a neighbor to let me in AGAIN. This is getting ridiculous, my keys are practically worn out. Fix the lock already, please!

Okay, so I was waiting at the stoplight by Central Park and it just stopped working. People were driving like maniacs and there were tons of bikes too. It was chaos!!! Can we PLEASE get that thing looked at before someone gets hurt?

label: Illegal Animal Sold. Turtle Under 4 inches Long
complaints: I can’t believe it but I just saw this dude selling tiny turtles on the corner of my block! They’re like 3 inches long or something, totally illegal and it’s just so wrong!! Who is even allowing this??

Yo, why are people allowed to sell these baby turtles in the park? I saw a couple of them for sale and I thought they were like pets but they’re too small! Can someone do something about it? This is nuts!

There’s a guy near the bodega selling these baby turtles and they are REAL tiny, like smaller than my hand! It doesn’t seem right and I feel bad for them, it can’t be good for them or legal or whatever.
I saw tiny turtles being sold on the street today, like under 4 inches, isn’t that illegal or something? It just feels wrong, nobody seems to care but I do! We shouldn’t be letting this happen!

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Base Door/Cover Missing. Location Type: Intersection
complaints: Yo, the street light at 5th and 34th is a disaster, the cover is missing from the base and there’s exposed wires, looks super dangerous!
Why is the base of the street lamp at Park and Main wide open?? Like no cover at all! Can someone please fix this before someone trips or gets hurt? Ugh!
There’s a street light on the corner of 8th Ave that has been completely missing its door for weeks now!!! It’s just sitting there all open and it’s really sketchy. Please can you send someone?
I walked by that intersection on 42nd and 8th and the street light has this gaping hole in the base – not cool! It’s like an accident waiting to happen, kids might poke around and get hurt. Help!

label: Consumer Complaint. Carpet and Flooring Business. Contract or Billing Dispute
complaints: I got this carpet put in last month and it’s already coming apart at the seams! I thought I was getting quality but now I’m regretting that decision big time. Can someone please help?

So I paid a good chunk of change to have my floors done and they messed up the measurements! Now I got weird gaps and my living room looks like a disaster zone. Seriously, do these people even know what they’re doing?

I am beyond frustrated with this flooring company. They promised me they would get it done in a week and now it’s been THREE weeks and no one is giving me a straight answer. I just want my floors done already!
I don’t usually complain but this billing thing has gotten out of hand! They charged me extra for ‘materials’ that I never even saw. Feeling a bit scammed here can someone sort this out?

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Speed Board Sign. Out
complaints: The speed limit sign on 5th and 34th is totally broken and keeps flashing weird stuff like it doesn’t even say how fast I'm supposed to go! It's making it really hard to drive safely!
Can we please fix that speed board on 8th Ave? It's stuck on some random number and just blinking like a disco ball! So annoying and unsafe for us drivers!
Why is the traffic signal at 45th and Broadway not working? It just stays red all the time and people are running it like crazy, it's gonna cause an accident!
I thought the traffic signs were supposed to help but this one at Madison and 23rd is just blank?? Like did it get hit or what? Can someone please do something before someone gets hurt?

label: Pet Sale. Illegal Animal Sold
complaints: I bought a puppy from a guy in the park and it turns out he’s not even 8 weeks old! I feel so bad for this poor little guy, he should still be with his mom! This is so messed up!
Ugh, I’m so angry! I got a kitten from some sketchy ad online and now she has ringworm! I think I got scammed! Can't believe I trusted that ad.
I adopted a tortoise from some dude on Astoria Blvd and he said it was healthy but it’s been acting weird. Like, really weird. I'm worried I got ripped off. Can someone check on these sellers?
Why is it so hard to find a legit pet seller? I bought a bird from this guy on the street and it’s sick. Like, how do people get away with this? This city is a jungle!

label: Food Establishment. Pesticide
complaints: I found a dead cockroach in my takeout from that place on Bleeker St. Absolutely disgusting! How are they not shut down yet?
I ordered from a diner and there was a weird chemical taste to my fries... I think it might be pesticides? Please investigate that place before more people get sick!
I swear I've seen some weird stuff crawling around the kitchen area of the deli on my block, like live bugs and stuff... I'm not eating there again! Why isn't anyone doing anything?
Just saw a rat run across the floor of that taco joint and it’s like they don’t even care! I'm really not sure I want to eat there anymore. What is going on with these health inspections?!

label: Consumer Complaint. Drug Store or Pharmacy. Overcharge
complaints: I just went to the pharmacy and they charged me like $20 more than what was on the shelf!! I’m so mad, like do they just make up prices as they go?
I bought some cold meds and they charged me twice for one item! What kinda scam is this? I should have checked my receipt but who has time for that?
I picked up a prescription and it was way more than I was told it would be. I feel like I’m being ripped off left and right. How am I supposed to afford this?
Why am I paying so much at this drug store? I swear last week the same thing was way cheaper! They need to get their act together, this feels like highway robbery.

label: Consumer Complaint. Gift, Novelty, or Souvenir Store. Cash Payment Not Accepted
complaints: I went to this cute little gift shop on East 32nd and they wouldn’t take cash!! What kind of store doesn’t accept cash? I had to leave empty-handed and I was really looking forward to buying some souvenirs for my family. Booo!!

So I tried to buy a funny mug or whatever from that novelty store in the village and they straight up told me only cards! Are we living in the future or what? No one wants to deal with cards for a stupid mug!

Just went to that souvenir shop on Broadway and they refused my cash. Like seriously? I had bills ready and they said it’s card only. What’s wrong with the world these days? I just wanted a keychain to remember the trip smh.

Feeling really frustrated after going to that gift shop near Times Square and they said NO CASH!! It's ridiculous I mean come on, sometimes people just want to pay in cash and not swipe a card for a $5 trinket! Ugh, such a hassle.

label: For Hire Vehicle Complaint. Driver Report - Non Passenger. Cell Phone Use
complaints: I just saw a black car idling at the corner of 5th and Main and the driver was on his phone, like come on! He wasn't even watching the road, just scrolling away. So unsafe!
What the heck is wrong with people? This for-hire driver was just parked in the middle of the street texting, like it's no big deal. Can't they pull over somewhere? It's super annoying and dangerous!

Ugh, can you believe I saw a guy in a yellow cab swerving like crazy 'cause he was busy on his phone? He almost hit a bike! This city is too packed for that kind of nonsense, they should really be paying attention.

So I’m walking down the street and this SUV pulls over, not at the curb but in traffic, and the driver is just sitting there on his phone. I mean, I know it’s New York but come on, have some respect for the road and other drivers!

label: Consumer Complaint. Storage Warehouse. Price Not Posted or Inaccurate
complaints: So I went to this storage place and there were no prices anywhere and I felt super sketchy about it, like am I gonna get ripped off? Like is it gonna be $100 or $1000? Just post the prices already so I know what I'm dealing with, geez!

I called this storage facility and they quoted me one price over the phone but when I got there it was a whole other price! Like what gives? Just trying to figure out if I can afford this without feeling like I’m being played!

Hey can someone please explain why I walked into this storage warehouse and saw nothing but vague signs? Like I had to ask the guy behind the counter for a price and he looked like he didn’t wanna tell me! Super frustrating, just be upfront already!

I went to check out a storage unit and they didn’t have any prices posted anywhere, so I had to ask like three different people just to find out what it costs and by the time I left I was so annoyed I forgot to even sign up for a unit, smh!

label: LinkNYC. WiFi/Internet Not Working/Slow
complaints: The LinkNYC thingy by my apartment is acting all wonky again! I can’t even load my emails, like seriously I’m standing here trying to get work done and it’s just spinning! Ugh!
Why is the internet on these LinkNYC booths sooo slow?? I’m trying to look up a subway schedule and it’s going nowhere! It’s like watching paint dry! Come on!
These LinkNYC screens are worse than dial-up! I tried to connect but it just keeps disconnecting me! I thought we were livin' in the future, not the Stone Age!
Can someone please fix this LinkNYC WiFi? I was able to connect for 5 seconds then kaput! I had the perfect meme to send too and now I’m standing here like a fool!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Vehicle Signal. Damaged
complaints: The traffic light on 5th and 42nd is busted, keeps blinking yellow and nobody knows when to go! It's a total mess! Cars just zooming past, it’s like a game of chicken!
Hey, that light at the corner of 7th and Broadway is totally out, I almost got hit crossing the street! Can someone fix it before someone gets hurt? It’s been like this for days!
What’s up with the signal at 14th and 8th? It’s broken and totally confusing. Drivers just sit there staring at it. This is NYC, we can’t have traffic jams over a light!
The pedestrian signal at 34th and 8th is all messed up, doesn’t light up half the time! Been waiting forever to cross and the cars just don’t stop. No respect for pedestrians, SMH!

label: Broken Parking Meter. Graffiti
complaints: The parking meter at 5th and 23rd is totally busted. I swear I put money in it and it didn’t even register! What’s the point of these things if they’re just gonna steal our change?
There’s graffiti all over the side of the park building on 10th Ave. I mean who do I even talk to about this? It’s like, we’re trying to enjoy the park and it looks like a dump. Pls do something!
This parking meter on Broadway is broken, like seriously people come on! And there’s this ugly scribbling all over the sidewalk nearby, it’s just gross! Can we get some help here?
I parked on 3rd and 15th and the meter wasn’t working and I got a ticket anyway!!! This is so unfair!! Plus there’s stupid graffiti on the wall next to it. Can you guys fix this nonsense?

label: Damaged Tree. Entire Tree Has Fallen Down. Blocking Driveway
complaints: Hey, so like a whole tree just fell in my driveway and it's blocking everything. I can't get my car out and it's just laying there like it owns the place. Can someone PLEASE come and take care of this?

OMG, there's a giant tree down in front of my house and I was supposed to leave for work 30 minutes ago! It's totally blocking my driveway and I have no idea how long it's been there. This is ridiculous!
Ugh, a tree fell and now I can't even park! It's taking up half the street too, really not helping my morning. This is a total mess, can someone do something about it?
So there's a fallen tree just chillin' in my driveway right now and it's a whole situation. My neighbors are laughing but I'm not finding it funny at all, like can someone please come help?

label: Violation of Park Rules. Obstructing Public Use. Path
complaints: Why do people think they can set up a whole picnic on the walking path in Central Park? Can't walk my dog without tripping over a blanket!
Just saw a group taking over the entire pathway with their yoga class, like, hello? People actually need to pass through here!
Can someone please tell those people not to block the path in Prospect Park? I get it's a nice day but there's literally no space for us to walk!
Honestly, every time I try to go for a run in the park I gotta dodge people taking selfies, walking three across and blocking the whole way. It’s ridiculous!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Base Door. Missing
complaints: Hey, the traffic signal at 5th and Main is totally messed up, the piece that covers the light is gone. Not only is it super annoying but it’s dangerous, cars just zoom through thinking it’s green! Can someone please fix this before something bad happens? Thanks!
Ugh, the light at 42nd and Broadway is missing its cover! I was waiting and cars kept running through, it’s like they don’t even see the signal. This is ridiculous, fix it already!

Why is there a broken traffic light at 7th Ave?! The top panel is completely missing and it’s a nightmare, people are just ignoring it! HOW DO YOU NOT NOTICE THERE'S A LIGHT MISSING?! Put it back! This is NYC, c'mon!

Can you please do something about the traffic signal at 34th street? The whole top casing where the light shines is gone, like completely! I almost got hit trying to cross. Seriously, how long does it take to replace a cover?

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Cable. Damaged
complaints: Yo, the traffic light on 5th and Main is all messed up! It's flickering like a disco ball and cars are just zooming through like it's a racetrack! Someone's gonna get hurt!! Fix it already!
That signal at 42nd Street is broken or something, it just stays red forever, even when there’s no traffic. I almost missed my bus waiting there like a fool! Can’t someone do somethin'?
Ugh, why is the traffic light at 3rd Ave and 14th St not working?! I almost got hit crossing! It’s just flashing yellow and nobody knows what to do, totally chaotic!

Seriously, the light at 7th and 34th needs a makeover or a new bulb or something because it’s just not functioning right. It's super annoying! People can't just run through the intersections like it’s a game!

label: Consumer Complaint. Home Improvement Contractor. Home Damaged
complaints: I hired this contractor to fix my roof and they left a huge mess in my backyard, like come on, they just dumped old shingles everywhere, I thought I was paying for a professional service!

So my bathroom renovation has turned into my worst nightmare. The guy said it would take a week, its been 3 weeks and they still haven't finished, and now my ceiling leaked! I can't even shower properly, ugh!

I can't believe this guy! He said he could fix my wall in a day and now my living room looks worse than before. Like, how do you even mess that up? It's all uneven and now I gotta call someone else to deal with this bs!
I had a contractor come to do some painting and now my place smells like paint fumes, I thought they were supposed to ventilate that or something? I feel like I'm gonna pass out, please help!

label: Violation of Park Rules. Obstructing Public Use. Entrance
complaints: Hey, so I just tried to take my kid to the playground at Central Park and there’s this group of people set up with tables and chairs just blocking the entrance like they own the place! I mean seriously, it’s a public space not a private party! Can someone do something about this?

This is ridiculous. I tried to go for my morning jog in the park, and there’s this whole event with tents and loud music right at the entrance! Like, who even let them do this? It's 8 am and people are trying to enjoy the park!

Can you please get someone to check on the park near 5th and 10th? There’s a bunch of skateboarders just lounging around at the entrance and nobody can get in or out without almost bumping into them. Like, how hard is it to share a space?

Ugh, I love Prospect Park, but I was so frustrated today! I went to meet friends and there’s a huge yoga class taking the whole entrance over. No one can get by! Why do they think it’s okay to block access like that?! Just let people into the park, come on!

label: Consumer Complaint. Other Store (Non-Food). Air Conditioning Law Not Posted
complaints: I went to this store today and the air conditioning was like a sauna, I mean seriously, why are you not following the law? It’s hot out here and they didn’t even have the notice posted!

So I walked into this shop looking for some stuff and wow, it’s like they don’t even believe in AC – I noticed they didn’t have the law posted anywhere which is illegal right? Like come on, do better!

Why is it so freaking hot in that store? I thought it was just me but nope, it’s just their terrible AC situation and no sign about the air conditioning law! It’s bad enough to go shopping in this heat, they could at least comply with the law!
This place is a joke! Sweating buckets while browsing around and no sign posted about air conditioning law?? Get it together, I can’t even focus on shopping when I’m melting!

label: Outside Building. Skylight. Leaking
complaints: So I got this skylight and lately it’s been leaking like crazy, you can just see the water dripping down. I don’t know what to do, it’s ruining my ceiling! I tried to put a bucket but it’s just a mess, help!!!

Why is my skylight suddenly leaking? It was fine before, but now every time it rains, my living room is like a waterfall. I mean come on, I don’t pay rent to have a pool in my apartment! Fix it please!

There’s water coming through my skylight and I think it’s gonna ruin the wood around it. I don’t have money to fix that! I’m worried it’s gonna get worse and I can’t deal with mold. I just remodeled my place!
Can someone take a look at the skylight in my building? It’s leaking and I’m tired of cleaning up water every time it rains. I can’t sleep at night worrying about it. This is ridiculous!

label: For Hire Vehicle Complaint. Car Service Company Complaint. Discourteous
complaints: I called that car service and the driver was soooo rude, like just straight up ignored me when I asked for the location, and then he drove like a maniac, almost got us in an accident! NOT cool, dude.
The guy who picked me up today was such a jerk! I asked him to turn down the music and he rolled his eyes at me! What am I supposed to do with that?
I ordered a ride and it took forever to arrive, then when he did get there he barely helped with my bags! Honestly, could barely be bothered to get out of the car. So frustrating!
I used this car service and the driver was just awful – he kept talking about politics the whole ride and didn’t even check if I was comfortable. Like I’m sorry, I’m just trying to get home in peace!

label: Consumer Complaint. Drug Store or Pharmacy. Receipt Inaccurate, Incomplete, or Not Given
complaints: I bought like 10 things from that pharmacy last night and when I got home I realized I didn’t get a receipt! It’s so annoying cause I need it for my insurance, why can’t they just give it to you?
Went to the drug store on 5th and the cashier forgot to print my receipt! I mean, how am I supposed to know how much I spent or if I was charged correctly? This is ridiculous!!
I asked for my receipt after paying for my prescriptions and the lady just stared at me like I was crazy. How do I prove I bought my meds now? Ugh, come on people!
Just left the store on Broadway, got some allergy meds and no receipt. I want to return them but how can I with no proof? This is the third time this happens, like seriously, get it together!

label: Bridge Condition. Dirt, Debris, Litter Complaint
complaints: Yo, what's up with the Brooklyn Bridge?! It's a total mess down there, like there's trash everywhere, I can't even walk without stepping on something gross! Can someone clean this up please, it's embarrassin'!

I was walking on the Queensboro Bridge the other day and honestly it’s like a dump up there. Just garbage everywhere. It’s really ruining the view, not to mention there are rats scurrying around. Come on now, clean it up!

Why is no one taking care of the Williamsburg Bridge? The sidewalks are littered with old food wrappers and God knows what else. It’s disgusting! I don’t wanna have to dodge trash while I’m trying to enjoy the breeze, fix it!!

Can we talk about the Manhattan Bridge? It’s got sooo much debris around the entrance, it’s like they don’t even care. I saw a used diaper and a broken bottle the other day, like seriously??? Who’s in charge of cleaning this up?!

label: Street Light Condition. Flood Light Lamp Out. Location Type: Bridge / Tunnel
complaints: Yo, there's a super dark spot on the bridge at night, no lights or anything. I swear it's like a horror movie. Can’t they fix this?
The flood light on the bridge is out! I almost tripped over my own feet the other night. Fix it, people! It’s dangerous!
Ugh, it’s pitch black under the bridge! How am I supposed to feel safe walking there? Like, can someone please get on this?
This bridge is super sketchy at night, the flood light has been out for weeks, and I’ve seen some weird stuff down there. Get it together, city!

label: Consumer Complaint. Mobile Food Vendor. Overcharge
complaints: I went to buy a hot dog from that cart on 42nd and 8th, and the guy charged me like $10 for a basic frank and a soda! Like, are you kidding me? Last week it was $5! There's no way that’s right. Someone needs to check these food vendors!

So I grabbed a pretzel from that cart near Central Park and the guy charged me $6 for it! I swear last season it was like 2 bucks. I mean, inflation’s a thing but c'mon, this is just crazy. I'm gonna start bringing my own snacks!

Dude, I stopped by the taco truck on 10th Ave and they charged me extra for guac, which fine, but I swear I didn’t even ask for it! I ended up paying like $15 for two tacos. This is just ridiculous, I can’t keep dropping money like this for street food!

Last week I treated myself to a smoothie from that vendor at Union Square, and they charged me $9 for what shoulda been a $5 drink! Like, I get it, things are expensive but lemme live, I’m just tryna enjoy a nice day out!

label: Consumer Complaint. Hotel or Motel. Cancelation Without Notice
complaints: I booked a room at that hotel down on 5th a month ago for a special weekend and then they just up and canceled my reservation with no heads up! What the heck? I had plans, now I gotta scramble to find another place. So unprofessional!

Called the hotel to confirm my booking cuz I was nervous and they told me oh sorry we’ve canceled it and we can’t even help you find another one! Like what do you expect me to do? Just sleep on the street?! Totally ridiculous. Never booking there again!

Seriously, I planned a whole trip just to find out my hotel canceled my reservation without even a call or an email! I had friends coming in from out of town and now I’m scrambling to find a new place like where are you supposed to get that kind of service in this city?

I booked a hotel for a conference, and they just sent me an email saying they canceled my stay like it was no big deal! No reason given just poof gone. What’s up with that? Now I’m stuck wondering where to stay and it’s such a mess. This better not be how they treat everyone!

label: Ferry Complaint. Delays
complaints: I was waiting for the ferry for over an hour today and then it just didn't show up! I had places to go and now I'm late, this is ridiculous!
So I’m on my way to work and the ferry decides to just not run on time, what is going on? This is not the first time either, get your act together, please!
Ughhh, seriously, what’s with the ferry delays? I thought I could depend on it but it’s like they just don’t care about schedules anymore!
I missed my connection because the ferry was running late AGAIN! This happens way too often and it’s super frustrating, I just want to get to where I need to go on time!

label: Damaged Tree. Entire Tree Has Fallen Down. Park (High Traffic Area)
complaints: yo there is a huge tree just fell in the park and it’s blocking the whole path like what are you waiting for?? someone is gonna get hurt if this isn’t cleaned up soon!!

I was jogging in the park and nearly tripped over this giant tree that fell down, it’s a busy area and people are just walking around it like it’s no big deal. Can’t believe the city hasn’t done anything about it yet!
There’s a tree on the ground in the park. It’s totally inconvenient for all us dog walkers and families. Like, what if a kid trips over it or something?! Get it sorted out ASAP!

There’s a HUGE tree that just fell down in the park near the playground, it’s like right in the middle of the walkway and making it super hard to get through. Seriously who is in charge of these parks?? Fix this!

label: Consumer Complaint. Online or Mail Order. Advertising False or Misleading
complaints: I ordered a shirt online that said it was a large but when it got here it looks like it would fit a toddler! Like seriously, who do they think they are fooling with these sizes?
Got some skincare stuff that was advertised as cruelty free but I found out they test on animals! I'm super upset and feel totally misled, I just wanted to help the planet, not hurt it!
These ads said I could buy one get one free but when I got to the checkout it was a total lie! I ended up paying for both, what kinda bait and switch is that?
I bought a gadget that promised to fix all my kitchen problems and it’s worse than useless. I’m so mad I wasted my money on this junk! They need to stop lying in their ads, it's just not right.

label: Animal-Abuse. Tortured. Cat
complaints: I think someone is hurting cats in my building, I heard some awful noises last night and its been really disturbing, I can't sleep, I mean who even does that??

Saw this dude in my alley kicking a poor kitty, like what is wrong with people, it was meowing and running away from him and I can't just stand here and do nothing, somebody needs to do something fast!!
My neighbor has this cat that they just keep outside all day and it looks so skinny and scared, doesn’t even look like it gets fed, it’s really cruel, I can’t take it anymore!
I saw a video on my phone of a cat in distress like crying and it was just horrible, I think someone is torturing it out there in my neighborhood, it makes me sick to my stomach, PLEASE HELP.

label: Consumer Complaint. Other Store (Non-Food). Expired Medication
complaints: I can't believe I bought some Advil at the pharmacy on 5th Ave and it was expired! Who does that? I'm so upset because I was relying on it for this awful headache and now I feel like I've been scammed!
Just got some medicine from that drugstore on 34th and it's seriously expired! Like, how hard is it to check dates? This is beyond unacceptable, I just want my money back!
Hey, I was at that corner store and they sold me some cold meds that were past the expiration date! Like seriously? How's anyone supposed to trust these places if they're selling junk like this?

I picked up some allergy meds at that shop near the subway and they were expired. Come on, this is ridiculous! What if I had given it to a child? I'm really angry about it and feel like I need to warn others.

label: Consumer Complaint. Clothing, Shoe, or Accessories Store. Refund, Return, or Exchange Refused
complaints: I bought a jacket from that store last week and now they say I can't return it even tho it still got the tags on, like what kinda customer service is that? I just wanted a different size!

I tried to return a pair of shoes that I wore for like 10 minutes and they said no way! I’ve never seen such a rude staff, I just want my money back, it’s not like I wore them to a wedding or something!
So I went back to this shop because the purse I got had a tiny scratch and these people were all like no exchanges or returns! I’m like seriously? What am I supposed to do with a scratched up purse?
I was denied a refund for a shirt that mismatched the size on the tag! It says large but I can't even fit my arm in it, and they just laughed and said too bad, that’s your problem!

label: Consumer Complaint. Gas Station Pumps. Inspection Seal Missing
complaints: I just went to the gas station on 5th Ave and their pumps are unsealed?? like how am I supposed to trust that I'm getting what I pay for?? it’s super sketchy! I’ve never seen that before, I don’t like it at all, can someone check it out?

Filled up my car at the Shell on Broadway and noticed there’s no inspection seal on the pump?? I mean shouldn’t they be safe and all? I don’t want to be cheated out of gas or something, can someone do something?

Yo, I pulled up to that Exxon on 42nd and realized the pumps don't have seals, how is that even allowed?? I feel like I'm just asking to get ripped off here, like come on, who’s watching these places? Please do something!!

I just want to complain about the BP on 8th St, their gas pump was missing the inspection seal and it made me super uncomfortable. How do I know if the gas is good or if I'm getting scammed? Just really don’t think that's okay, fix it!

label: General Construction/Plumbing. Smoking Ban - Smoking on Construction Site
complaints: Hey can someone do somethin about the construction site on 5th Ave?? They’re always smoking like its no big deal. I mean, its so bad I have to hold my breath when I walk by. It’s so gross and unhealthy, not cool guys!
Ugh, I’m so sick of those construction workers on Main St puffing away while they work! Like, is this even allowed? I thought we had laws about smoking in public spaces!

There’s this construction site near my apartment and I swear the dudes there are lighting up every 5 minutes. I get it, hard work, but seriously? Can’t you just step away or something? The stench is horrid, and I’m over it!

Can someone check on the construction crew over at Park Ave? Every time I walk by, they’re all huddled together smoking like they don't care. Not only does it stink but it feels unsafe having all that smoke clouding the area. Come on, be professional!

label: For Hire Vehicle Complaint. Car Service Company Complaint. Service Delay/No Show
complaints: So I called that car service like 20 minutes ago and they still aint shown up! I'm gonna miss my appointment at this rate, what even is going on?!
I booked a ride an hour ago and I'm still waiting. It says my driver is 5 minutes away but they never show!!! I was even ready early, this is so frustrating!
Yo, where's my car? I ordered one for the airport and the app said 'driver on the way' but it's been like 30 minutes now! Do I have to start walking or what?
I'm really upset right now. I waited over 45 mins for my ride and then when I called to ask they said the driver canceled! Why didn't they let me know? This is ridiculous.

label: Lost Property. Bag/Wallet. Briefcase
complaints: I was at the subway station at 42nd and 8th the other day and I left my brown leather briefcase on the bench. It had my laptop and a bunch of important papers in it. I am freaking out, please help me find it!

Lost my black messenger bag on the M15 this morning! It had my laptop and some work documents in it, and honestly I can't even remember what else. I’m gonna lose my job if I don’t get it back! Can you please check the bus or something?

So listen, I think I left my wallet at that pizza place on Bleecker St. last night after I got a slice. I called but nobody picked up and I can’t even remember what was in it. Just a lot of my cards and probably like $40 cash. I'm so stressed out!

I lost my backpack somewhere in the East Village, I think around 1st Ave and 7th St. It’s a blue one and had my favorite hoodie in it! Ugh, I just want my stuff back. If anyone sees it, please let me know!

label: Consumer Complaint. Moving Company. Overcharge
complaints: So I hired this moving company and they totally overcharged me! Was quoted a price but then they just added all these extra fees when they got here like, what the heck?? Not happy at all, felt like I got scammed!

I can't believe how much they charged me. I was told it would be $100 per hour and next thing I know my bill is $500! They didn't even move that much stuff! Really disappointed with the whole experience, never using them again!

Ugh, this moving service is a nightmare. They gave me a quote, was supposed to be a flat rate, then they hit me with all these surprise charges at the end. Like where did these fees even come from? Smh. RIPPED OFF!

I was charged way more than I was originally told for my move. They said it would take 3 hours max and I ended up paying for 6 hours. I feel cheated and I’m definitely writing bad reviews everywhere. DO NOT USE THEM!

label: Lost Property. Other. Keys
complaints: I swear I lost my keys at the subway station and now I can't get into my apartment! Like what am I supposed to do, sit outside all night? Ugh!
My keys fell out of my pocket while I was getting off the bus on 5th Ave and now I can't find them anywhere! I'm so stressed out, I can't even remember where I was exactly!
I think I dropped my keys somewhere around Times Square last night after I got my slice of pizza but I seriously have no idea where they could be. This is the worst! Help!
I lost my keys at the park today, I was chilling by the fountain. They're just regular keys but like I can't go home without them! It's so annoying!

label: Street Light Condition. Fixture/Luminaire Missing. Location Type: Park
complaints: Hey, just wanted to say there's a street light missing in the park near my place. It's super dark at night and feels kinda unsafe, like can anyone do something about this??
The street light that used to be in the playground area of the park is just gone! Like poof! It’s so dark there now and I totally can’t let my kids play after sunset. What’s going on with that?
Why is it so dark in the park after sundown?!?! There’s no light by the benches anymore, I don’t even know how anyone can walk through there. Fix it already!

Umm, excuse me, but there’s a major lack of lighting in the park! Like, there's no street light by the entrance, and it’s really hard to see when you're coming home late. Can we do something about this??

label: Consumer Complaint. Street Fair Vendor. Goods Damaged or Defective
complaints: I bought a shirt from that street fair and I swear it was made from some weird fabric, now I got holes in it after one wash! What a rip off!
So I got this handmade mug at the street fair and it's already chipped! I'm so mad, I was excited to drink my coffee from it!
I picked up this bracelet from that vendor at the fair and it fell apart like 10 minutes after I put it on! Seriously, how is that even allowed?
I thought I was getting a good deal on those gourmet cookies but they were stale and tasteless! Like, who wants to pay for crumbs?!

label: Food Establishment. Facility Construction. Badly Constructed/Maintained
complaints: I ordered some takeout and the food had this weird smell like it was old or something. I can’t even eat it, feels like it’s gonna make me sick. Got it from that new place on 5th Ave, what a disappointment!

Why is that new cafe on my block always under construction? They make so much noise in the morning and I’m trying to work from home! Also, their food is overpriced and never tastes fresh. This is NYC, not a ghost town!

Ugh, the diner on the corner is falling apart! I went in for a burger and the tables are sticky, the bathroom is gross and they took forever to serve me. I shoulda just gone to McDonald’s! I might get food poisoning at this rate!

So there’s this food truck parked right outside my apartment that’s always blasting music while I’m trying to sleep, and their food looks gross like it’s been sitting out all day! Can somebody do something about that please?

label: Maintenance or Facility. Graffiti or Vandalism. Monument/Statue
complaints: Yo, what is up with the crazy graffiti all over that statue at Union Square? It looks like a mess, and it’s actually kinda disrespectful. Can someone get this cleaned up?

I was walking by the park and saw that statue with spray paint all over it. Like, come on people, have some respect! It’s not cool to vandalize something that was put there to represent history or whatever!

That monument in the middle of the square is covered in tags and doodles! I can’t believe people think it’s okay to deface public art. Can someone do something about this please? It’s making the place look trashy.

I can’t believe how bad the graffiti is on the old statue down by the waterfront. It’s a historical piece and now it just looks like some kids went wild with spray paint. Really ruins the view, you know? Can we get it cleaned up?

label: Consumer Complaint. Third-Party Food Delivery Service. Advertising False or Misleading
complaints: I ordered my food an hour ago from that app and it said it’d be here in 25 minutes?! Now I just got a text saying it's still 15 mins away. Like what, are they walking it here? This is ridiculous!
I ordered a burger, and the pic looked amazing, but what I got was a sad little thing that looked like it was made by someone who’d never seen a burger before. Totally misleading!
So I downloaded this food delivery app because I saw a deal for 50% off first order. Turns out I still paid full price after all the extra fees and taxes! Felt like a total scam, ugh!

I tried to get my favorite sushi from this place that was supposed to be 10 mins away...waited over an hour and when it finally came, it was cold and looked like it had been through a war! Not cool at all!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Signal Visor. Loose
complaints: Hey, the traffic signal on 5th and Main is kinda falling apart, like the visor is all loose and flappin' around. It's hard to see when it's actually red or green. Fix it before someone gets hurt please!
Ugh, why is the traffic light at 42nd and Broadway always a mess? The visor is so loose it’s practically hanging off and nobody can see the light properly! It’s dangerous and annoying!
So I’m waiting at this signal at 3rd ave and 14th street and the visor is like, wobbling all over the place. I almost didn't see the light change! Can someone fix this before it causes an accident?

Seriously, do you guys ever check the traffic lights? The one at East 56th is ridiculous! The visor is loose and flopping in the wind. I don’t wanna be the one who gets hit because someone can’t tell if it’s red or green!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Temporary. Install
complaints: The traffic light at 5th and Elm is out again! I almost got hit crossing the street, can someone fix it already?!?
Why is there no light at the intersection of Broad and Maple? It's chaos every morning, cars just zooming through, not safe for pedestrians at all!
Can you please do something about the blinking yellow light at Park Ave? Nobody knows if they should stop or go, I swear I've seen people just stop in the middle of the road!
I'm tired of waiting at the red light on 42nd St when there's no cross traffic. It feels like an eternity. Just fix it so we can move on!

label: Maintenance or Facility. Recreation Center. Air Conditioning/Heating
complaints: The gym at the rec center is like a sauna! No AC at all it’s sooo hot in there I can barely breathe, I thought I was gonna pass out while doing cardio! Can someone please fix this?
Why is the air conditioning always broken at the community center? It’s summer, we’re sweating and the kids are getting cranky! This is not how you run a place meant for families!
I took my kid to the rec center yesterday and it was boiling inside, seriously it felt like I was in a furnace. Do we have to suffer through the heat just to get some exercise?
Ugh, every time I go to the rec center the AC is either too cold or too hot, can’t there be a happy medium? I just want a comfortable workout environment, is that too much to ask?

label: Consumer Complaint. Used Car Dealer. Advertising False or Misleading
complaints: I bought a used car from that dealership on 5th street and they said it was in perfect condition, but it's been leaking oil since day one! They totally lied to me and now I'm stuck with this lemon!
These guys at the car lot down on Broadway are the worst! They promised me a warranty on a used SUV and now they’re giving me the runaround. I feel so scammed, like I was tricked right off the lot!

How do these people sleep at night? I thought I was buying a reliable used car, but it broke down within a week. The ad said it was 'fully inspected' but clearly that was a bunch of bull. I want my money back!
So I went to this used car place 'cause their website said they had great deals but omg, the car I got has so many hidden problems! They need to be called out for lying in their ads, I'm furious!

label: Street Light Condition. Street Light Lamp Missing. Location Type: Residential Address
complaints: Hey, so there's this street light missing at the corner of 5th and Main and it's super dark there, feels like a crime waiting to happen, can we please fix this asap? I'm tired of walking my dog in the pitch black!
OMG, I just tripped over a tree root because the street light on my block is gone! It's like walking in a horror movie out here, someone needs to replace that ASAP before someone gets hurt!
The street light at the end of my block is gone! Like completely missing, and I've almost been hit by cars twice now at night. It's so dangerous, can someone please do something about this?

I live on 10th Avenue and the light at the corner with 14th is not even there anymore. It’s so dark, I can’t see my hand in front of my face, let alone my neighbors! This is ridiculous, fix it already!

label: Consumer Complaint. Process Server. License or Complaint Sign Not Displayed
complaints: So I just got this weird knock on my door and it's this guy trying to give me some papers but like, he didn't have anything that said he was legit or whatever. Like, is this even legal? I want to know who let this dude roll up to my place like that without any identification!!
