Why is there no sign for the exit to Queens on the highway?? I drove around in circles like a total idiot trying to find my way! This is ridiculous.

Seriously, can someone replace the missing sign on the highway for the exit to the Bronx? I nearly drove off the road trying to figure out where to go and it’s not safe, people need to know where they’re headed!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Bike Signal. Missing
complaints: Hey so like there's this bike signal missing at 5th and main, I almost got run over cause cars don’t know when to stop for us! Like can someone fix that ASAP?
Yo, the bike signal at 10th and Ave C is just gone! I'm dodging cars left and right here. I swear it's like a video game out here, but NOT in a fun way. Please do something!
Uhh, there's no bike signal at the corner of Broadway and 42nd. I thought we were supposed to be promoting bike safety?? I'm freaking out every time I ride through there, it ain't safe!
The bike signal is MIA on 8th and 23rd! I mean how hard is it to put one in? I'm tired of yelling at cars when I cross. Just fix it already, thanks.

label: Street Light Condition. Lamppost Wire Exposed. Location Type: Residential Address
complaints: Hey the street light on my block is totally busted, like it’s flickering on and off and I swear it’s gonna fall apart any second now. It’s really dark and kinda scary walking home at night. Can you please fix it ASAP?

So there’s this lamp post outside my building and the wire is hanging out all exposed and it’s dangerous!!! I got kids around here and it looks like an accident waiting to happen, please send someone to take a look fast!

Ugh, I’m tired of this! The streetlight by my house has been out for weeks now and it’s like a black hole at night. I’ve almost tripped and fallen like 3 times, can we get some action on this already or what?

Listen, I was walking my dog and I nearly got my foot stuck in the wires dangling from that lamp on the corner of 5th and Main. It’s such a hazard! I don’t know who’s in charge of this stuff but it really needs to be handled, like yesterday.

label: Consumer Complaint. Third-Party Food Delivery Service. Goods or Services Not Delivered
complaints: Ordered my food over an hour ago AND it says its out for delivery but where is it???? I'm starving and have a meeting in 10 min!! Come onnn!!!
This delivery service is the worst. My order has been sitting at the restaurant for like 30 mins according to the app. Why even bother ordering if my food won't come?
So I waited for my food for like an hour just to get a message saying it was canceled??? Like wth I was looking forward to it and now I have to figure out dinner again smh.
The delivery guy just ghosted me! I was outside waiting for 20 mins, and then the app says he 'can't find my location'? I live in a building, not like I’m in the middle of nowhere!

label: For Hire Vehicle Report. Car Service Company Report. Fare/Tip/Receipt
complaints: So I took a ride from this car service and they charged me way more than what was on the app!!! Like why is the fare so high??? I know I didn’t go that far but the driver decided to take some weird route and now I’m out like 40 bucks! This is ridiculous!!

I got dropped off a block away from my destination because the driver said the street was closed. No one told me anything about that and I ended up walking in this rain. Can I get a refund or something? Totally unfair!

I don’t even know if I can trust these car services anymore. I took a ride last night, and the driver was super rude and didn’t even give me a receipt. Like, how am I supposed to keep track of my expenses? This is not how you treat customers, seriously!

This driver didn't know where they were going AT ALL. They kept asking me for directions and I had to tell them the whole way! Plus, I got double charged on my credit card! WHAT IS GOING ON!!! I expect better from these services!!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Wood Pole Equipment. Install
complaints: Hey, so the traffic light at 5th and Main is totally outta whack like it just stays red forever! I feel like I'm gonna get hit every time I go through there, can someone fix this already?
Not sure who to tell but the stoplight on 2nd Ave is broken! Cars just go zooming by and it's really dangerous. I almost got hit with my kids there, it's been like that for weeks!

Ugh, the light at 42nd and 8th is acting super weird. It doesn’t change when it’s supposed to and I saw a delivery guy almost get hit. Can you please send someone to check it?! This is getting ridiculous!
There’s a wooden pole near the traffic light at 52nd street that looks like it’s about to topple over! The light’s also out and cars just go crazy, you need to send someone to look at both ASAP!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Blank Out Matrix Sgn. Open
complaints: Hey, the traffic sign on 5th and Main is totally blank! Like, how am I supposed to know when to stop or go? It's just a big ol' nothing there, super unsafe especially during rush hour! Please fix it ASAP!

Can you please do something about that blank out sign at 42nd street? It’s supposed to direct traffic but it’s been blank for days! Cars are just honking like crazy and it’s confusing AF! Get it together!

Yo, there’s this sign near the park that’s just not working, it’s all blacked out. Drivers are speeding by and it’s a mess! I saw a near accident today! How is this even allowed to happen in the city?

The electronic traffic sign at Broadway & 23rd is out, it’s just black! People are blowing their horns like it’s a parade and nobody knows when to stop! Can we just fix it already? This is New York, not a game!

label: Consumer Complaint. Pawnbroker. Pawned Items Sold Without Consent
complaints: I pawned my grandma's ring at that shop on 3rd Ave and they sold it without even telling me! I'm so mad I can't even think straight, that's my family heirloom!
Had a real bad experience with this pawn shop on 5th St! I left my watch there, and now it's gone! Supposedly they sold it? No one called me or anything!
Listen, I thought I was being smart pawning my guitar for some quick cash, but those thieves sold it right from under me! I want something done about it, like seriously!
So I took my old camera to a pawn place, and they promised it was safe but now I hear they sold it?? Like, what even?! That was my dad's and it was my only keepsake from him, how is that even legal?

label: For Hire Vehicle Complaint. Equipment Complaint. Broken/Missing
complaints: So I just tried to get picked up by this car, and the driver was acting super shady, like he wasn't even in the right spot? Then he tells me he can't take me because something was wrong with his app?? Like what? Can someone fix this, I'm running late and this is ridiculous!

There’s this car service that keeps parking in front of my building like it's their private driveway! My buddy almost got hit trying to cross the street because they always stop in the middle of the road. It’s so frustrating, can’t these drivers just follow the rules?

Yo, what’s up with the app glitches? I booked a car and it sent me a text that the driver was 2 mins away, but he never showed up! I had to wait forever in the cold and then I just gave up and took the subway. This is not how you do business!

I’m honestly fed up. The car I got last night was completely wrecked inside! Smelled like someone had a pizza party in there, and the seat was totally broken. Like I paid for this? Come on! Someone needs to check these vehicles more often, that’s just gross.

label: Maintenance or Facility. Unsecured Facility. Bike Path/Greenways
complaints: Why is the bike path by the river always so messy? There’s trash everywhere and it smells so bad, like can someone please just pick it up? Not asking for much, just a clean place to ride my bike without dodging garbage.
The gates on the bike path aren’t even locked half the time! I’ve seen kids hangin out at night and who knows what else! This is dangerous and people could get hurt, or worse!
Hey, there’s a section of the greenway that’s totally overgrown and it’s making it hard to even ride my bike through, like did nobody think maybe we should trim the bushes?

So there’s this spot on the bike path where the fence is just gone! Just an open gap and it’s super sketchy cause you could just ride right into the street if you’re not paying attention. Can we fix this please?

label: Water Quality. Taste/Odor, Musty/Stale (QA4). Qa4
complaints: Why does the water taste like I’m drinking a wet cardboard box?? It’s so gross! Like, can we get a filter or something? So sick of it!
I just filled my glass and it smells musty, like an old basement or something. I don’t know what’s going on but it’s making me not want to drink water at all. This is unacceptable!
Ugh, can someone do something about the water?? It tastes stale and I’m pretty sure it’s making me feel sick. I’m all for staying hydrated but not if it tastes like moldy bread!
I’m tired of my water tasting like it’s been sitting in a dirty old bucket! It’s awful and I’m scared to even use it for cooking. What’s the deal???

label: Consumer Complaint. Gas Station Pumps. Price Displayed on Pump Inaccurate
complaints: Yo, I just filled up my tank and the price on the pump was way different than what I was charged at the register! How is that even legal? I’m not made of money!
Went to that Shell on 5th Ave and the prices at the pump don't match what they have on the sign! They need to fix this or I’m reporting them, this is so shady!
I just left this gas station and the pump said $3.20 a gallon but I got charged $3.50! Like, seriously? What a scam! Get it together people!
Why do I always get ripped off at the gas stations!? Pulled up to fill up and the price said one thing but the charge was totally different at the end, I’m so tired of this nonsense.

label: Lost Property. Other. Religious Item
complaints: I lost my grandfather's rosary at the park near 5th Ave and it's super important to me! I was sitting on a bench and might've left it there, please help me find it or tell me if anyone turned it in, ugh I can't believe I lost it!

So I was at this flea market on the Lower East Side and I dropped my prayer beads, they were special to me, a gift from my mom or something. Can someone check if they turned it in, seriously I feel awful about it.

Hey, I think I left my kippah at the deli on 86th St. I was there grabbing a bagel and I’m pretty sure I took it off to eat but now I can’t find it anywhere. It’s like my lucky one or whatever! Please let me know if you find it!

I need help because I can't find my church cross necklace that I wore around my neck, I think I dropped it near the subway station at 42nd Street or something. It’s really sentimental and I’m freaking out! Can you please keep an eye out or something? Thanks!

label: Consumer Complaint. Bodega, Deli, or Convenience Store. Air Conditioning Law Not Posted
complaints: Yo, I just walked into my local bodega and it was a sauna in there, like seriously who needs a gym when you can just sweat shopping for snacks?! Also, where’s the sign about air conditioning? I thought that was a law or something, this is NYC not the jungle!

Came in to grab a drink and this deli was hotter than my ex’s attitude! There’s no air conditioning notice anywhere, I don’t even know if I’m breathing in the right air. It’s like a furnace in there. Someone needs to get it together!

I love my corner store but I’m melting every time I go in. There’s no temp sign and it’s just ridiculous, like can’t they install AC or at least tell us something?! I was just trying to buy a bag of chips and left looking like I just ran a marathon!

Okay but seriously, why is it so hot in the deli? I almost passed out in there and nobody has a clue about the AC law. It’s just wrong! I ended up leaving without my sandwich cause I couldn’t handle the heat! Fix it already!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Conduit. Damaged
complaints: Hey, can someone please fix that traffic light on 5th and Main? It’s flickering like a disco ball, and it’s so confusing! I almost got hit today!
The traffic signal at 3rd Ave and 42nd Street is totally messed up! It’s been malfunctioning for a week now, and cars are just blasting through. I’m scared to cross the street!
Ugh, the light at 8th St and Broadway is all wonky. It stays red forever for us pedestrians but cars just zoom right through when it turns green. Total chaos!
Seriously, the signal at 12th and 8th is like broken or something. It just stays yellow way too long and then turns red for ages! I mean, wth?! Can we get it fixed, please?

label: Mobile Food Vendor. Food Worker Activity. Food Worker Illness
complaints: There’s this food truck on my corner and I swear every time I walk by it smells like something went bad like all the time. I don’t think the guy should be serving food if it smells like that, gross!
I saw the taco truck last night and the guy was sneezing everywhere while he was prepping food, like come on. What are you doing, man? I don’t wanna eat sneezes!
So there's this halal cart near my office and I got food poisoning from it last week. I don’t know what they put in that rice but I was stuck home for 3 days, felt like I was gonna die!
Can someone check on that hot dog vendor on 5th and 42nd? I saw him drop a bun on the ground and just pick it up and put it back like it’s totally fine. Makes me sick just thinking about it!

label: Food Establishment. Food Protection. Food Re-Served
complaints: I ordered takeout from that new sushi place down the block, and I swear I got the same roll from last week like it was just sitting in the fridge! I'm not trying to eat leftovers that I didn't ask for, this is just gross!

Every time I go to my favorite deli, I see them put back sandwiches that people didn't finish, like how long does that stuff sit there before someone else eats it?? That's just nasty, I can't even with this.
So I went to this little corner cafe and I think they served me a pastry that was a day or two old? I mean it was hard as a rock, I gotta wonder how fresh everything really is when I go there!

I bought a pizza from that place on 5th, and I'm telling you, it tasted like it had been reheated from last week! Like, come on, can we get some fresh food around here?? I'm not paying for yesterday's leftovers!

label: Consumer Complaint. Used Car Dealer. Title Not Provided
complaints: I just bought a used car from this dealer and they told me I'd get the title in a week but it’s been way too long and I still don't have it, why are they making it so difficult?
What kind of scam is this?? Bought a car last month and they promised to send me the title but it’s like no one ever replies to my messages, so frustrating!
So I bought a used car and they promised me the title would be mailed, but it's crickets on their end. I called, emailed, nothing! Is this normal?
I’m seriously losing my mind here, I bought a car from these guys last month and they still haven’t given me the title, like am I just supposed to drive around illegally or what??

label: Electric. Wiring. Fuse Blows Out
complaints: My lights keep flickering and the fuse keeps blowing so I'm in the dark like every other night like what in the world! I swear something’s wrong with the wiring. This is getting ridiculous!
Can someone please come check the wiring in my apartment? The power keeps going out and I can't even use my microwave because if I do, literally everything turns off! It's driving me insane!
Ughhh my electric keeps tripping and its just not cool, it happens like every couple days now! I thought it was a one time thing but I guess not! Need help or something!
So I tried to watch the game last night and just as my team scores - boom! The fuse blows again! I can't keep doing this, it’s messed up! Can someone come fix this already?

label: Food Establishment. Sewage. Contaminated Facility/Equip.
complaints: I just went to this place on 3rd Ave for lunch and I swear the food tasted off. Like, super off, I can't even put my finger on it but I think the kitchen is dirty or something, I felt sick afterwards. Pls look into this!
I found some nasty stuff in my sandwich from that deli on 45th St, it was like brown goo and I’m pretty sure it’s not supposed to be there. This is so gross, how can they even serve food like that?

Hey, can someone check out that Italian restaurant on 8th Ave? I think their pasta was sitting in sewer water or something. Smelled weird, really weird! I shouldn't have gone there, but I was starving!

The bakery on 5th St had a weird smell like sewage when I walked in and the employees didn’t even seem to notice. Like, hello? Is this normal? I didn’t want to buy anything after that, it was just so off-putting.

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Veh Sgnl Mult Lamps. Obscured (Dirty)
complaints: Yo, that traffic light at 42nd and 8th is so filthy you can barely see the red! I almost ran a red light the other day! Clean it up, it’s a mess!
I think the street light on 5th Ave by the library is covered in grime, I mean seriously, does anyone even clean these? Can’t see which color it is, super dangerous!
The stoplight at 34th and Broadway needs some TLC! It's like they haven't wiped it down since the last snowstorm! I want to cross safely without second-guessing!
Why is that traffic signal on Park Ave such a joke? It's basically camouflaged at this point, can’t even tell when it's green or red. Get a ladder and a sponge for crying out loud!

label: Consumer Complaint. Moving Company. Property or Home Damage
complaints: So my stuff was supposed to arrive yesterday from that moving company and they just ghosted me! No one picking up the phone, it's like they vanished! Now my furniture is who knows where and I’m sitting on the floor, like this is NOT how it’s supposed to go!

I hired these movers and they scratched my hardwood floors moving my couch in like they didn’t even care! I’m furious, it looks terrible and now I gotta deal with this mess when I should be unpacking!

Like, I thought I was just getting a simple move but the guys broke my favorite lamp and now they won’t even return my calls! Can’t believe I trusted them, I’m gonna tell everyone I know to stay away from them!

I had a bunch of boxes stacked in the corner and when the movers came they just knocked them over like it was no big deal. Ugh! I can’t find half my stuff now, it’s seriously ridiculous how careless they were!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Pedestrian Sign. Hanging
complaints: Hey so this pedestrian sign on 5th and 42nd is just hanging there like it’s about to fall down, super unsafe for us trying to cross and also I’ve almost hit my head on it, fix this ASAP!
Why is the pedestrian signal at East 15th street hanging off the pole?! I saw a kid almost knock it down the other day, it’s just dangling there like a piñata or something, please sort it out!

Seriously, the pedestrian sign at Broadway and 34th is hanging on by a thread! I’m worried it’s going to fall on someone’s head, like can you please send someone to take a look before someone gets hurt?
The walk sign at 3rd Ave and 60th is all messed up, it’s kinda hanging crooked and nobody knows when to cross like it’s a game of guesswork! C’mon, people need to get to work safely!

label: Consumer Complaint. Storage Warehouse. Property Damage
complaints: I had some stuff in storage and when I got it back it was totally ruined, like water damage everywhere and I swear it smelled like mold. What is going on?! This is so ridiculous, I can't even believe I paid for this.

I tried to get my things out of my storage unit and there was a leak or something, everything was soaked! They said it was fine but now I'm sitting here with soggy boxes and no help, this is just not fair!

Can someone please explain why my belongings look like they were dragged through a hurricane? I thought storage was supposed to protect my items, not destroy them! I'm so beyond upset right now, like how do I even recover from this?

I just picked up my stuff from the storage place and it's like they threw my boxes around or something, some are damaged and I found a rat's nest in one of them! Ugh, this is the last time I trust a storage unit, what a mess!

label: Street Sign - Missing. Construction
complaints: I just drove past that huge hole where they’re diggin up the street and you know what? There’s no sign to tell us we should even slow down or watch out! Someone is gonna get hurt, I swear!
So there’s this construction on Third Ave and they took the stop sign away, like why??? People are just zooming by like it’s the Autobahn, it’s dangerous! Pls fix this before someone gets run over!
The sign at Elm and 5th is missing because of the construction and it’s like a free-for-all! Cars don’t know to stop, it’s chaotic! Can you get someone out there to just put a new sign up? Thanks!

I can’t believe you guys took the street sign and now no one knows where the heck they are! I was lost for over 30 minutes trying to figure out intersections! This is ridiculous, stop messing with the signs!

label: Traffic Signal Condition. Blank Out Matrix Sgn. Out
complaints: Hey, the electronic sign on 5th and main is blank, like totally blank. What’s the point?? It’s confusing and dangerous!
Yo, there’s a blank sign at the intersection of 42nd and 8th, can’t even tell if I’m supposed to stop or go... fix it already, please!
This sign on Broadway is out! I almost got into an accident because it didn’t tell me anything. Why even have it if it’s not working? Ugh!
Seriously, the matrix sign on 34th street is just not working at all!!! I rely on it to know when to cross, this is just ridiculous!

label: Street Light Condition. Street Light Out. Location Type: Other
complaints: Yo, the street light at the corner of 5th and Maple is totally out, like pitch black over here at night. It's scary to walk home, what’s taking so long to fix it?
Why is the light by my building not working? I got almost hit by a bike last night and I swear I couldn't see anything. Get it together please!
Ugh, can someone please do something about the street light on 42nd? It’s been out for weeks and it’s so dark I feel like I’m in a horror movie every time I walk by!
Seriously, I don’t get how the street light near Central Park is still out. I almost tripped and fell the other night. This is beyond ridiculous, fix it already!
